sentence: hi'a kowheli khanoheha tsunelhthanvhsv tsihsa kalonetvhi tewi uwetsiav ekwahami uwetsi.
ekwahami ehsiki utenhele'i; ehsikinho tsekakwi utenhele'ihi tsekakwinho tsuta ale nahski anatanvtli kvwatenhele'i;
tsutanho kwelihsi' ale hsela kvwatenhele'i thema tunanukowihse'i; kwelisino ihsilami utenhele'i'i ihsilaminho elimi utenhele'i;
eliminho eminitakwi utenhele'i v eminitakwinho nahsoni utenhele'i; nahsonino hsalima utenhele'i;
salimanho kwohsi utenhele'i lehawi unalvkowhihse'i; kwohsinho okweti utenhele'i' luhsi unanukowhihse'i a okwetinho tsehsi utenhele'i;
tsehsinho tewi ukvwiyuhi utenhele'iyv tewinh ukvwiyuhi hsolimanv utenheli yulaya utayhvtv unanukowhihse'i;
hsolimanvnho lokwoma utenhele'i i lokwomanho ekwaya utenhele'i v ekwayanho ehsi utenhele'i;
ehsinho tsohsikwa utenhele'i.  tsohsikwanho tsolami utenhele'i; tso'laminho ohsaya utenhele'i;
ohsayanho tsotami utenhele'i; tsotaminho ehahsi utenhele'i; ehahsinho hehsikaya utenhele'i;
hehsikayanho manasi utenhele'i; manahsinho amoni utenhele'i; amoni'nho tsohsaya utenhele'i;
tsohsayanho tseknaya ale anatanvtli kvwatenhele'i; nahiyu tatiloni tsiwitikekathinhvhsthane'i;
tatiloninho witikekathinolhv tsekonaya salatayili utenhele'i v saltayilinho tsilakweli utenhele'i;
tsilakwelinho akwayati utenhele'i v akwayahtinho ilaykimi utenhele'i; ilayakiminho ehso utenhele'i;
ehsonho hsetoki utenhele'i; setokinho ekimi utenhele'i; ekiminho ilayti utenhele'i;
ilayatino iliesa utenhele'iha ili'ehsanho matani utenhele'i v matani'nho tsekakwi utenhele'i;
tsekakwinho tsowa utenhele'i, nahski meli uyhehi nahski tsunanukowhihse tsihsa kalonetv tsanohaho'i.

nahskinho nikatv nunatanetliyvhsv ekwahami tsehe nahiyu nvtakvwatalenvtv tewinho tsehe nvtvhsthi nika'tu nuntanetliyvhse'i; tewinho tsehe nahiyu nlikvwatalenvtv tatiloninho tsiwitikekathinhvhsthane nahiyu nvtvhsthi nika'tu nuntanetliyvhse'i; tatiloninho nahiyu tsiwitikekathinhvhsthane utayutalenvtv tsihsanho tsutenhe nahiyu nvtvhsthi nika'tu nunatanetliyvhse'i.
nahskinho hi'a nulhsthanitole utenhv tsihsa kalonetv.  nahski meli tsihsa' utsi tsowa utayhvhsti v ahsikwo nitanatshekvna kehse'i, unelitse kalvkwtiyu atanto utanhthelhvhi.
tsowa nahski na tsunatshvhsti utanhthiyhu kehsv iyuhsti, ale nutulihskvna kehsv' iyuhsti' kvnikehshv utehohihstohtiyi, utelitvkwo iyvtv wvtatsiyahkhanhi, uwelihse'i.

ahsenho ahsikwo hi'a nahski nuhste atanhthehske'i, kvnhiyukwo tikhanhahwatitohi yihowa unvhsitv khvnikehsv nutvnhele ahskitskv'i, hi'a nikawehske'i i tsowa, tewi uwetsi, lhehsti tsahskalv hiyanvtiyi meli tsatayhvhsti v nahskiyhenho na tsikaneli kalvkwtiyu atanhto utanthelhvhi;
ale takananukowhihsi atshutsa v nahskinho tsihsa tehiyo'vha, tsutseliyhenho yvwi totvhstelvhi' totakutalehsi unihskanvtsv'i.
nahskino hi'a nikatiyu nulhsthnitole utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsv'i hi'a tsinuwehse yihowa atolehohski akvtihskv'i;
khvniyukwo athv natsiyehvna kanelitv kehsehsti, ale takananukowhihsi atshutsaav nahskino' imanu'eli anohsehehsti, nahski anhelhthanvhi kehsv' hi'a nuhsti kathka, unelhanvhi ikelatitoha.
tsowano uyetsv ulhvnhv'i tikhanhahwtitohi yihowa nvtayunvhsitv nuwehselv nutvnele'i, uyhanvhkekwo utayhvhsti.
ale' vlha yukhthovhse'i khvnhi unanukowhihsv ikvyi ehi uwetsi atshutsa, tsihsanho suwo'e'i.
tsihsanho utenhv katuyi katuhv tsutiyi v nahiyu tsehe elotv ukvwiyuhiav khvnhiyukwo uniluhtse tsiluhsilimi anikhthanhahi nvto tikhalvkv ititlv tsunilohse'i,
hi'a nuniwehse'i v hatlv na tsutenhv ukvwiyhi anitsuhsi unatselika, okikohvyhenho utseli nokwihsi tikhalvkv ititlv, ale otsatatolihstanelika.
elotno ukvwiyuhi uthvkanv' nahskiav uwelihihsti utanvhtate'i, ale nikatv tsiluhsilmi anehi.
tulawithvnho nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi v ale yvwi tinowhelanehi, tuthvtvnhe'ivi nanhahutehti kehsv kalonetv.
hi'anho nikvwawehsele'i; tsutiyi katuy katuhv'i; hiayhenho nuwanhv uwowhela atolehohski;
ale nihi katuyi katuhv tsutiyi, vlhahskini tsahstikhani yiki v tsilotahsuya nunikvwiyuhsv tsutiyi, nihiyhenho tatsanukotsi tikwatseli yvwi ihsili-tikhanetsehi.
nhahkwono elotv utelitv wituyhanvhv nahski anikhthanhahi, ohstv tuthvthihsanhe' iyukwo nahski nokwsi unanukotsv'i.
ale tunvhse katuyi, hi'a nuwese'i i itsena ohstv wetsiyoka nahski uhsti ayolhi, iyunho etsiwahthvhvha a ihskinonhelilhvha v ayvnho nahskwo witsiluhtsvha, ale tsiyatatolihstanelvha.
unathvkanhonhelvnho ukvwiyuhi unanhikihse'i v kvnhiyukwonho nokwsihv nahski' unikohvhi tikhalvkv' ititlv, ikvyi unenv'ele'i v khvnhi wuluhtsilhv ale ulewhihsthanv' kalvlatitlv nnhahaatslhi ehv'i.
unikohvnho nahski nokwsi, ulothanvhi unalihelitse'i.

atanelvnho uniyvlhv unikohe ayolha ale utsi meli i ale elati tunatanvne'iav unatatolihstanele'ihi ale tsukvwalhohti unihlanvtv tunihstu'ihsv uninhelvne nvnalhskolhthanvhi, atelv-talonitv, ale ukanahstv kawhsvki atlat ale mila.
anahskitskvnho unelanvhi tunetselv elotvyi wunilohihstiyi nikehsvna a unanhikihsv utsathinikwo ititlv wunilohse iunenv unatselikohi.

unanhikihsvnho khvnhiyukwo tikhanhahwtitohi unvhsitv yihowa khvnikehsv nutvnhele tsowa' ahskitskv'i, hia nuwehsele'i; thalehvkaav ale thathinhuka ayolhi ale utsi a'le halithihu itsikwi whilohi, nanhhanho whehehsti khvni wikvnetselvhahi elotvhyenho ahse tvyholi uhsti ayolhi uhihstiyi.
nhahkwono tulenhv uthinhvhse ayolhi' ale utsi' svnoyihi ale itsitvyi wulohse'i.
ale nanhahwehe khvnhi elotv uyohuhsvhv utohiyunhe unelhanvhi unhetsv'i i atolehohski tsuwhthane'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i; itsikwiyi witsiyanvhv akwetsi.

nhahkwono elotv utolehohsv anikhthanhahahi kvwalitahsthanv'i i utsahthanvhi uthalhawohse'i v ale utanvhse witunihonhe nikatv tiniyolhi katuyi anehi, ale nikatv nkvnatv nanhahani, tha'li iyunatethiyvtv wahsthiai nahiyu nvtayutalenvtv tsitalhsinhihstanehe tsitathvtvhelhv'vhske anikhthanhahi.
nhahkwonho utohiyunhe tselimay atolehohski unhetsvhi, hale tsinuwehse'i;

lemayi khanekv unathvkanvkiav taniyvhkv'iki ale tanatloyhihv'i, ale utsathi unelhuhkv'ivi letsili tahskonhihv tsuwetsi v ale nutulihskvna kehsv' unhuwohistiyi, nvtikalihstohtihskv nanehvnakwo kehsv'i.
nhahkwonho elotv uyohuhsv, khvniyukwo tikhanhahwatitohi yihowa utselika khvnikehsv nutvnhele tsowa ahskitskv' itsikwiyi,
hi'a nuwehsele'i; thalehvka ale hathinhuka ayolhi ale utsi i ale hena ihsiliyi, nhahakwohyenho tuniyohuhsv ayolhi kvnhv tsuniyohvki.
tulenhvnho uthinhvhse ayolhi ale utsi, ale ihsiliyi wuluhtse'i.
ahsenho uthvkanv atsila ukvwiyuhi kehsv tsutiyi utota elotv utanetliyvhstanelv'i v uhskale nanhahwulohihstiyi; ahsenho unelhanvhi uweyhahthanhvhi kehsv ahskitskv'i, kelili wukolhvhsthane'i;
katuhvnho nahselithi tsuto'itv wuluhtsv nanhahehe'i.vv nahskino utohiyunhe anatolehohski tsuninhetse'ihv nahselithi ehi akohsehehsti v tsunatvnhe'i.
nahiyu uluhtse tsani titawohski alhtsitohvhske inake tsutiyi,
hia nikawehske'i; titsinetliyvna tetsatanvhthv'i, nhahakwohyenho kalvlati' ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ehskaniyu taya'i.
nahski hi'a na tsikhane'ihstihske atolehohski ihsaya, hi'a tsinikawehske'iav uwelhuhka khilo inake'i i hi'a nikawehahe ohstv nitsvka yihowa ulohihstiyivv tunvnhv titsitshinohihsta.
nahskino hi'a tsani unhuwe khemili uhsthiyenhvhiav kanotsino utatlohste'ivv ulhstayvhthino vle kehse inakenho ehi watulihsi.
nakwonho wikvwaluhtshele tsiluhslimi ale nikatv tsutiyihi ale nikatv nanvnathv' tsotani,
tsotaninho te'uwo'e'i, aninhohvhske unihskanvtsv'i.
ahsenho tukohv unitsathi anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi ani'luhkv tatawohskv'iav hi'a ntuwehalei; yo v inatv tsunetsi nihi! kako itseyhahthanhv etsali'ehtiyi uthalhawohihsti tstsai?
itsinanukowayoko atolehohihstohti tetsinetliyvhsv tetsatanhtv'i;
ale lhahsti hi'a nvtayotsiwehsi itselihsvki totitsatanhthv'i; ekwahami okitota; itsvyohsehyenho unelhanvhi yelikwo hi'a nvya yitekvhta yitekolhvna' ekwahami' tsuwetsi.
ale nahskwo kayula kaluyhsti aha tunhahstetlv telhkv'i a nahskino nikatv tetluhkv anohstv nanatatv'hskvna tikaleyvhstohti ale atsilvyi witatinvti kehsehsti.

ayv utohiyuhi ama tetsvyawohstiha titsinetliyvhstiyi tetsatanhthv ukvwalhi v ahsenho nahski na onhi tsvtaya'i utlihiyu ulhnikitiyu ehskakwo ayvhv tsulahsulo vlha yeli yiniko'i tikinhitahstiyi; nahskihskini kalvkwtiyu atanhto ale atsilv totatsawohsthani.
nahski kalahsowhihsti utselika ayhehahv ale nikatv takalahsowhihsi, utselinho ukhthathanvhi takalhihsanhi tvnhi atana'nvtiyi uthiyvhihskini tvkohvhsthani nikhtlohskvna atsilvyi.
nhahkwonho tsihsa kelili tsulohse'i i tsotani uluhtse tsani etohv'i akawohstiyi uyelvse'i.
ahsenho tsani tutlvwhihselekwo i hi'a nuwehse'i v ayvhskini yihskwawo'v; tsikonho ihskiluhtseha?
tsihsano tsunhetsv hi'a nuwehselei; unelaki he'la khohi kehsv'i v ohsiyuhyenho nahski' ikinatvnhtiy kinihskwatihstiyi nika'v tuyukhtv kehsv'i. i khila unelaki uwelihsele'i.

tsihsanho akawo'v, khilakwo iyvtv unhahalusei, amayi utanvhse'i, ale khvnhiyukwo kalvlati tsatsihstuki'ele'i v ale wukohe unelhanvhi utanhtho' elati nvtsutvnhahtihse' hkule-tihskonhihi titselhitvai ale uweyalvtse'i.
ale khvnhiyukwo hi'a nvtsuwehse kalvlati; hi'a tsikeyu'i akwetsi, nahski ohsiyu tsitsiyelv'a.
nhahkwono atanhto' inake wuthinvhsthane tsihsa, ahskina ukoliyetiy ayelvhse'i.
nvkhskohinho tsutotakwatv ale nvkhskohi tsuhsvhitv amalhi uwanhv khila uyohsihsanhe'i
nhahkwonho ukoliyehski uluhtshelv hia nuwehse'ihv iyunho nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi kehsehsti'i hi'a nvya katu unatolhvhtiyi hineki.
ahsenho unhetsv, hia nuwehse'i i hi'a nikvnhv kowhela, yvwi' vlha katukwo uwahsv yikvnhahtihsti v nika'vhskini khanohetv unelanvhi aholi nvtayunnukotsvhi.
nhahkwonho ahskina kalvkwtiyu tikatuhv wuthinhvhsthane'i v ale wukhilvthane uhskholi uthvnv-tikalawi'ihstiyi;

hi'anho nuwehsele'i; iyuhno nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi kesehsti i hatalota tsvhsv i hiayheno nikvnv ikowhela v ahse totakhanetsheli kutseli tinikhanhahwtitohi nihsa kehsv ukvwalhi v ale tsunoyeni ketsahsalatotehsti nahski ilvhiyu nvyohi tsanahskwalohstohtiyi nikehsvna.
tsihsa hia nuwehsele'i; hi'a hnskwo nikvnhv ikowhela; lhehsti hikoliye'vki yihowa tsanelanvhi.
nhahkwale ahskina utsathi inv-ikathi otalv wi'uthinhvhsthane'i, ale tuhsehele nika'v ayelhi tekolhvwhatihsv elanikhv'i i ale nahski nituwotuhsv'i;
ale hi'a nuwehsele'i; hi'a nikatv yitekvyohihsihv iyunho yitsatanvnv, ale yihskwatatolihstanelv.
nhahkwono tsihsa hia nuwehsele'i v utli whilohihi setani v hiayheno nikvnhv ikowhela; ase hiyatatolihstanehehsti yihowa tsanelhanvhi v ale nahskikwo uwahsvhiyu tehiyanelhtehsti.
khilano ahskina utanv'ele'i, khvniyukwonho tinikhanhahwatitohi uniluhtse'i i ale kvwhstelvhitole'i.
tsihsanho uthvkanv tsani atsihstuhv'iav kelili wulohse'i.
nahselitino utanvhsv kekwani keluhtse nanhahawutenhe'i v nahski vtali amayulhti tsikatuhaai tsekwalani ale newathali unatselikohi,
utohiyuhtiyi atolehohski ihsaya tsunhetse'i i hi'a tsinuwehshe'i;
tsekwalani unatselikohi, ale newathali unatselikohi, itali ititlv, tsotani utititlvyv kelili tsunatalenhvtv yvwi taninelv'i,
yvwi ulhsihkv tsaninvki utsathi ikkathi unikohv, nano ayohuhihstiyi kesv utselikohi ale utawatihskv tsaninvki, ikkathi uninanukotshelv.
nahiyu tsihsa ulenvhe alhtsitohvhske'i, hi'a nikawehske'i i titsinetliyvna tetsatanhthv'i, nhahakwoyhenho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ehskanhiyu taya'i.
tsihsanho a'ihsv kelili vtalulti tukohe anithali analhinvtli, sawani kwita tsanohseho'i unhvlhino' eniti i vtali anikayalu'vhske'i-anikayalu'vhskiyhenho kehse'i.
hi'ano nituwehsele'i; skinihstawatuka, yvwino ihstikaylu'vhski nvtahstvyvneli.
kilakwonho iyvtv tuniyohse tikayaluti ale kvwahstawatvhse'i.
nanhahnho wi'uwenv, anithali nvwanatale analhinvtli tukohe'iai tsimi tsekwiti uwetsi unhvlhino tsani, tsekwiti unitota tsiyuhi unatsa'e'iav tanolhvhihsihske tsunikayalutihi wituyhanvheno.
khilakwonho iyvtv tuniyohse tsiyu' ale unitota v ale kvwahstawatvse'i.

tsihsanho nikvnathv kelili etohe'i tateyhohvhske tsunilawihstiyi v ale alhtsitohvhske ohstv khanohetv, unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehske'i, ale tekhanvwihske tsulilenhvtv tunitlvkv'ihi ale tsutalenhvtv' vyuki yvwi unehv'i.

tekanotsalhvnho nikvnathv siliyi uyelihse'i; tekvwahthinohelenho nikatv tsunitlvkivv tsutalenhvtv yuki ale ehihsti uniyilitohi, ale nahskwo anihskina tikvwaniya'i, ale nahskwo tsunilvnhohthihski, ale nahskwo tsuninawihski; tunhvwanenhoh.
unitsathinho yvwi kvwhstawatvsi nvtayunilohsvhi kelilivv ahskohinho ukatukiyiov ale tsiluhsilimi, ale tsutiyi, ale tsotani hskhonititlv.
unitsathinho witukohv' uhsahilhv unhahluhse'ihv uwenhvnho kvwhstawatitohi kvwaluhtshele'i.
aholinho uhstu'ihsv tuweyhonhe hi'a nuwehse'i;
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti uyo iyunatvnhahtekihv tunatanhthv'i; unatselihyenho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i.
ohsiyu iyunalhstanhehti uyo untanhthawateki, tvketsinuwohihsthaniyenho.
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti unatanhthiai katohihyenho unatseli iyulhstohti.
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti' uniyohsihski ale unithatekihski unatanhthi iyunalhstohtiyi; tvketsikhalilihyenho.
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti unatatolitsathiav tvketsitolitsiyhenho.
ohsiyu iyunalhstanhehti tsutanvkalvtv tsuninawi i unelanvhyeno unikowahthvhti;
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti anohihstihski i unelhanvhyenho tsuwetsi tvkkohseli.
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti uyo ikekvnateki tuyukhtv kesv unihstvtihskiav unatseliyhenho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i.
ohsiyu itsalhstanehti iyunho yvwi uhsonv ni'ketsiwehsehehsti ale uyo niketsvnehehsti v ale nika'v tsutalenhvtv uhsonv kayhkoki ketsinhohehskehsti ayv kehsv itsihstvtihskehsti.
itsalihelikehsti ale utsathanvhi ohstv itsatanhthehsti v utsathihyeno etsakuyv'eti kalvlati i nahskiyayhenho utsi nitunhvnelvki anatolehohski ikvyi tsiniketsenv'elv.
nihi ama elohi utselika; iyuhskini ama yutsihskolhv kato yikalhstohta ama yatolhvna; htla nhahakwo kohuhsti khtoti' yikakiav atinvtikwo uwahsv, ale yvwikwo unalahstati.
nihi ika itsathihstihski elohi n i katuhv uhsahilhv tsikakhaho'i vlha yeli yvkayekvhskalhvka.
vlha ale yvwi anitsvhsthvka atsvhstohti alhilohsti yanulhvtihsko'i, kakhtiyhskini anikhahvhsko'ihv ikanho unathihstaneho nikatv kalhtsote aniya'i.
ika itsathihstihskv tunilvhsatatehehsti yvwi, nahskino' ohstv tetsilvwhihstanehv anikowhahthihskehstioi ale anilvkwohtihskest itsitota kalvlati' ehi.
lhe'hsti tikhanhahwatvhsti ale anatolehohski tuyohsthanilhv yihskiyelihsehehsti; vlhahskini yitakiyohsthanilhv, takikhalililhvhskini.
utohiyuhiyahyeno hi'a nitsvwehsehahi khvnhi kalvlo'i ale elohi anilohsonhvha sakwo uhsti aleh sakwo wuhstikv tikhanhahwtvhsti vlha yvkalohi kvnhi nikatiyu akhalitsvha.

nahski iyuhsti khilo ayohstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a uhstikhani ulhinetsv'i, ale nahski nuhstesti yvwi tekeyhohvhskehsti, nahski uhstikhani akohsehehsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi' kehsv'isi khilohskini takhanhahwatekehsti, ale nahski nuhstehsti tateyohvhskehsti, kalvkwtiyu akohsehehsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i.
hiayhehno nitsvwehseha, itsvnho nahski itsatanhthi kehsv nititsikonatthanvna ikehsehsti tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi, vlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhiyukehsv' yvketsiyvha.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i; tlehsti tsatalhvki i ale khilo' atahihehsti kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tinukhtihskiyi.

ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehsehahv khilo tinatanhvlhi ahskakehsti kohuhsti nuhstvtihskvna ikehsehsti, kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tinuktihskiyi i khilonho tinatanhvlhi nitsatanhthvna ikohsehehsti, tekalawi'v kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti; khilonho tsaneku ikohsehehsti, kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tsvhskino atsilvyi.
nahski iyuhsti iyunho atsilvkelhstiyi hiyhohihehsti tsatanhehti, nanhahnho ihanvhtatihskehsti tihstatanvlhi kohuhsti tselihsehv'i,
nanhahatsilv-kelhstiyi hihiyahskehsti tsatanhehti ale hatanvhskehsti, ikvyi ohstv nihstvnehehsti tihstatanhvlhihv khilanho hi'luhkehsti halhskolhtihskehsti tsatanhehti.
nulakwo ohstv nihstv tsahyi'litohi v ahsikwo ihsta'ihsv'i, tikukhtihskiyinahsi wiyitsakhahvka tsahyi'litohi i tikukhtihskinho titaniyihskiyihv wiyitsakhahvka, ale titahstutiyi yiwetsayvhta.
utohiyuhya hi'a nikvwehseha, vlha yvtvkahinuko'i, khvnhi ulihskwalhti ayelhiiyatanhthehti hhkuyvhvha.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i; lhehsti tsatayhonelvki.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehsehahv khilo akeyhv takhanihskehsti tsunanhsihtiyi utulihskehstivv kayula utayhonelvhi kehsehsti tsutanhthv'i.

iyuno hikhtholi hikhthisi tetsotehstihskehsti, hataktheto'ihskehstiyv ale tsatekehstihi ohsiyuyhenho itsalhstanehti hsakwokwo tsalikvhalvtv yitsayohuhseha, anho unhohstv hiyelv tsvhskino wiyetsata'ineha.
iyunho tsoyeni hikhthihsi tetsotehstihskehsti s hihskwalihskehsti, ale tsatekehstihv ohsiyuyheno itsalhstanehti hsakwokwo tsalikvhalvtv yitsayohuhseha, anho unhohstv hyelv tsvhskino wiyetsata'ineha.
hi'a ikawetv iki'i khilo utali'i ikakhahvhskehsti, kanvnehehsti kowheli nahski tunakalenvhv'i.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehsehahv khilo utali ikakhahvhskehstivv tsunhsinhvhihskninon ikehsehsti, utayhonehtiyikwo nikvnhihsanehehstihi khilono' atsikhanhvhi atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti.
ale itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i; lhehsti tsayohsthanv tsahselithanv'i, yihowahskini niyatvnehehsti nuhstv tshanetsv'i.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha; lhehsti yitsselithanehsti yitsane'ihsthane'hsti kohuhsti, lhehsti kalvlati yitsane'ihsthanehsti v unelanvhiyenho uwehtiyi nahski;
tlehsti ale elohi, tsulahsihtiyyenho nahski v ale tsiluhsilimi, nahskiyeno atsilvkwoti ukvwiyuhi utseli katuhv'i;
tlehsti hle hskoli yitsane'ihsthanehsti, tlayhenho yeli hsakwo kilhv unekv ale kvnhahke yinvkahvka.
itsinekvhskini hi'a nuhstehsti, vv, vv v vlha, vlha; utliyhenho tsinika'o uyokwo kehsv' titalehnihsko'i.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a ikawetv kesv'ihv akhtha akhthakwo takvwalhvhskehsti, khayuhkanho khayuhkakwo takwalhvhskehsti.
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsawehseha; lhehsti yitsatlekehsti uhsonhv netsvnelv'ihi khilohskini' hikathihsi tsakkweluhvhskehsti, so'i nahskwo hiyalihskolvtanehehsti.
khilonho utulihskehsti tsahyilitahstiyi, ale tsanaehtiyi hawini tsanhuwo, uthvnohi nahskwo hnnhsti.
khilohn sulhilotv ihstenvhstiyi nitsvnhehehstiav tha'li iyulhilotv ihstekehsti.
tsathayohsehi hinehehsti, tsatholvehtiyino utulihski lhehsti iyvtv ihiyatvnhelvki.
itsathvkanvhi iki hi ikawetv kehsv'i; hikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala, hihskakehstino tsahskaki.

ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha; tetsikeyuhsehsti ketsihskaki v ohstv tetsinetsehehsti ketsihskinvtihski, ohstv nitetsatvnhehehsti ketsinikwathihi, ale ohstv iyunalhstanhehtiyi itsatatolihstihskehsti kayhkoki ketsinohehski ale uyo iketsvnehi.
nahskino kalvlati ehi itsitota tsuwetsi nitsalhstihskehstiyv nahskiyhenho utseli' nvto tekananukowhihseho uniyo ale anohstv, ale takanvhtaneho unatanhthi ale uninekutsitv.
iyuynho yititsikeyuha ketsikeyuhi v kato yetsakuyvhtahshi?  tlahsko nahski' yinanatvneho ayelhi-atelv anikihsitohi?
iyu ale itsatanhvlhikwo unvhsv yititsiyoliha i kato itsatvnehv tetsikonahtti anihso'i?  tlahsko nahski yinanatvneho ayelhi-atelv anikihsitohi?
nihihskini' nitsihskanhvna kehsehsti nahskiya itsitota kalvlati ehi nahskanhvna tsiki.
itseyhahthahehsti tlehsti yitsatanhehehsti anikhthahv yvwi ketsikowhahthvhtiyikwo yitsiyelvhskehsti i iyuyhenho nahskikwo yinuhsti vlha yvketsakuyvhsi itsitota kalvlati' ehi.

nahski iyuhsti iyunho hatanhehehsti lhehsti atselhuhki ikvyi wiyinoyhvlhihstihskehsti nahski tsinanatvneho unatlonahsti tsulawihstiyi ale enaitahstiyi tekalanvtv'i i yvwikwo kvwanilkwohthohtiyi tsuniyelvhso'i; utohiyuhya itsvyohseha, kekakuyv'elv.
nihskini hatanhehehsti lhehsti tsoyeni hikhskani utolehohsv hikahthihsi tsoyeni natnhi.
nahskino hatanhehv utelihsv kehsesti, tsatotanho utelihsv akowhahthihski uwahsv ahse tsakhuyv'eti kehsehsti khvnikehsv'i.

iyu ale htatolihstihskehsti, aha lhehsti nunhstv unatlonahsti yinitsahstehsti; nahskiyhenho ohso uniyelvhso unatatolihstohtiyi unaletiyi tikalawi'ihstiyi ale tunhvhsiyanv tekalanvtv enaitahstiyi, yvwikwo kvwnikowhahthvhtiyi unatulihsko'i. a utohiyuhya itsvyoseha i kekakuyv'elv.

nihskini iyunho thatatolihsthanihsehsti wiyvhihehsti khanvhsulv'i, nhahakwonho tsahstunhehsti kalohihstiyi, hiyatatolihstanehehsti tsatota utelihsv ehi, tsatolinho utelihsv akowhahthihski ahse tsakuyv'ehti kehsehsti khvnikehsv'i.
ahsenho itsatatolihstihskehsti lhehsti' ahsekwo yitsvkhthilohskehsti nahski tsinanatvneho tsunatalenhvtv yvwi v utsathihyeno otsinekv utakalhstohthani tayokathvkaneli anelihsko'i.
nihskini lhehsti nahski nunhstv yinitsahstehsti a itsitotayheno akhthaho iyuhsti itsinikvkv ahsikwo netsithayohselvna tsikehso'i.
nihihskini itsatatolihstihskv hi'a nuhstehsti; ohkitota kalvlati hkehi, kalvkwtiyu kehsehst tetsato'v'i.
tsakvwiyuhi kehsv wikananuko'i.  anhi elohi winikalhsta hatanhthehskv'i, nahskiya kalvlati tsinikalhstiha.
nitatotakwihsv okalhstayvhti hski'vhsi khohi ika.
tikehskivhsikwonho tehskithukv'i, nahskiya tsitikayotsinheho tsotsithuki.

ale lhehsti utakoliyetiyi kehsv witihskiyathinhvhsthanvkivi skiyutalehskehstikwohskini utsi kehsv'i.  tsatselikayhenho tsakvwiyuhi kehsv'i, ale tsalhiniktiyi kehshv'i, ale etsalvkwtiyu kesv nikohilv'i.  emenv.
iyuynohsyvwi ketsihskanvtsehv yitiktsineha v nahskwo itsitota kalvlti ehi itsitolihsti kesehsti.
iyuhskini nitiketsinhehvna yiki yvwi ketsihskanvtshehv'i, nahskwo itsitota' vlha yitoketsihvhsi itsihskanvtsv'i.

ale nahskwo amalhi itsvhskehsti, lhehsti nvnatlonahsti nunahstv yinitsahstehstiai unatatolihsti tsikehso tikhanhtiyi v nitatselhvnayheno nitanvneho tunakhathv'i i yvwikwo unatolehohihstiyi unatulihsko amalhi anvhskv'i.  utohiyuhya nitsvwehseha kekakuyv'elv.
nihskini amalhi hvhskehsti, hatlonehskehsti, ale hakvhskwohskehsti,
nahski lhehsti yvwikwo ketsatolehohihsehtiyi yitsayelihsehsti amalhi tsvhsv'i v tsatohtskini utelihsv ehi, tsatotnho utelihsv akowhahthihski, ahse tsakhuyv'ehti' khvnikehsv'i.
tlehsti tsukvwalhti elohi' yitsilhihsihskehsti, tsiskoyv ale ayhahstltatihski uniyohstohtiyi ale aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi ale uninohskihstiyi;
kalvlatihskini witsilhihsihskehsti tsukvwalhti v nanhahni tsskoyv ayhahstlattihskinho uniyohstohtiyi nikehsvna kehsvi v ale aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi ale uninohskihstiyi nikehsvna kehsv'i.
nanhahyhehno tsukvwalhti witsihv'i ahse nahskwo witahehsti titsatanhto.
akhtha ayelhv ika kathihstihski, iyuhskini' hiktholi kohuhsti nuhstvna kehsehsti i nikhv hyeli ukhalitshonhvhi kehsehsti ikakathi.
iyuhskini hikhtholi uyo ikehsehsti, nikhv hiyelv'i ukhalitshonvhi'ikehsehsti ulihsihki.  iyuhskinino ikakathi hawini tsehv ulhsihkikwo ikehsehsti, nahski ulhsihki nika' ekwohiyu!

vlha khilo yeli anithali kvwanalha'i kohuhsti yitokvtvnhihsi, yi'ahskakayhenhoh sakwo yinvkeyuhanh hso'i o ale yito'uniyvha hsakwo yikanikwathihanoh so'i. lhahskini yeli unelhanvhi ale mamani kohuhsti' yitoketsatvnhihsi.

nahski iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha, lhehsti yitselihihskehsti tetsvnhv'i, iyuhsti itsikihstiyi ale iyuhsti itsatithahstiyi, lhehsti ale titsiyelv'i yitselihihskehsti iyuhsti titsanhuwohstiyi.  tlahsko akvnhv utlihiyu yiki ehskakwo alhstayvhti?  ale lhahsko ayelv'i ehskakwo tinhuwo?

titsakhanhvka tsihskwa kalvlo'i anehi, tlayenho yaniwhihsko'i, ale tla yaninetsa'ihsko'i, lha ale tatanelv yanilhihsihsko'i v ahsenho itsitota kalvlati ehi tokelhoho'i.  tlahsko nihi utli' yinetsilvkwoti ehskakwo nahski?
kakonho nihi tsinitsatvnhv utahsuya uwelihihskv'kwo yelih sakwo iyulhilotv yikhanehkwotsa kvnhv'i?
ale katonho tinhuwo totselihihsko'i?vi titsatanvthvli tsutsilvhi tlokehsi tsehi tathvhskv'i.  vlha yitunilvwhihstaneho'i v ale' vlha yanihstoho'i.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha i nahskwo hsolimanv nika'v nuwotuhsv'i lha nahski yinuhste tunhuwv'i hsakwo hi'a nuhstv'i.
i'yuhyenho unelhanvhi nahski yinikvneha yikhanhuwoha khanehska tlokehsi ehi, khohi ika tseha, ukitsvnhvnho tikathtiy wuntinvti tsiki, lhahsko utlihiyu yinitoketsinhuwotsa, uhsti itsohiyuhi?
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yitselihihskehsti hi'a yinitsiwehskehsti; kato tayotsiki, ale kahto tayotsatithahi, ale kato tayotsanhuwo'i?
nikatvyhenho nahski hi'a uniyhoho tsunathelenhvtv yvwi.av kalvlatihyenho ehi itsitota akhthaha nahski hi'a nikatv itsinikhvhsehv'i.
ikvyihskini itsiyhka kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ale utseli tuyukhtv'i, hianho nikatiyu tayetsinehkwo'eli.
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti ukitsvnhv iyvtv yiwitselihihskehsti, uktsvnhvyhenho uwahsv tsutalenhvtv tvtelihihsthani.  yelikwo uyo ika uwehv'i.
lhehsti tsitsatalhawhihseli nahskino nihi lhehsti etsilawhihselki.
nahskiyeno nuhstv itsatalhawhihselv ahse nahskwo tetsilawhihselihvi ale nuhstv itsatalhilosvlv nahskwo tv'etsalhilo'eli.
ale katonho ihikowahthihsko utlvtalvtv ukhsuhv'i tihstatanhvlhi, nelihskvnano ikehso unhohstv ata tsvhsv tsakhsuhv'i.
ale kato yikalhstohta hi'a yiniwehsi tihstatanhvlhi i kvlvhsi utlvtalvtv tsakhsuhv'ihv khvnhiyukwonho unhohstv ata tsvhsv tsakhsuha.
tsatlonahsti!  ikvyi hilv unhohstv ta htsvsv tsakhsuhv'i, nhahkwonho khvnhikehsvhiyu tsakowhahthvhtiyi kehsehsti hilvehtiyi utlvtalvtv tihstatanhvlhi ukhsuhv'i.
lhehsti kohuhsti kalvkwti kilhi titsinhelvki, lhehsti ale takvna-iyunahsti titsatselikah sikwa wititsatinelvki, yitanalahsta'vlikwohyenho, ale yanakhthahvna yvketsitakalv'vka.
itsithayoha, ahse tayetsineli v itsiyohka i ahse tatsiwhahthvhi; itsvnhka, ahse taytsihstu'i'eli.
khilohyenho tsathayohiho atsineho'i v khilonho tsuyhoho awhahthihsko'i, khilonho tsiwikvnhiho atsihstu'i'eho'i.
kakokhe ahskaya hi'a tsinitsatvnhv i iyunho uwetsi katu yuthayohseha, nvyakwoh yahvhsi?
ale atsati yathayohihahv tsiko inatvkwo yvkanv'vhsi?
iyunho nihi itsiyo'i yitsihsinahi ohstv kehsv titsinehtiyi titsetsiav utlihiyu utohiyuhiya itsitota kalvlati ehi ohstv tanhehehsti kvwathayohsehi.
nahski iyuhsti nika'v kohuhsti itsatulihskv yvwi iketsatvnhehtiy, nahskiya nahskwo nitetsatvnhehehsti; nahskihyenho hi'a nuhsti tikhanhahwtvhsti ale antolehohski
ayahtholhi kalohihstiyi itsiyvhsta ayhahtheniyhenho kalohihstiyi ale ayhahtheni nvnohi ayohuhihstiyi' wikananukokv'i, uni tsahthanho nanhahanilohska.
ayhahtholhiyuhyeno kalohihstiyi ale ayhahtholhiyu nvnohi kvnhitv wikananukokv'i, ale anikayolhiyu aniwhahthiha.
tetseyhahthotsehehsti unatlonahsti anatolehohski v awhi uninotena kaneka tsunanhuwa'i tsiketsiluhtseho'i; ahsenho hawini kehsv wayha unikhv'vhski kehso'i.
nuhstv anatathvhskv'i totatsolhihsthani. ahi tsiko yvwi thelvlati tanatehsko tsihstunikihstihi?  ale hsvkhtha-iyunahsti' tsikotsitsihi tanatehsko'i?
nahskihskini nuhsti nika'v ohstv tluhkv ohstv atathvhsko'i, uyonho tluhkv uyo atathvhsko'i.
ohstv tluhkv' vlha yeli uyo yvkvtathvka v ale uyo tluhkv' vlha yeli ohstv yvkvtathvka.
nika'vhskini tetluhkv ohstv nanatatvhskvna v tikaleyvhstohti kehsehsti, ale atsilvhyi witatinvti.
nahski' iyuhsti totatsolhihsthani' nuhstv anatathvhskv'i.
vtlayhenho nani'v i tsakvwiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhi, kvkwohsehi, kalvlati' ehi' ukvwiyuhi kesv wuninanuko'ihsti yiki, nahskihskini na etota kalvlati' ehi atanvhthehskv tsunilvwhihstanehi.

nahiyu ika kehsehsti unitsathihsti hi'a nvtakvkiwehali; tsakvwiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhi, tlahsko tetsato'v yotstihske yotsatolehohske'i? v ale lhahsko tetsato'v yotstihske anihskina yitotsinukowhihske'iv ai ale lhahsko tetsato'v yotstihske utsathi uhskwanikohti yitokilvwhihstanehe'i?
nhahkwonho hi'a nvtakatsiwehseli; vlha ilvhiyu yitsvkathahe'i; utli witsilohi uyo titsilvwhihstanehi.
nahski iyuhsti nani'v khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anatvkihskehsti, ale nahski nanatvnehehsti i akhthanhahi ahskaya totakatsiyatlilohsthani, nahski nvyohi tsunhehskehe'i;
nhahkwonho tsukanhahne'i, ale tsitunohukane'ihi ale tsunolvne'iai nanhahatanelv tsituyhilolhe'i; ahsenho vlha yuyotse'i v nvtsihiyhenho kakhahe'i.
nani'vnho khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anathvkihskehstiai nahskino nanatvnehvna ikehsehstihi uneku ahskaya tikekatlilohstohti kehsehsti nahski noyuhi tsunhehskehe'i.
nhahkwonho tsukanhahne'i, ale' tsitunohukane'iai ale tsunolvne'ivi nanhahatanelv tsituhyilolhe'i, ale tsuyotse'i, ale uhskastiyu tsinulhsthane uyotsv.
hiano nulhsthane'i v nahski tsihsa uhskwatv nahski nikawehskv'i a unihskwanikohse' tateyhohvhskv'i.
utselikayenho tsitateyhvhsko iyuhsti kehse'i, vlhanho tinowhelihskikwo tsitanateyhohvhsko iyuhsti yikehse'i.
nhahkwono tsukhso'ahsv uhsahilhv'ihv unitsathi kvwhstawatvhse'i.
ale kvnhiyukwo atayhehski utlvki uluhtse utatolihstanele'i, hi'a nuwehse'i; tsakvwiyuhiah iyunho yitsatanhthelv yelikwo yihskinvkalv.
tsihsanho utoyanvhitv uhsvnhile'iai katanvthvli, tsatanvkalvtv kehsehstiah uwohsele'i; khilakwonho iyvtv atayhehski utlvkv utanvkalvhe'i.
hi'anho tsihsa nuwehsele'i; kha tlehsti khilo tsihinonheli, henakwohskini, witsakowhahtv atsilv akelhohi, ale alhskolhtohti whihvka mohs unhetsv alhskohltohti naski unatlhhstti.
nhahkwono tsihsa kekwani wi'uluhtsvai uluhtshele ahskohikkwi aniyahwski tithinhitohi, uhstiyethane'i,
hi'a nuwehsele'i; tsakvwiyuhi v tsinvhsitahsti kanhka tikwenvhsv utlvka ulvtalv'vhska utsathanvhi akilhiyoka.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i; takehsi tatsinvwanehsi.
ahskohitskwinho tithinhitohi ti'unhetsv hi'a nuwehse'i; tsakvwiyuhi, lhayeli yiniko'i tsinelv tsayvhstiyi i hinhekikwohskini uwahsv, tsinvhsitahstinho tayutiwhsi.

ayvyhenho tikwatanelhtikwo v ale takikhah aniyahwski nahskih tekvkwanelhto'i, khilonho hena tsiyohsi, eko'i i nvwatalenho ehena tsiyohsi, ti'eko'iav tsinvhsitahstino, hi'a nhhatvka tsiyohsi v nahski natvneho'i.
tsihsanho uthvkanv uhskwanikohse'i i ale hi'a nituwehsele nvtakvwahstawatvtv, utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha, vlha nahskwo ihsili tuto'v nahski ika'i kohihyti kehsv yakiwahthvhv.
ale hi'a nitsvwehseha; unitsathi tikhalvkv ale wutelikv ititlv tinilohskehsti, ale itsulaha ananv'vhskehsti ekwahami, ale ehsiki, ale tsekkwi i kalvlati ehi nanhahukvwiyuhi kesv'i,
kalvlatihskini ehi nanhahukvwiyhi kee anehi taketsinukowihsi witotakekata'ehsi tsulhsihkv toyititlv i nanhahtaniyvhkehsti, ale tanilvtakihskehst taninhtohkv'i.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele ahskohitskwi tithinhitohiyv henahv ale nuhstv tsohiyunhv nahski winitsalhstahsi. i unvhsitahstino nahiyukwo utiwhse'i.
tsihsano kwita kanelv uluhtsv v ukohe kwita utali'i utsi'vhkanvhke utilhehvhske'i.
uhsvnhilenho uwoyeni i utilhehvhskvnho utiwhha'i.  tulenhenho ale tuhstelvhitole'i.
uhsvnho nulhsthanv, unitsathe anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwahthinhohele'i; tunukowhihsenho anihskina khanekvkwo khtihske'i, ale nikatv tsunitlvki tunhvwane'i.
utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsvki isahya atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'ihi uwahsv ikikihstanelvki titiwanakalahiyu kehsv'iav tekitlvkvnho tsutseli nituwanelvki.
tsihsanho tukohv unitsathi yvwi kvwatlatwihstihskv'i, unhetse' ihskonv wunilohihstiyi.
khilonho iyuhsti tikowhelihski uluhtse'i, hia nuwehsele'i; thateyhohvhski takvhstawatitoli nika'v hetohv'i.
tsihsanho hia nuwehsele'i; tsulha tunithalehso'i a tsihskwanho kalvlo' anehi tunanhehstalhaho'i i yvwihskini uwetsi' vlha ilvhtlv ahskholi uhtiy yiki.
nvwatalenho uhstawatitoh hi'a nuwehsele'i; tsakvwiyuhi, ikvyi kena tsinihsanhuka etota.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehale'i; skihstawatukaav unanelkinho tsuniyohuhsvhi taninihsihskehsti tsunatseli tsuniyohuhsvhi.
nhahkwono tsiyuh wutsanv kvhwstawatitohi kvwahstawatvse'i.
kvnhiyukwonho utsathi uhyilolhe unole itali; tsiyuhyeno ama talhstilhanekv uwulhv'vhske'i; ahsenho ikalhihekwo.
kvhwstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshele kvwayhehsthane'i i hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; tsakvwiyuhi, skihstelv, tayotsatsvnhikwo.
hi'ano ntuwehsele'i, katonho itsihska'iha? v uhsti' itsohiyuhi!  nhahakwono tulenhv tushkatse unole ale vtali, utsathinho utatshinahstvhi nulhsthane'i.
anihskayanho unihskwankohse'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i; kato uhsti hi'a ahskaya v nahskwoyhenho unole ale vtali ikvwohiyuhvhska.

hskontitlvnho' wuluhtsv kakisini unatselikohihi anithali anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwatlohse'i, tatanihsahv tsuninukotse'i v utsathanvhi' uninhahlvhiyu kese'ivi nahski' vlha khilo nanha hkvwalohihsti yikehse'i.
ale khvnhiyukwo unelhunhe'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i; vlha kohuhsti' tikatatvhtohti yiki nihi i tsihsa unelanvhi uwetsi, tsiko' anhi tsa'luhtshilv skinikilhiyo'ihstohtiyikwo ahsikwo nahskwalihskvna?
kehinho iyvtv tinetohe unitsathi sunatatlki hsihkwa analhstayvnhitohe'i.
anihskinanho kvwathayohsele'i, hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; iyunho skininukowhihsvha, unnelaki hskinelihselvha sihkwa hsuntalhuhki' wikohstiyvstiyi.

han nituwehsele'i; stena.  uninukotsvno, sihkwa hsunatalhki wituniyvlhe'i. v ale khvnhiyukwo nikatv sunatalhki hsihkwa ayanuliyu unalihse'iai wunikhso'ahse kanelhuhki kvhsv'iiv vtali wunalihthatinvhse'i, ale amayi tuniliwhotse'i.
tinikhthiyanho unalihse'i, tikatuhv wunilohsi, nikatv wuninhohelhe'i, ale anihskina kvwaniya'i nunalhstanhelv'i.
khvnhyukwonh nikatiyu skatuki tsuninukotse'i, tsihsa tekvwatlohsilhe'i; kvwakohnho kvwahthayohsele utanvhstiyikwo unatselikohi kehsv'i.
tsiyuhinho utsanv, tuwehsohtse'i, uwahsvnho uwetuhv wuluhtse'i.

kvnhiyukwonho kvwahthinhohele ahskaya utlvki ulvtalv'vhski kanhke atsehstokihi; tsihsano utolehohsv anohiyuhvhskv'i, hi'a nuwehsele ulvtalv'vhski; akwetsi, ukalhstiyukwo hatanhthata, tsahskanvtsv etsatoliki.
kvniyukwnho ikatv tinowhelihski' hi'a nuniwehse tunatanhthv'i; hi'a ahskaya kalvlati' ehi ahsotlv'ihstiha.
tsihsanho akhthahe' nuhstv anatanhthehskv'i, hianho nituwehsele'i i katonho uyo itsatanhtheha titsinawhiyi?
katokhe uhsti utli ahitiyu khane'ihstiyi, tsiko hi'a yinakawe'a, tsahskanvtsv etsatoliki?  hi'ake yinakawe'a, thalehvka ale hketa?
atina itsatolehohihstiyi yvwi uwetsi ahskanvtsv kvwatatolihsti kesv anhi' elohi, nhahkwo hi'a nuwehsele' ulvtalv'vhski; thalehvka, tsatsehsto hinaki, ale titsenvhsv hena.
tulenhvnho tsuwenvhsv wulohse'i.
unitsathinho unikohv, unihskwankohse'i, ale unilvkwthane unelhanvhi naski tsu'lhihskolhtanelvhi nahski iyuhsti tsunilvwhihstanetiyi yvwi.
tsihsano nanhahuta'nvhsv, ukohvki ahskaya matu tsuto'itv, uwolhvki ayelhi akhuyhtiyi.  hiano nuwehselvki; skihstawatuka.  tulenvnho uhstawatvhsvki.
hiano nulhsthanvki, kanvkv [alihstayvhvhskv] kalhtsote, kvniyukwo unitsathvki atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana uniluhtsv unanhtlvnvki aninvhtlhta'v tsihsa ale kvwhstawatitohi.
anikwalihsino unatolehohsv, hi'a ntu niwehselv kvwhstawatitohi; katonho' titseyohvhski atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana itsulaha ianalihstayvhvhska?
tsihsanho uthvkanv hi'a ntuwehselvki; nitunitlvkvna vlha utulhti yinunalhstaneho titanhvwihski, tsunitlvkihskini.

itsenahskini, witsatelhohkwa' katvkv hi'a nahski tsinikaweha; atatolihsti kehsv akwatuliha, vlhanho atsilv-kelhstiyinakesv'i.vv vtlayhenho nanihskanhvna yititsiyanvhilv, anihskanahskini tsuninetliyvhstiyi tunatanhthv'i.
nhahkwonho tsani kvhwstawatitohi [tsihsa] kvwaluhtselvki, hi'a nikvwawehselvki; katonho ayv anikwalihsino yano amalhi tsotsvhska, nihnho ketsstawatitohi amalhi nanvhskvna tsiki?

tsihsano hi'a ntuwehselvkihi tsiko yeli tekekatsvhstihskv anikhthahi yitanatloyhka ahsikwo utehsvnhilhvhi unhelatitohv'i?  ahsenho ika tvlhiyilolhi taketsiyanveli utehsvnhilhvhi, khila nhahkwo amalhi tvnvnhi.
vlha ale khilo itse' yikahlstlvtihsko' uwethi anhuwokihi, kalstlvtvhyeno yvkatsakalvta anhuwo, utatsakalvhvnho utli ekwohiyu yinikalhsta.

vlha ale itse kikake-atithahsti tsuwethi tihsutlvhtv yitanitlihstihsko'i; tihsutlvhtvyheno yitatatsakalv, ale kikake-atithahsti yatsewoki v tihsutlvhthvno yhitayoki.  itsehskini kikake-atithahsti titse tihsulhvhtv tanitlihstihsko'i, itsulanho tunihskwanikoto'i.

ahsikwo nahski nitekawehsehvki, kvniykwo khilo iyuhsti nukvwiyuhsateki uluhtsv utatolihstanelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki; akwetsi akeyhutsa kayula uyohuhsitena. v atina hena a hiyahsvnhilvha, aha tvatvnhitikwo.
tsihsanho tulenhv uhstawatvhsvki a ale nahskwo kvwhstawatitohi.
kvniyukwonho akeyhv utlvki kikv uwenvehi thalatu tsutethiyvta ikvwalhsthanvhi i onhititlv uluhihstanelvki v kataluyatv unhuwa'v uhsvnhelvki.
hiayheno nuwehse utanhthv'iav iyunho unhuwa'vkwo yakwsvnhilv, ahse yakwatiwhi.
tsihsanho ukhthahvsv ale ukohv, hia nuwehsvki; akwetsi i ukalhstikwo hatanhthata. i tsohiyuhsv tsatiwhihstaav i akeyhvnho nahiyukwo utiwhsvki.
tsihsanho nukvwiyuhsateki kanelv uluhtsv, ale tukohv tinitselhuhihski, ale yvwi taniyhkv'i,
hi'a ntuwehselvki; itsatanvna, nakonho uyohuhsvhi yiki akeyhutsa v kalhihakwohskini.  vkvwayetssthanvkwonho.
ketsinukowhsvnho' yvwi v uyvlhvki' uwoyeni uniyvhvki, akeyhutsano tulenhvki.
nahskino hi'a tunotsalhohtsitolv'i nanhahnikvnathv tuyhelihsitolvki.
tsihsanho nanhahutanvhsv, anithali tinikhewi anihskaya kvwhahstawa'tvhsvki, unelhuhkvki hi'a naniwehskvki, skinitoliki nihi tewi uwetsi.
kalhtsoteno uyvlhvhi tinikhewi kvwaluhtselvki, tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvkivi ihstohiyuhvhskahsko yeli nahski ikvkwatvntikikehsv'i?  hi'a nikvwawehselvki; vv, tsakvwiyuhi.
nhahkwono tuhsvnhelv tinikhtholi, hi'a nuwehsvki; nuhstv' ihstohiyuhvhskv nahskiya nihstalihstahsi.
tinikhtholinho tulhstukhsvki.  htsihsano tunvhstatelvki, hi'a ntuwehselvki; tlehsti khilo utolehohsvki.
ahsenho unatanvhsvkwo tuninotsalhanvki nanhhanikvnathvi.
nhahkwono aninukokv'i kvniyukwo khilo kvwhahthinohelvki' ahskaya uwakhewi, ahskina uya'i.
ahskinanho atsinukowhsv uwakhewi uwonisvki. v unitsathinho unihskwanikohsvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; vlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti akohvhi yiki' ihsiliyi.
ahsenho anikwalihsi hi'a nuniwehsvki; anihskina unatseli ukvwiyuhi kvhtiha tsitekanukowhihska anihskina.

tsihsanho nika'v tsuthvna tekatuhv ale tsusti tekatuhv uwetolvki, tateyhohvhskvki tsunilawihstiyi, ale alhtsitohvhskvki ohstv khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehskvki, ale' tekhanvwihskv nika'v tunitlvkv ale nika'v vyhuki yvwi unihyi'litehv'i.
tkhn unitsth ywi, twtolitsvki, utakalhstohtihskvki wanakwo tanilokv'i, ale unatikaleyotsvhi kehsv'iav nahskiya awhi uninotena nehvna tsikehso unikhthiya.
nhahkwo hi'a ntuwehalv kvwhstawatitohi; ekwohiyu tlokehsi ukhthvnatsvhi, ahsenho anikayolhiyu tsunilvwhihstanehi.
nahski iyuhsti etsithayohsi uloketv tsunvhstiyi' tsunilvwhihstanehi ukahthvnatselvhi.
wituyhanvhvnho thalatu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohihv tunhelv anihskina tsuninukowhihstiyivi ale tsunatanhvwotiyi nika'v tunitlvkv v ale nika'v vyuki.
hianho nahski nuhsti tunato'v thalatu iyanitv ketsinvhsitv.  ikvyiyi sawani kwita tsanohseho'i i enitinho nahskikwo unhvlhi, tsiminho tsekwiti uwetsi i tsaninho nahskikwo unhvlhi.
kwilikinho, watalamino, taminho v matunho atelv akihsitohihi tsiminho elikwi uwetsiai lekwiyano tatiya tsanohseho'i,
sawaninho akenaniti, tsutahsinho ihskalati nahski tsihsa tsulonuhelhvki.
nahski hi'a thalatu iyanitv tsisa tunvhsvki tunhetselvnho hia nituwehselvki v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tinehv ititlv lhehsti witsilohsvki, aleh sameli anehi tunituhv lhehsti itsiyvlhvki
awhihskini unalenahitv ihsili sitanelv kehsv titsiwhahthvhuka.
itsa'ihsvno itsalihtsitohvhskehsti, hia nitsiwehskehsti; kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhiyikehsv ehskanhiyu taya'i.
tsunitlvki tetsinhvwihskehsti v atayhehski tsunitlvki tetsinvkalihskehsti, tsuniyohuhsvhi tetsaletihskehsti, anihskina tetsinukowhihskehsti. v ahsekwo etsinelvhi, ahsekwo itsatanhehehsti.
lhehsti tetsatatlohv yitsatanelhehsti talonike atelv ale unekv atelv ale vtsayi,
ale tekalhti, ale thali' titsanhuwo, ale tilahsulo, ale titolanvhstihi tsulvwhihstanehihyeno uwhahthvhti kehso ulhstayvhti.
ilvhtlvnho uthvna katuhv ale uhsti katuhv itsiluhkehsti v itsatatvtvhvhskehsti khilo' ehv utanhthihi nanhahnho itsinehsti khvnhi vtsanhiki.
atanelvnho itsiyvha itsiyolihehsti.

iyunho nanhahaninela uwhthohiyatv tikvwntanilv'ihsti ikehsehsti, nahski uwhthohiytv itsatseli uniluhtseti kehsehstihi iyunho tikvwantanilv'ihsti nikehsvna ikehsehsti v nahski nvhwthohiyatv' itsvhsvkwo itsiluhtseti ikehsehsti.
iyunho khilo nititsatanilvkvna ikehsehsti v ale itsinhekv nathvkihskvna i'kehsehsti, nanhahkalhtsote ale katuhv' itsinukoki, tetsinvkovhtihskehsti kata ttslstn.
uthyhy ha nitsvywehseha, ehskakwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti sotami ale komali, tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti, utlihiyu nahski na katuhv'i.
kvnhiyukwo itsvnvli awhi uninotena tsanhelatitoho wayhohi nahskiya'i; nahski' iyuhsti inatv iketsihsinahsani kehsahsti, ale kule-tinihskonhihi iketsatanhthi kehsehsti.
tetseyhahthotsehehsti atin yvwi v tekalawi'vhyenho totaketsathinholhi v tsunilawihstiyinho totaketsili'vnhili.
ale ayv kehsv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti nunikvwiyuhsateki ale unikvwiyuhi tunolhv ikvyititlv tetsathinhohihehsti, nahski unvhsv ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi unatolehohihstohti.
ahsenho nhahkwo teketsathinohihehsti lhehsti yitselihihskehsti iyuhsti itsine'ihstiyi ale itsiwehstiyi; nahiyukwohyeno etsinehti kehsehsti itsiwehstiyi.
vtlayhenho nihi yitsinheko'i v itsitotahskini utanhto khaneko'i nihi' itstihsko'i.
ahskayanho totayuyohsi uyohuhihstiyi tinatanhvlhi, akayvlikenho uwetsi' totayuyohsioi ale onhi tsunathvhsvhi totvnatluthani' tsunikayvlike'i, ale nahski nvtvnvnhihsahni tiketsi'ihsti kehsehsti.
ale nani'vkwo yvwi' ketsihskaki kehsehsti ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti; ahsenho nahski kvlhskwatihski alhinikvnehi atsihstelvhti kehsehsti.

ale nhahkwo uyo niketsvnhahtekehsti ilvhtlv katuhv'i v ilolihskehsti nvwalile tikatuhv witsilohskehsti.  utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha, vlha ihsiliyi tekatuhv'i yiketsetonhehsti nhahkwo yvwi uwetsi taka'luhtsi.
titelokwahski vlha utli yinatsilvkwotho'i ehskakwo tsuweyhohvhskiai ale atsinvhsitahsti' vlha utli hyinatsilvkwoto'i svhskakwo unvhsitohi.

yelikwoyheno titelokwahski tsuweyhohvhski itsulahakwo yiki, ale atsinvhsitahsti unvhsitohi itsulahakwo yiki. i iyuyhenho tsutathinhahi atanelv kwelitsikwa yunohselv, utli ahitiyu nahski itsuniwehsetiyi tutathinhahai.
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yititsihska'ihehsti.  vtlayhenho kohuhsti' yikvhskalha nahski kvnikehsv iyulhstohti nikehsvna kehsv'i, vlha ale kohuhsti utelitv yiki nahski atolehohihsti nikehsvna kehsv'i.
lsik itsvnetselv'i ikakathv itsi nekehsti; etsatonv'elvnho kehsv kahsanali itsalhtsitohvhskehsti.
ale lhehsti yititsihskaihehsti ayelv'i anihihioi ahsenho atanhto kvwahnihsti nikesvna tsiki. i ukvwiyuhsehstihskini etsihska'ihehsti nahski tikvwahihsti tsiki ayelvi ale atanhto itsula tsvhskinhohi.
tlahsko anitha'li tsihskwayah sakwo iyatanhtheti tsunakvwalhti yiki, ahseno' vlha hsakwo elati unv'ihsti yiki itsitota' utanhthelhvhi nikehsvna.
nahskwohskini' itsihsthiyehkv itsihskholi nikatiyu tihselhvhi.
nashki' iyuhsti lhehsti yitsihskaihehstihi utliyhenho nika'v titsakvwalhti nihi' ehskakwo unitsahthi tsihskwaya.
khiloyhehno khvnhikehsv nakwvnehehsti yvwi anikhthahv'i i nahskwo ayv nahski khvnikehsv utatsiyvneli etota kalvlati ehi akhthahv'i.
khilohskini iakwatahyihehsti yvw anikhthahv'i, nahskwo ayv nahski tatsiyatayili etota kalvlati ehi akhthahv'i.
lhehsti thohiyi unanukowihsilhv elohi, yihskiyelihsehehsti i vtlahskini thohiyi yakinanukowhihsilhv, ayelhstihskini kanvhitv.
ayvyhenho aki'luhtsilhv a tinatahskaki iyulhstohtiyi ahskaya utotanho, ale akanvki akeyhv utsinho v ale utatsohiya utsohinho;
khilonho uwahsvkwo tutathinhahv kvwahskaki kehsehsti.

khilon utli nukeyuhsehsti utota ale utsi ehskakwo ayv nakikeyuhsehstiav vtla yeli nahski' ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti.  khilono utli nukeyuhsehsti uwetsi ahskaya ale uwetsi akeyhv ehskakwo ayv nakikeyuhsehsti, vlha yeli nahski' ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti.
khilo nayihskvna ikesehsti utseli tsutanhahawatv ale nakhstawatekvna ikehsehsti, vlha yeli ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti.
khilonho kvnhv iawhahthihskehsti, nahski uyohuhsehti kehsehsti; kilono' iuyohusehehsti kvnhv ayv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, nahski uwhahthvhti kehsehsti.
khilonho tetsatanilvkehsti, nahski ayv takwatanilvkehsti; khilonho' ayv takwatanilvkehsti, nahski tatanilvkehsti nvtvkinvhsvhi

khilonho tatanilvkehsti atolehohski' atolehohski kehsv utikalhstohtikehsti, atolehohski akkuyvtahnti kehsv nahski akakuyvtnehehsti; khilonho tatanilvkehsti utanhthi ahskaya utanhthi kesv tikalhstoh tihskehsti, utanhthi ahskaya akakuyvtahnti kesv nahski akakuyvtnehehsti.

khilonho sakwo hi'a tsunhsti kesvi ulihskwitikwo akhali'i uyhvtlatama hhu'vhskehsti akhstawatitohi kesv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, utohiyuhiya nitsvwehseha i vlha nahski uyohuhsehti yikehsehsti akakuyv'ehti kehshv'i.
hi'anho nulhsthanvki; tsihsa uhskwa'tv tekhanetsehv thalatu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi, unhikihsvki nanhahani, tuteyhohuhsvki ale ulhtsitonvhsvki tunitunhahai.
nhahkwonho tsani tsatsihstuhv tsuthvkanv nuhstv tulvwhihstanehv kalonetv i totsunvhse anitha'li kvwhstawatitohi,
ha nvtayuwehselvki; nihihsko na uluhihsti' tsiki, tsikokhe nvwtale otsikathenohehsti?
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; tsihstena tsani' wi'ehstinohvhsi nika'v ihstatvkihskv'i ale ihstikowhahthihskv'i:

tinikhewi anikowahthihaai tiniyo'ulhinho anetoha i atayhehski tsunitlvki tunatiwhska v tsunili'enanho anahthvkiha i tsuniyohuhsvhino tekekaletiha uyonho iyunatvnhahteki ohstv khanohetv ikekalitsitonheha.
ale ohsiyu iyulhstanhehti khilonititsiyotehstihskvna ikehsehsti.
i'unenvnho tsihsa ulenvhvki hiah hni'tuwehselvki unitsathi tsani tunohehtanelvki; kato itsakhthanhvhse inake'i?  wahsonahsko unole uthelvhehskv'i?
katokhe itsakhthanhvhse'i?  ahskayahsko tiwanake tsunhuwa'i?  kvnhiyukwo tiwanake tsunanhuwa'i unikvwiyuhi taninelv aneho'i.
katokhe' itsakhthanhvhse'i?  atolehohskihsko?  v'v, itsvyohseha, ale utlihiyu ehskakwo atolehohski.
nahskihskini hi'a' na kekowhelv hia hatsinohehlskv tsinikvnhv i kvnhiyukwo, tsinvli tsinvhsitahsti tsakhathv ikvyititlv, nahski tatsatvnv'ihstaneli tsalohihstiyi ikvyititlv.

utohiyuhya hi nitsvwehseha, anikeyhv kvwninnukowhihsvhi tsiki vlha khilo yunanukotsv kvwtalinehitehti tsani titawohski; ahseno uhstikhani kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo tsani'.
tsaninho titawohski unanukotsv nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ananeluki'eha, ananelukihskinho kvhskahstaki taniniyiha.
nani'vyhenho anatolehohski ale tikhanhahwatvhsti anatolehohskvki tsani unanukotsilv iyahsthi.
iyunho tiketsatanilv'ihsti kehsehsti, nhski hi'a ilaya uluhihsti' tsikehsvki.
khilo tekaliluhkehsti uthvkotiyi nahsk athvkihskehsti.
katokhe totakatsiyatlilohsthani hiahikhohi tsaneha?  tiniyolhikwo nahskiya kanhtohtiyi tsanino'i ale tsiwitaniyanihsko unetahstiyi
al ha tsinitaniwesehi; atseluhki okvhthanv ttsvnokilv, ahsehno' vtl yitsalhihskisv; ttsykvk hthsatvkti, seno vtla yitihtsatloyilhv.
tsaniyeno ulhtsvki vlha yalistayhski ale vtl ytithski, hsenho nanweh; skin uya.

yvwiviu'wehtsihsulu'tsvuwalihstahyvhvhska ale atithahskahv hi'anho ni'aniwehaai kvniyukwo ahskaya ukhv'vhski alhstayvhti ale kikake-atithahsti a atelv anikihsitohi ale anihstena unali'i.  ahsenho akhthanhahi tsuwetsi ohsiyu ikvwayelvha.
nhahkwonho ulenvhvki tukvhskolvnvki tunituhv'i nanhahutli' ika'i uhskwanikhti tulvwhihstanelv'i, nvtakalhstohtihskvki tunatanhthv nituninetliyvhsvna kesv'i.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti kolehsini i uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti kwetsayiti v iyuyhenho uhskwanikhti tekalvwhihstanelv nihi' itsehv yitokalvwhihstanele thaya ale satoni v kohiki tikvwaninetliyvtv yikehse tunatanhthv'i v tsuhsihthena yitunanhuwo'e ale kohstu yunatanvliye'e'i.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; ehskakwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kesehsti thaya ale hsatoni v tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti i utlihiyu nihi.
nihino kekwani kalvlati iyvtv tsetsahsalata, tsvhskinhohi wvtayelo'vhthani; iyuhyenho uhskwanikti tekalvwhihstanelv nihi' itsehv yitokalvwhihstanele sotamiyi i ahsi khohi kehsv yinikvwhstekwo.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; ehskakwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti hsolimi tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsehsti v utlihiyu nihi.
nahiyu tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki; kvyali'elitseha etotahi tsakvwiyuhi kalvlati ale elohi v nahskinihiaehtsitehvhskalanelv anihsinahsani ale aneyhahthahi, tiniyolhinho tsitehinanukowhihselv.
v, ett, nahskiyhenho ohsiyu tsayelvnhvhi.
nika'v kohuhsti takiyohihselv etota, ale' vtla khilo yakhthaha uwetsi utotakwo uwahsv; vlha ale khilo yakhthaha akayvlike'i uwetsi uwahsvsi khilono nahski tsinanukowhihsi ela uwets.
etsenavv ayvh skiluhtsi i nikatiyu akilhiya titsilvwhihstanhi,tsale kahktv titshlisehi, ayno tatsvyawesolvhsthahni.
itsiyv akwakilhanalo aleihskiyatelhohkwahsi, akwatanhthiyuyheno ale akwatatolihstiyu akinawiyi, tatsiwhahthvhino titsatanhto tsuyawehsolvhstiyi.
akwakilhanaloyheno nuhihsohtvna, kalihsehvnho utahsahkhahiyu.
nahiyu tsihsa a'ihsvki awhihsv utsalehsti unatotakwahskv ikaai kvwahstawatitohino akonu tuniyohsihskvki, ale unalenvhvki unihskutesvki utsalhehsti ale unihstikvki.
ahsenho anikwalihsi unatolehohsv hi'a nvkvwawehselki; khvnhiyukwo ikvtvneti nikehsvna unatotakwahskv ika nanatvne ketsahstawatitohi.
ahsenho hi'a nituwehselvki; lhahsko yitsikoliye'o tewi nutvnelv akonu tsuyohsihske, ale nahski' anehi,
unelanvhi utseli atanelv tsuyvlhe'ihv ale akahtohti katu tsuke'i, yeli' kvwakihsti nikehsvna tsikese'i, ale nahski anehi, atsilvhskini-anelhohi unvhsv?
lhahsko nahskwo yitsikoliye'o tikhanhahwtvhsti'yi nahski unatotakwahskv ika uthvna tikathawihstiyi atsilv-anelhohi unatotakwahskv aniyohstihskv, ale unihskanvtsvhi nikehsvna kesv'i?
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha v anhi etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo uthvna tiklawi'ihstiyi.
yitsikhtho'vhsehskini kathkv hi'a nahski tsinikaweha, atatolihsti kehsv akwatuliha, vlhanho atsilv-kelhstiyi kesv'i, vlha unihskanvtsvhi' yitoketsiyelvnhe nunihskanvtsvna.
yvwiyhno uwetsi ukvwiyuhi nhskwo unatotakwahskv ika.
nanhahn iutanvsv, tsunilawi'ihstiyi wuyvlhvki.
kvnhiyukwonho etohvki ahskaya uwoyeni uwa'ihselvhi.  kvwahtvtvnhvkinho hi'a nuniwesvkiva tsiko yelikwo kvtanhvwoti unatotakwahskv'i; kvwayhi'litahstiy unatulihskvki.
hiano ntuwehselvki; tsiko ahskaya utahsuya' itsehv'i i iyunh sakwo awhi unotena yunalha'a, athalehsvnho yulvtsv unatotakwahskv'i, nahski wuniyhti ale wulehsti nikehsvna?
nika'vhskini utlihiyu atsilvkwotiyu yvwi ehskakwo awhi unotena.av nahskihskini iyuhsti yelikwo ohstv tikalvwhihstahnti unatotakwahskv ika.
nhahkwonho hi'a nuweselv ahskaya; hatoyanvhita; utoyhanvhitvkinho.  ale utiwhhsvki, nahskiyalhso'i nuhstv nulhsthanvki.
nhahkwonho anikwalihsi uninukotsv uninhohelv iyunvnhtiyi unhstiyi.
ahsenho tsihsa utolehohsv nanhahutanvhsvki; unitsathinho kvwhahstawatvhsvki; ale nikatv tunhvwanvki,
ale tunvhstatelv khvnikehsv' ikvwanhtiyi.
utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsvki ihsaya atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i;
kvniyukwo tsinvhsitahstihv tsiyahsuyetv tsikeyui tikwatanhtv iyvtv ohstv tsiyelv'i; tatsineli akwatanhto, ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tuyukhtv' tsunnukohwsehti kehsesti.
vlha tsuthiyohsti ale uwelhuhti yikehsehsti, vlha ale khilo uthvkanehti yikehsehsti khanekv tekalanvtv'i.
wahsona' uyehthawotsvhi vlha tsuhskwalhsti yikehsehsti, ale tholetv tsukhsvhsti vlha uhwtlattihsti yikehsehsti, khvnhi atalinehitonhvha tuyuhktv' kesv tayelihihstihskv'i.
ale tuto'v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi analihskahstohtihskehsti.
nhahkwono akathinhohelvki' ahskina uya'i tikhewi ale uwakhewi, ale unhvwanvki; nahskino tikhewi ale uwakhewi uwonihsvki ale ukohvki.
nikatvno yvwi unihskwanikohsvkivi hi'a nuniwehsvki; tlahsko hi'a tewi uwetsi yiki'?
ahsenho anikwalihsi unathvkanv i hi'a nuniwesvki; hia' vlha anihskina yitikanukowhihska khvnhi tsuhstelihsko' kwelitsikwa ukvwiyuhi anihskin unatselika.

ale tsihsa akhthahv nuhstv anatanhthehskv'i, hi'a nituwehselvki; nika'v ayelhi kolhvhsi tha'li tsinatatihsko uwahsvkwo tsatatlutihsko ayokokwo; ale nika'v katuhv ale atanelv tha'li tsinatatihsko uwahsvkwo tsatatlutihsko vlha yinikvwahstokwo.
iyu ale hsetani setan yikanukohwihska, tha'li natatihsko'i uwahsvkwo atatlutihsko'i; katonho yikalhstohta yinikvwhstikwo utselikohi?
iyunho' ayv kweltsikwa yakhsteli ahnskina yittsinukowihska, kako unihstelihsko titsetsi tsitaninukowhihsko'i?  nahskihskini tiketsukhtanehi kehsehsti.
iyuhskini ayv unelhanvhi utanhtho yikvti anihskina' yititsinukowhska, nhahkwohskini kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv' itsiluhtselv.
ale kato yatvka kl ulhinikitv ahskaya' kanelv yayvha ale unhahv yawonv, iyuno' ikvyi nulhvlvna yiki nahsk ulhinikitv ahskaya? i khila nhahkwo yawonv kaneli unhahai.
khilo nakwalikonhehvna, nahski akwatlutiha; khilon nohstilhihsihskvna, nahski yatikaleyahska.

nahski' iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha; nika'v nutalehsv ahskanv'ihsti kesv' ale ahsotlvhtohti kesv' ketsitolihstikwo kehsehsti yvwi; kalvkwtiyuhskini atanhto ahsotlvtohti kehsv vlha ketsitolihsti yikehsehsti yvwi.

ale khilo kawonihskv atlutihskehsti yvwi uwetsi, atsitolihstikwo kehsehstihi khilohskini kawonihskv atlutihskehsti kalvkwtiyu atantho, vlha atsitolihsti yikehsehsti kohi kehshv ale nahskwoh so'iyi tikehsv'i.
lhkv ohstv nitsvka uthvnho ohstv, ale tluhkv uhsonhv nitsvka uthvnho uhsonv'i; tluhkvyheno' kolhihstohti kehso' nuhstv utv'i.
yo' inatv tsunetsi nihi!  tsinitsiyo'iyv kato yikalhstohta ohstv yitsiwonihi?  utsathvyeno onawhiyi wehi vholi kawonihsko'i.
ohstv yvwi, ohstv uhskwanikotv unawiyi, ohstv kananukowhihsko'ihi v uyonho yvwi, uyo uhskwanikotv uyo kannkowhihsko'i.
hianho nitsvwehseha; nika'v uyo aniwonihskv yvwi, uninoheti kehsehsti tikukhthohtiyi ika kesv'i.
hihnekvyhenho tsatutalehstohti kehsehsti v ale hinekv tsahskanvtsv titsatukhtaneti kehsehsti.
nhahkwonho khilo iyunahsti tinowelihsk ale anikwalihsi uninehtsv, hi'a nuniwehsvki; thateyhohvhskiav uyelhthv okatuli itsvkowhahthvehtiyi.
unhetsvno hi'a nituwehselvki; kohi tsaneha uniyo ale tinatayhonehi uyelhtv uniyhoho'i; ahsenho uyelvhtv vlha ketsinehti yikehsehsti, tsona atolehohski utselika uyelhtv uwahsv.
tsonahyenho tso'i' ika ale tso'i hsvnoyi atsa'ti' ekwa uhskwolhiyi tsaya'e'i i nahskwohskini yvwi uwetsi tso'i ika a'le tso'i hsvnoyi katohi hawin aya'ehsti.

yvwi' niniwi tsanehvki totvnalenhi takvwanatluthani kohi tsaneha, tikukhtotiyhi ika kesv'i, ale uhnskanvtsv khvnikehsv utvnvneli a nahskiyheno tunatanhvtv tuninetliyvhsvki tsona alhtsitohvhskv nuwanhihsanhvki i khvnhiyukwonho ani' etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo tsona.

ukvwiyuhi' akeyhv' tsukanawv tsehe'i totvlenhi tayunatluthani kohi tsaneha tikukhthohtiyi ika kehsv'ivi ale unihskanvtsv khvnikehsv nvtakvneliav nahskiyhenho katohi wahsthv iyvtv tsuwenvhse uthvkanilhe solimnv akhthanhahiyu kehsv'i, kvniyukwonho anhi' etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu' ehskakwo hsolimonv.
iyuno kataha atanhto yvwihi kanuko'i, ukhayotvhi etoho'i uyawehsolvhstiyi uyhoho'i, ahsenho' vlha yawhahthihsko'i.
nhahkwono hi'a nikawehsko'i; titsinelv tikinukotsv yvtvtsilohsi.  nhahkwono wika'luhki awhathihsko uhsiwha kehso' ale kvnohsatvhi ale kotu'ihsto'i.

nhahkwnho' i'eki witayhanihsko uwanatale kalhkwoki' anihskina utli iyuninekutshitv ehskakwo uwahsv, nanhahno aniyvhiho'i ale ananelatihsko'i, onhino nuhstv na ahskaya utli uyo'iyu kehso'i ehskakwo ikvyiyi.  nahskihskini nunstehsti kohi uninekutsitv tsaneha.
ahsikwo tekawonetihskv yvwi i kvnhiyukwo utsi' ale analinvtli toyitlv anitona'vki, unatulihskvki kvwalhinohehtohtiyi.
khilonho hi'a nuwehselvkiai kvnhiyukwo tsatsi ale itsalhinvtli toyi anitona'a, ketsalinohehtohtiyi unatuliha.
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehselv unhohnelhvhi; kako etsi? i ale kako otsalhinvtli?
wituhsonnho kvhwstawatitohi hi'a nuwesvki; kvnhiyukwo etsi ale otsalhinvtli.
khiloyhenho natvnehehsti nuhstv utulihskv etota kalvlati ehi, nahski vkhinvlhi ale vkito ale etsi.
nahiyu ika tsihsa unukotsvki atanelv'ivv ale vtalulhti uwenhvki.
unitsathin yvwi kvwatalhuwhihsthanvki, nahski iyuhsti tsiyuhi utsanvki v ale uwenhvki. v nikatiyunho' nahski unitsathi amayulhti anitona'vki.
te'uwonhthanvnho utsathi tsutalenhvtv tulhilohstanelvki'e hi'a nuwehshvki; kvnhiyukwo, awhihski uwhihsvhse'i.
uwhihsvnho ikatv nvnohulhti ulakeyatvtse'i, tsihskwanho uniluhtse ale unuthihsonhe'i.
ikatvnho nvyohi kehsv ulakeyatvtse'ihv kayolhi kata' kalakeyv'i, khilakwonho iyvtv ulhiyenhe'iav nvtikalhstohtihske sake'iyu kehsv kata.
ahsenho nvto tsukhalvtsv uleyvhse'i, nitunhahstetlvnanho kehsv iyuhsti unhahskvtsekwo.
ikatvnho anukalhvhi ulakeytvtse'i i anukalhvnho tsuthvhs unenulahsthane'i.
ikatvhskini ohsv katohi ulakeytvtse'ivv nahskino ukhthathane'i, ikatv ahskohitskwi unhehkwotse'i, ikatvnho hsutalahskohi unehkwotse'ihv ikatvnho tso'ahskohi unhehkwotse'i.
khilo tekaluhkehsti uthvkotiyi wahthvkvka.
kvwahstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshelv hi'a nikvwawehselvki v katonho tehiwonhtihskv tsitehalhilohstaneha?
unhetsvnho hi'a nituwehselvki; nvtikalhstohtihskini nihi etsinelvhi kehsv' itsolhihstiyi utelitv kehsv kalvlati' ehi ukv wiyuhi kehsv'i, navhskini vlha kekalihskoltanelvhi yiki.
khilohyenho uhehsti atsinehti kehsehsti, utsathinho uhehsti; khilohskini nuhvna kehsehsti atsiki'ehtikwo kehsehsti nahski nskw hi.
nahski nvtikalhstohtiha tsitekatsiyatlilohstaneha v anikowhahthihskvyhenho vlha yinahthkiha al vthla yinholika.

ale anehv utohiyunhv ihsaya tsutolehohse'iki hi'a tsinuwehse'i'i itsathvkihskv itsathvkihskehsti, ahsenho vlha yitsolhkehsti v ale itsikowhthihskv itsikowhahthihskehsti' v ahsenho vlha yitsatolehohskehsti.

hiayhenho yvwi tsuninawhi tulitsohvhsv, ale tanililuhkv kayolhiyu tathvkiha, ale tinikhtholi tunihstunhvav nahski tinikhthol tikvwanikowahthvhtohti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi, ale tanilihlkv tikvwnathvkottinikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi, ale tsuninawhi tikvwanolhihstohti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi, ale tikvwanatanetliyv'ehti nikehsvna tunatanthv a ale tikaktsinvwoti nikehsvna iyulhstohtiy.
nihihskini titsikhtholi tikalvkwthanvhi, nahskiyno takowhthiha, ale tetsilihlkv'i v nahskiyenho tathvkiha;

utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha, unitsathi anatolehohski ale unatanhthi unatulvtv utsikowahthvtiy hia nahski tsitsikowahthihavv ahsenho vlha unikohvhi yiki; ale unathvkotiyi hi'a nahski tsitsatvkiha, ahsenho' vlha unathvkanvhi yiki.
nahski iyuhsti' nihi itsathvkvka talhilohsthv awhihski.
iyuno khilo athvkvka khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvnayuhi kehsv ukvwalhiav nikolhkvnanho tsikehso'i, nhahakwo unekutsitv ka'luhko'i ale uki'eho awhihsv unawhiyi.  nahski hi'a unohulhti tsawhihse'i.
hi'anho nahski nvyohi tsawhihse'ihsi nahski tsatvkihsko khanohetv, ale khilakwo iyvtv ulihelitsvhi tsitatanilvko'i;
ahsenho nitunhahstetlvnakwo kehso'iav ale lhekakwo tsitakhanhahwateko'i; akilhiyvyheno kananuko'i ale khanohetv tvlhiyilvhsta akateyahthohta, khilakwo iyvtv tuwotehiho'i.
hi'anho nahskwo anukalhvhi tsawhihse'i, nahski tsatvkihsko khanohetv, elohnho uwelihihsti kehsv ale kenhv'ihsti kesv utalitahstv aninenulahstihsko khanohetv, nahskinho nakhthathvhskvnakwo kehso'i.

nahskihskini' na ohsv katoh tsawhihse'i; nahski tsathvkihsko khanohetv ale tsikolhko'i, ale nahskwo tsakthathvhsko'i, ale tsikananukowhihsko'i, ikatv ahskohitskwi unhehkwotsvhi, ikatvnho hsutalahskohihv ikatvnho tso'ahskohi.
nvwatale tulhilohstanelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki; kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo ahskaya ohstv ukhtha ulokehsv tsuwhihse'i.
ahsenho yvwi unilhinvtsv, uhskaya uluhtse' uyo' ukhtha uwhihse utsalehsti awhihsv uhsuyvne'i; ale i'uwenvhse.
nhahkwonho ulhiyenhv ale ukhthathanv nahskwo uyo unanukotse'i.
nhahkwonho ahskayahs kanela tsunvhsitahsti kvwaluhtsele'i, hi'a nikvwawehsele'i; skinvhsitahsti, tlahsko ohstv ukhtha yitsawhihse tsalokehsv'i?  kato tikalhstohtaha uyo tsuyhehka?
hian hnituwehsele'i; khilo akhskaki nahski nutvnelv.  tsunvhsitahsti hi'a nikvwahsele'iav tsatulihskon okiyhehihsvhstiyi?
ahseno hia nuwehse'ihv vlhahi itsiyehihskvyhenho uyo, yitetsinhahahstetlvhta nahskwo utsalehsti.

unelaki ikulaha witathvhi khvnhi' akhthvnatsvha; nhahkwonho akhthvnatsv hi'a nvtakatsiwehseli anihskutehski a ikvyi itsilhihsa uyo, ale titsohthvtsa tikohvhstohti, utsalehstihskini itsilhihsa akihskwankohttiy.
nvwatale tulhilohstanelvkihi hia nuwesvki v kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo atsilv ukhtha, ahskaya tsukihse ale tsuwhihse ulokehsv'i.

nahski utohiyuhsv tsiwotakonatti uhstikhiyu kesvh nika'v ukhtha'a ahsenho athvhi tsiwotakonatti uthvniyu kehsv nika'v uyenhahai, ale tluhkv tsinikalhstiha, nahskinho tsihskwa tsaniluhko'i, tuwanikalhv tsanahatihsko'i.
nvwatale tulhilohstanelvki, hia nuwohsvki a kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo akotohti, nahski akeyhv tsukihse ale tsuhsuyvne tso'i iyulhilotv ihsv kalhv'i, khvnhi nikatv ukohsonhv.
nahski hi'a nikatiyu tsihsa tuwonhthanvki unitsathi tulhilohstanelvki, nitalhilohstanehvnanho kesv vlha yituwonhthane'i.
utohiyutiyi ayelvhsvki atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i a tatsihstu'ihsi tsi'oli tekatlilohstihskv'i v tatsineihsthani utelitv ahskwanikotv elohi tsutolhvnhv nvtakvwatalenvtv.
nhahkwono tsihsa tuyelihsthanv unitsathi, atanelv wuyvlhvki; kvwhstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshelvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; tihskiyohsihsasi talhilohsthv uyo tsulhiyenhe tlokehshi.
unhetsvnho hi'a nituwehselvki i nahski na ohstv ukhtha tsuwhihse'i nahski yvwi uwetsi;
tlokehsinho nahski' elanikhv'i; ohstv ukhtha nahski kalvlti' ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv anehi; uyonho tsulhiyhne nahski' unekutsitv tsuwetsi;
akaskinho nahski tsuwhihse'i, nahski ahskina; ukhthvna'ihstiyinh kesv nahski alhskwatvha elohi; anihskutehskinho naski tinikhanhahwatitohi.
nahskinho uyo tsanilhihsihsko ale tsanakohvhstihsko' atsilvyi, nahskiyahskini nahskwo nuhstehsti alhskwatvha hi'a elohi.
yvwi uwetsi totakanvhsi tsutseli tinikhanhahwatitohi, ale nahski utselikohi totvnotsalehsi nikatv tinatatotehstihski ale nikatv anihskanvki,
tikolhvhsvnho atsilvyi witotvna'ta'ehsivi nanhahtaniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhtohkv'i.
nhahkwonho unatanhthi kvwanithalukihski kehsehsti unitota utselikohi a nvto nahskiya'i o'i khilo tekalilkehsti uthvkotiyhi wathvkvka.

ale nahskwo kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv nahskiyakwohv tsukvwalhti' utelitv tlokehsi tsaho'i, nahski iyu ahskaya awahthv, tsatelhvhsko'i v alihelikvnho iyuhsthi tseki tsiwikanateko nikatv uhskwanhikotv'iav ale tsiwuwhahsko' nahski tlokehsi.
ale hnskwo kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv nahskiyakwo kanohtihski tsituyhohe tsuwotuhi takvna-iyunahsti.
nahskinho nhahkwo uwhahthvhv sakwo utsathi tsukvwalhti takvna iyuhsti uwenvhse wunatinvhse nikatv uhskwanikotv'i, nahskino' uwhahse'i.
ale nahskwo kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo akayaluti tsiwunatainvhse amekwohi, ale tsituniniyvhe nani'v tsunatalenhvtv;
nahskinho nhahkwo ukhalitsv amayulhti uninhsinole'i, ale unanvne'i, anohstvnho tithelito tunilvthane'i, uniyonho tunata'invse'i.
nahskihskini nuhstehsti elohi alhskwatvha; tinikhanhahwatitohi tvni'luhtsi, totvnakalenthani uninekutsitv ale unatanhthi;
uninekutsitvnho witotvnata'ehsi tikolhvhsv atsilvyi, nanhahtaniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhtohkv'i.
tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki; itsolhkitsu nikatv hi'a?  vv, tsakvwiyuhiav vkvwohselvki.

nhahkwono hi'a' ntuwehselvki; nahski iyuhsti khilo tikowhelihski kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv ukvwalhi' akeyhonvhi tsikehso'i, nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela tsitotikananukohwihsko' tsukvwalhti uhskwanikhtv tsutalenhvtv titse ale tsuwethi.
hi'anho nulhsthanvki, nhahkwo tsihsa uhskwatv hi'a nahski talhilohstihskv'i, unhikihsvki.

nhahakwno uwahsv utselikohi uluhtsv tsunilawi'istiyi tuweyhonhvki; nahski iyuhsti unihskwanikohsvki, ale hi'a nuniwehsvki; kato ulhstohthanv hi'a nahski ahskaya tsakhtha nhaha ale uhskwanikhti tsitulvwhihstaneha?
hi'akhani tinehskehski uwetsi, melikhani' utsi, alekhani' analhinvtli tsimi v ale tsohsi ale hsawani ale tsutahsi?
alekhahni tsuto nikatv ehskanhi tsaneha?  katonho ulhstohthanv hi'a nikatv tsuweha?
vkvwakhonelohihselvkinho v ahsenho tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvki; atolehohski vlha natsilvkwotvna yikehso'i, uwahsvhskininonv utselikohi ale uwahsv kanelvhi.
vlhanho yutsathe uhskwanikhthi nanhahayitulvwhihstanele'i v nanohiyuhvhskena kehsv' nvtakalhstohtihskvki.
nahneyu elotv nvhki ikatuki kehsv hstatuki atsikathitihst uthvkane tekanotsalhv tsihsa.
hi'anho nituwehsele tsunvhsitahsti; hi'a nahski tsani titawehski; to'ulenhv tsuyohuhsvki, ale nahski iyuhsti uhskwanikhtiyu tsitulvwhihstaneha.
elotvyhenho uni'yvhe tsani' ale ulhvle'i ale uhstunhe titahstutiyi,  kwiliki elotv tinatanhvlhi utali'i elotisi tsutitv uhstvtihske'i.
tsaniynho hi'a nuwehsele elotv; vlha tuyukhthv yiki nahski tsatayheha.
ale utulihske uhihstiyi, ahsenho tahska'ihe yvwi i atolehohskihyenho uniyelvse tsani.
ahseno nhahkwo elotv utenhv iyu' ika tunlawitsv a elotihsi uwetsi athv unalihski'elei, ale ohse uyelvnhe elotv.
nahski iyuhsti uhselithane' uthu'ihstanele unhehtiyi nuhstvkwo uthayolv'i.
nhahkwonho utsi uweyhonhvhi nikehse'i hi'a nuwehse'i; anhi hskhiyohelvha tsani titawohski uhskho athelito kalhtehsti.
ukvwiyuhinho uyo'iyu uyelvnhe'i, ahsenho uhselithanv'ivv ale nahskwo nhski analhstayvhvhski nvtsulhstohthanei, unhetse atsinehtiyi.
utanvhsenho wunihskutehse tsani titastuhtyi.
uhskonho uniyholhe athelitokihi v ale uninhele athv e nahskino utsi wunhele'i.
kvhwstawatitohinho uniluhtse' ale uninehse ayeli, ale uninihsanhe'i, ale unenvhse wuninhonhele tsihsa.
tsihsanho uthvkanv, tsiyu utsothanvki nanhahunhikisvki utayelilv inake wulohsvki.  nhahakwonho yvwi unahthvkanv v elati kvwhstawatveki tekatuhv totayunenvsvki.
tsihsanho utsa'ihsv tukohvki unitsathi yvwi, ale tuwetolitsvki v ale tunhvwanv tsunitlvki.

uhsvnho nulhsthanv kvhwstawatohi kvwaluhtselvki hi'a nuniwehsvki v anhi inakekwo i ale ika ulohsonhiti, tsitsenakwon kiyosi hi'a unitsathi yvwi v ale totikatuhv wi'anilohi, nanhahunvhsv unalhstayvhti uniwhahsvha.
ahsenho tsihsa hi'a ntuwehselvki; vlha ahse' vunenvhsti yiki, nihikwo titselhsta.
hanho nvkvwawehselvki; anhi hihskikwo katu tokiha i thalikwonho atsa'ti.
hi'anho nuwehsvki; anhi tihskiyohihsi.

tunetselvnho unitsathi khanehskohi kehsv unanvtiyi v tukihsvno hihski katu ale thali atsa'ti tunesvhi kalvlatnho witukhanhanv ulihelitsvki, ale tukvhaluyv tunhelvk katu kvhwstawtitohi, nahskino kvhwstawatitohi unitsathi wituninhelvki.
nikatvnho unalhstayvnhvki ale tunolhvhsvki v ale unuthihsvki ulikvhaluyhvhi uthiyvhi thalatu iyakhali'i thalutsa.
unalhstayvnhvhino hihskiha iyakayvli anihskaya nani'vki, nitanelhtvna anikeyhv ale tiniyolhi.
khilakwono iyvtv tsisa tunvwhihsthanvki kvhwstawatitohi tsiyuhi unatsotiyihv ale ikvyi nitunihsohihstiyi ahsi tayelihihstihskv unitsathi.
nhahkwonho tuyhelihihsthanv unitsathi otalv unhahluhsvki uwahsv kehsv'i, utatolihsthanvhsvki.ai uhsvnho nulhsthanv nanhahuwahsvkwo kesvki.
tsiyunho nhahkwo ayelhi vtali waninihsvki ulhatihsthanitohv ama talhstilhanekv'i, unoleyhenho ikvyitlv tayukhthvki.
nhahkwonho nvhkine' iyuntanetliyvtv kesv aniyahwiski hsvnoyi tsihsa wituluhtselvki vtali katu'i a'ihsvki.
kvhwstawatitohinho kvwakohv vtali katuk; a'ihsv'i unatanhthehthanvki, hia nuniwehsvki; nayehi hi'a. a anihska'ihvnho iyuhsti unalhihsthanvki.
ahsenho khilakwo iyvtv tsihsa tunhetselvki, hi'a nituwehselvki v ukalhstikwo itsatanhtata, ayvkwohyenho, lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti.
kwitano unhetsv hia nuwehselvki; tsakvwiyuhi, iyunho nihi kesehstihi skinetsi wikvluhtsehtiyi amayi katu'i.
ehena, utvnhvki.  nhahkwono kwita tsiyuhi utsa'ihs amayi katu'i a'isvki tsihsa tsetohv wakhthvki.
ahsenho nvtolehohsv' ahstayiyu kanolv'vhskv uhskalvki, ale ulenvhv kanoyvkv uwelhunhvki, tsakvwiyuhi hskihstelv, utvnhvki.
khilakwonho iyvt tsihsa wutoyhanvhitv wuniyvhvkihi hia nuwehselvki; uhsti tsohiyuhi, ktohi vtstltsithsi?
tsiyuhinho i'unatsanv kanolv'vhskv uhsulkotsvki.
nhahkwono tsiyuhi unatsa'i uniluhtsv kvwatatolihstanelvki v hi'a nuniwehsvki' v utohiyuhiya nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi.
nhahkwonho tunihsohtsv kenihsilati uniluhtsvki.
nanhhanho anehi anihskaya kvwolhtsv, kvwathuwitv tunatanvhsitolvki, tekvwahthinhohelvki nikatv tsunitlvki.
kvwhthayohselvkino kataluyathvkwo nahskwo unhuwav unhsvnhtiyi, nikatvhnho unahsvnhilvhi tunatiwhsvki.
nhahkwonho tsihsa kvwaluhtselvki tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi tsiluhsilim anehi, hi'a nuniwehsvki;
katonho ketsstawatitohi aniyohstihsko ethi aneh uninhohelhvhi? v tlayhenho yitanohsulehsko' tsunoyeni tsvtinalihstayvnhihso'i.
ahseno unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho nahskwo nihi ethi anehi uninhohelhi itstihsko i'tsiyohstihsko unelhanvhi unhetsvhi?
unelanvhiyenho unhetse hi'a nuwehse'i i hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi; ale nahskwo hi'aai khilo tahskinvtihskehsti utota ale utsi ahse uyohuhihsti kehsehsti.
ahsenho nihi hi'a nitsiwehsko'i; iyunho khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti utota, ale utsivv akwalihskolhthanvhi yeli ketsalhstelhtohti kesv'i nitsatvnehv'i
nikalvkwtihskvnanho ikehsehsti utota, ale utsihv v vlha uhskanvtsvhi yikehsehsti,] itsatihsko'i.  nahski hi'a ethi anehi uninhohelhvhi itsvhthanv ahsekwo nitsvnelv unelhanvhi unhetsvhi.
itsatlonahsti, yelikwo ihsaya tsutolehohse tsitsitvke'i, hi'a tsinuwehshe'i;
hi'a yvwi na'v kvkiluhtseha anihol anhtiha v ale tunihaneka'lv tanhti kvkilvkwtiha, ahsenho uninawi invhiyu nunvnhv.
ahsekwohskini nanatvneha kvkwatatolihstaneha v tsitanateyhohvhska tanateyohvhskv yvwikwo uninhetsvhi.
wituyhahvnho unitsathi hi'a nituwehselvkihi itsathvkvka ale itsolhki.
vlhahskini nahski na aholi wuyvlhi kataha yinuwaneho yvwi, aholhskini nvtayunukotsvhi nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi.
nhahkwonho kvhwstawatitohi uniluhtsv hiha' nikvwahselvki; hikhthahahsko anikwalihsi uninhahlvtsvhi unathvkanv nahski hi'a nitsawehsv'i.
ahsenho unhetsvki hi'a nuwehsvkivv nika'v tuyhehkv etota tsuwhihsvhi nikehsvna tiyhehihsti kehsehsti.
unanelaki, tinikhewikw tnkw tinathinhitohi; iyunho tikewi yahthinhi tikhewi itsula athalehsv tsunilv'ihsti.
kwitanho unhetsv hia nuwehselvki; tihskiyohsihsasi hi'a nahski talhilohstv'i.
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki v ahsihsko nahskwo nihi nitsolhkvnakwo iki?
tlahsko ahsi yitsolhka nahski nika'v kohuhsti vholi uyvhsthanvhi kehsv ohskwolhiyi wikaluhkv'i, nahskino wikalohihstihskv'kwo?
nahskini' vholi nvtayunukotsvhi onawiyi' titalehvhsko'i'v nahskino kataha nuwaneho yvwi.

onawhyihyenho titalehvhsko uhsonv atanhthehti kehsv'i v ale atahihstiyi kehsv'iav ale atayhonehtiyi kehsv'i v ale utelitv tinhsihtiyi kehsv'i, ale kanohskihstiyi kehsv'i, ale atsikhohtiyi tanatayhi'litohv'i, ale hsotlvhihstohtiyi kehsv'i.
nahskihskini hi'a kataha iyuwanehi yvwihi nitahsulehvnahskini alhstayvhtiyi' vlha kataha yinuwaneho yvwi.
tsihsanho nanhahunhikihsv thayo'i ale satoniyi wulohsvki.
kvnhiyukwonho kenani ehi akeyv nanhahna'v nvtayulohsvhi uwelhunhvkivv hia nuwehselvki; hskitoliki, tsakvwiyuhi tewi' uwetsi i akwetsi akeyhv utsathanvhi uteyhahthohtiha ahskina.
ahsenho nunhetshelvnakwo vkehsvki.  kvwahstawa'titohino kvwaluhtselvki, kvwahthayohselvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; wi'ena a ikihskonhihahyenho.
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehsvki v vlha khilo titsiwahthvtiyhi yvkhinetshelv, awhi uninotena unalenalvhi unvhsv ihsili hsitanelvhi kvhsv'i.
nhahkwonho akeyhv uluhtsv utatolihstanelvki ha nuwehsvki; tsakvwiyuhi, skihstelv.
unhetsvno hia nuwehsvki v vlha yituyukhti tiki'ehtiyi tiniyolhi natseli katu, kilhinho witatinetiyi.
akeyhvnho hia nuwehsvkihsv utohiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhiav ahsenho kilhi analhstayvhtihsko unvko'ohsvhi tikvwaninalha'i tunihskilv'i.
nhahkwono tsihsa unhetsv hia nuwehselvki; hikeyhv utsathi tsohiyuha'v nuhstv tsatulihskv winitsalhstahsi. v nahiyukwonho uwetsi utiwhse'i.
tsihsanho nanhahunhikihsv kelili vtaluhlti uluhtsvki, unhahluhsvnho uhsahilhv nanhahuwenhvki.

unitsathino yvwi kvwaluhtshelvki v tanahthinehv tiniyo'ulhi, ale tinikhewiai ale tsunvkhewi, ale kohuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi, ale unitsathi nvwanata'lei, ale tsihsa tulahskv na'v tuninvnvki, tunhvwanvkinho.

nahski iyuhsti unitsathi kehsv unihskwanikohsvki, tunikohv tsunvkhewi aniwonihsko'i, ale ahuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi uninhohstv nunalhsthanv'i, alenatitiyo'ulhi, kvwanetahsti nulhsthanv'i ale tinikhewi kvwanikowhahthvhti nulhsthanv'i; unilvkwthanvkinho unelhanvhi ishili unatselika.

tsihsanho wituyanvhv kvwhstawtitohi, hi'a nuwesvki i katsiyatolika hi'a unitsathi kehsv'ivi tso'iyhenho natotakwa anhi ketohv anetoha, ale' vlha yiniyheha unalhstayvhti.  ale' ilha yakwatuliha to'unenvhstiyi tikvwniyohsihski v wanaye'no yitaniwanikalok wanahsvhi.
kvwahstawatitohinho hi'a nvkvwawehselvki v hatlvnho yotsiki nahski ika'i alhstayvhti inake'i, nahski iynitsathi yeli tsunolhvhihsti?
tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki v ilako katu tetsiyhehav av kalhkwoki i ilvhskinho tsunhsti atsa'ti, unatvnhvki.
unitsathinho tunhetselvki katohi unanvtiyi.
kalhkwokinho katu tukihsvki ale tunehsv atsa'ti i ulihelitsvno, tukvhaluyhvki, ale kvwhstawatitohi witunhelvki v kvhwstawatitohinho unitsathi wituninhelvki.
ale nkatv unalhstayvnhvki, ale tunolhvhsvki.  ale unuthehsvki ulikvhaluyhvhi kalhkwoki iyakhali'i thalutsa.
unalhstayvhinho nvhkiha iyakayvli nani'vki anihskaya, nitanhelhtvna anikeyhv' ale tiniyolhi.
ale unitsathi tuyhelihihsthanvki, ale tsiyuhi wutsanvki v ale makiteli' wunanukotsvki.
anikwalihsinho ale anihsatuhsi uniluhtsvkivv kvwakoliyehskvnho kvwhthayohselvki tsuna'nukowhsehtiyi uyeltv kalvlati nvtayulohsvhi.
unhetsv'nho hi'a nituwehselvki; uhsv nikalhsta' hi'a nitsiwehsko'i; ulhkaliyihsatv kehsehsti, kalvloyheno kikake'iyu iki.

snln tsksh, kohi ika tsiki tvkanhahaniv' kalvloyhenho kikke'iyu iki, ale ikalokiliyeha, itsatihsko'i.  itsatlonahsti, yelikwo itsatolehohsko nuhstv kalvlohi, lhahskonho yeli ketsatolehohihsti yiki uyelhtv iyu lhsthanitahsti kehsv'i?
uniyo ale uninekutsitv tsaneha uniyhoho uyelhtv'i, ahsenho vlha' yvkakekalihskolvtasi uyelhv'tvi, tsona atolehohski utseli' uyelhtv uwahsv. v tutanv'elvnho unhikihsvki.
kvhwstawatitohino tunihsohtsv unvkhewhihsvhi kehsvki unatenhtiyi.
tsihsanho hia ntuwehselvki i itseyhahthahehsti akothohti anikwalihsi al anhihsatuhsi unatselika.
uninhohelhvkhino kesv unvhsv, hi'a nuniwehsvki; nikatenhvna tsiki nvtikalhstohtiha.
tsihsano nahski utolehohsv hi'a nituwehselvkin' uhsti itsohiyuhi i katonho' itsvhsv kehshv itsinhoheha alhstayvhti' nitsiyhehvna kehsv'i?
tlahsko' ahsi yitsolhka, ale lhahsko yitsanhtha hihski katu ale hihski iyakayvli tsinani'vki v ale' iyakhali'i thalutsa itsuthehsv'i?
ale kalhkwoki katu nvkn iyakayvli tsinani'vki, ale iyakhali'i thalatsa itsuthesv'i?
kato tikalhstohti nitsolhkvna tsikiav nahski hi'a tsinitsvwehsi tlahskini katu yitsitvka, itseyhahthahehsti akothohti anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi unatselika v tsitsvyohsi?
nhahkwonho unolhtsvkih nuninhetshehvna kesv uneyhahtho'ihstiyi katu akothohti, tanateyhohvhskvhskini anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi.
tsihsanho uluhtsv hsihsaliyi kwelikiyi v tuthvtvnhvki kvhwstawtitohivv hi'a nituwehselvki; ayv yvwi uwetsi tsiki kako kvkwohseho yvwi?
hi'ano nuniwehsvki'; ikatv tsani titawohski [ketsohseho'i,] ikatvnho ilaya'i anihsohno tselimaya ale khilo iyuhsti anatole'hohski' kehsv'i.
hianho ntuwehselvki; nihinano kako skiyohseha?
sawaninho kwita unetsv hia nuwehsvki; kalonetv nihi, kvnhitv unelhanvhi uwetsi.
tsihsanho unhetsv ha nuwehselvki; ohsiyu itsalhstanehti nihi sawani tsona uwetsi; vlhayhenho ukwetalhi ale kikv nahski yitsananukowhihselv i etotahskini kalvlati' ehi.
ayvnho hi'a nikvwehsheha; kwita nihi' ale nahski ani hi'a nvyohi takanehskehi akwatseli tsunanelhti unatalhkv'i, ale tsvhskino'i tahstuhvi ehska iyunvnhti nikehsvna kehsehsti.

ale tihstu'ihsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv tsutseli totakvtelihv nika'vnho kohuhsti halhvihehsti elohi v kahlhvhsti kehsehsti kalvlati i nika'vnho kohuhsti halhvkihskehsti elohi kalhvkihsti kehsehsti kalvlati.
nhahkwonho tunvhstatelvki kvhwstawtitohi khilo uninhonhehtiyitinaski wahsv kalonetv kehsv'i.

nhahkwono tsihsa ulenvhvki tunonhelvki kvwhstawatitohi ahse uwenvhstiyi kehsv tsiluhsilimi, ale tsutalenhvtv tsukilhiyotshehtiyi tinilawiki ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilvanelhohi ale tinowhelihski; ale atsi'ihstiyi e ale tsohine ika tsulehtiyi.
nhahkwono kwita iyvtv wuthinhvhsthanv ulenvhvki utanvhstatelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki, unelhanvhi wunvhstohi, tsakvwiyuhi, vlha nahski yinvketsalhstahsi.
ukhthahvhsvnho hi'a natsiwehselv kwita i akwahsohatv halehvka, setani, tihskwotehstihskikwo nihi, vlhayhenho yhatanhtheha unelanhi utselika, yvwikwohskini unatseli hatanhtheha.
nhahkwonho tsihsa ha nituwehselvk kvwhstawtitohi v iyunho khilo utulihskehsti akhstuwatvhstiyi a atatayhihehsti uwahsvyv ale tsutanhahwatv ayihskehsti, ale akhstawatekehsti.
khilohyenho utulihskehsti uhstelhtiyi kvnhv'i, uyohuhsehti kehsehsti v khilonho uyohuhsehehsti kvnhi, ayv nvtikalhstohtihskehstiai uwhahthvti kehsehsti.
kato yvwi yunhehkwotsi iyunho elanikhv utseli yinulhsthanv, utanhtonho yuyohuhselv; ale kato yahvka yvwi ykanetliyvhsta utnto.
yvwiyhenho uwetsi takaluhtsi utota utseli kalvkwtiyu ke'sv unhuwohstehsti v ale tinikhanhahwatitohi tathinhehehsti; nhahkwonho totvkuyv'eli nani'v yvwi' nuhstv tunilvwhihstanelv'i.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehsehahe khilo anhi tanitoka vlha yvtvnatolehohsi ayohuhihsti kehsv'i i khvnhi anikohvha yvwi uwetsi nanhahaukvwiyuhi kesv kananukotsilhvha.
sutalinho winuhsvlhv tsihsa tuthinhvhsvki kwitahv ale tsimi ale tsani tsimi tinatanhvlhi, ale tunhahlhthanvki inv ikathi otalv unvhsv kehsv'i,
ale utanetliyvhse tanikhanhv'iai ale ukhathv tikvwlvhsa'ta nulhsthane nt itktslt, ale unhuwv ika-kathv tsinunekiyv nunekiye'i.
ale khvnhiyukwo nanhahkhvnikehsv nikvwantvnhele mohsi hale ilaya kvwalhinohetihske'i.

kwitano unhetsv hi'a nuwehsele tsihsa; tsakvwiyuhi, ohsiyu anhi tsitetohahi iyunho ohsiyu yitsayelvnhv, anhi tso'i yitotsilhtsothvka, hsakwo nihi tsatselikavi so'inho mosi utshlik, so'inho ilaya utselika.

ahsikwonho kawonihske, kvniyukwo uhskohstv ulokila unatawatihsthane'iai ale khvnhiyukwo nanhahulokilv tsunhetse'i, hi'a nvtsuwese'i; hi'a nahski akwetsi tsikeyu'i, nahski ohsiyu tsiyelv'i i nahski etsathvtahstanehehsti.
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv tuninvtse tuniyahstuhse'i, utsathi unihskale'i.
tsihsanho uluhtse tuhsvnhile'i, hi'a nuwese'i; titsalehvka, ale lhehsti yitsihskaihehsti.
tunakhanhanvnho vlha khilo yunikohe tsihsa uwahsv.
tsunikhsohsitihsvnho otalv'i tsihsa tunvhstatele'iav hia nuwehse'i; lhehsti khilo etsinonhelvha nahski tsitsikowathv khvnhi yvwi uwetsi uyohuhsv tulenhehsti.
kvhwstawatitohinho kvwahtvtvnhe'ihi hi'a nuniwehse'i; katonho tinowhelihski, ilaya ikvyi takaluhtsi, tsanatihsko'i?
tsihsano unhetsv hi'a nituwehselei e utohiyuhi ilaya ikvyi uluhihsti ale uwolhvhihsohti nika'v kohuhsti.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha i ilaya kayula uluhtsv, ale' vlha yikvwolhtso'ihi ahsenho nika'v unatulihski nikvwanelv. i nahskwohskini yvwi uwetsi nahskiya nvtakvwaneli.
nhahkwonho kvwahstawatitohi unolhtse tsani titawohski khane'ihstihskv'i.
nhahkwonho unitsathi anetohv uniluhtsv, uluhtshelvki ahskaya tulinikwanvnelvki hia nuwehsvki;
tsakvwiyuhi, hiyatoliki atshutsa akwetsi, kvliyenho kvwahiha i ale utsathi akilhiyokavi yanokiyuyhenho atsilvhyi khtvko'i ale amayi akvko'i.
katsiyathinhohelvkino ketsahstawatitohi i ahsenho uninulvnhvki uninhvwotiyi.
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwesvki v nitsohiyuhsvna ale itsakhthahvtv kohi tsitseha, ilako nikohilehsti itsvyelatitohehsti?  ilako nikohilehsti unanelaki itsvyelihsehehsti?  skiyathinhohihsi.
tsihsanho ahskina uhskatsvkiav ahskinan unukotsvki atshutsa, ale nahiyukwo utiwhsvki.
nhahkwono kvhwstawatitohi tsihsa kvwaluhtselvki unvhsv kehsv'i i hi'a nuniwehsvki v katonho tsokinulvnhvki' otsinukowhihstiyi?

tsihsanohihi'a nituwehselvkiai nvtikalhstohtiha nitsohiyuhsvna kehsv'i.  utohiyuhyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha v iyunho yitsohiyuha nahskwo atsilvkwo ukhtha ikhitv, hi'a yinitsiwehsi' hi'a tsotalv, hatanvna itlv whilohi, aha utanvhsti; vlh ale kohuhsti yiketsinulvhvhska.
hi'ahskininonv iyuhsti vlha unuko'ihsti yiki v khvnhi yvtatolihstiha ale amalhi yakvhska.
ahsinho kelili anetohv'i tsihsa hia ntuwehselvki i yvwi uwetsi yvwi totaketsiyohihseli,
ale nahski takvwhali v ale tso'ine ika totvalenhi.av utsathanvhinho uyo uniyelvnhvki.
kekwaninho uniluhtsv ayelhi' atelv ankihsitohi kvwaluhtsele kwita a hi'a nuniwehse'i; lhahsko titseyhohvhski ayelhi yakuyihsko'i?
vv, utvnhe'i.  atanelvnho uluhtsv tsihsa uyohstohtanelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki; kato heliha, sawani; kako ayelhi kvwanakuyv'eho unikvwiyuhi eloh nehi; tsunetsihsko, nvwanatalekhe?
nvwanatale'i, utatohselvki kwita.  tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki; tsunetsihskinikeno unanelakikwo.

ahsenho tininhahlvtohstiyi nikehsvna, vtali hena v ahsuhtinho witsata'ehsvha, ikvyiyhinho hiyvktv atsati hinehsvha, ale hihstu'isv aholi ayelhi-atelv thiwhahthvhi; nahski hikisvha ale tehinelvha ayv kinakhyvhti.
nahiyu tsihsa kvwaluhtselv kvwhstawtitohi, hi'a nikvwawhselvki v kako ulhia tsilvkwotiyu nanhahkalvlati' ehi ukvwiyuh kesv'i.
tsihsanho ayolhi wuyhanvhv ayelhi aninv uwekhanhvki, ale hi'a nuwesvki;
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; iyunho nitsatanetliyvhsvna ikehsehsti v ale tiniyolhi tsinunhsti nitsalhsthanvna ikehsehsti, vlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv yvketsiyvha.
nahski iyuhsti khilo' utatolihsti kehsehsti nahskiya ha ayolhi i nahski utli' atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti nanhahkalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i.
ale khilo tatanilvkehsti hsakwo nahski hi'a iyuhsti ayolhi takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, ayv takwatanilvkehsti.
khilohskini tekotehstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv nahski kvkwohiyuhvhski v utli' ohsiyu ahstohski nvya yatsiyalhanv, ale ahsthvhkv amekwohi yatsikvyhv.

uni'iyu iyuhlstanhehti kehsehsti elohi nvtikalhstohtiha tinatatotehstihskiav ahseyhenho tinatatotehstihski uninanuko'ihsti; ahsenho uyo'iyu iyulhstanehti nahski na ahskaya titatotehstihski unanukohwihsvhi.

nahski iyuhsti iyunho tsoyeni ale tsalahsihteni tetsotehstihskehsti v hihskwalhskehsti' ale witsatekehsti; utli ohsiyu itsalhstanehti tsoyeni ale tsalahsihteni tsayohuhselvhi yiki kvnhitv tikehsv wiyitsayvlhv i ano' itsula yithiyehsata ale itsula' titsalahsihteni wiyetsata'inv nikhtlohskvna kehsv atsilvyi.
