iyu ale hikhtholi tetsotehstihskehsti v hatakhtheto'ihskehsti ale witsatekehsti; utli ohsiyu itsalhstanehti hsakwo hyikhanhahkvnhitv tikesv wiytsayvlhv, anho itsula yithikhanhahtsvhskinoi atsilvyi wiyetsata'inv.
itseyhahthahehsti tsikayetsihsotlvhthani sakwo hi'a tsunhstika; hiayhenho nitsvwehseha v kalvlati tssv tsuntselika tinikhanhhawhatitohi nikohilv anikowahthihsko' ukhathv etota kalvlati ehi.
yvwiyhenho uwetsi uluhtsv uhstelvhilhv' ulenalhvhi.
kato itselihaav iyunho khilo ahskaya ahskohitskwi awhi yitunalha'a, hsakwono' yuleyo'elv, tlahsko sonhelhskohi hsonhelakali iyanitv yitikhteko'i, ale yitikhanaluhsitoho katuhsi yuyhoho uleyo'elvhi?
iyunho awahthv i utohiyuhya' itsvyohseha, utli nika'o aliheliko nahski kesv iyuhsti, ehskakwo sonhelahskohi sonhelakali iyanitv nunaleyo'vna.
nahskiya nahskwo' vlha yutuli itsitota kalvlati' ehiai sakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv tsuniyohuhstiyi.
iyunho tihstatanhvlhi itsahskanvtsehehsti, hekehsti hinonhehehsti uhskanvtsv ihstvhsvkwo kehsv'i; iyunho itsathvtahstanehehstiai hiwahthvhehsti tihstatanhvlhi.
iyuhskinino nitsathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti, ahsiyvwi ale anitha'li tehahthinhekehsti v nahskinho aninohehskv anithali ale anitso'i anikhthahi nikatv tshanetsv ahstayohskehsti.

iyunho nahski nitathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti htsunanelhti unatalhkv hinohvhskehsti; iyuhskinino tsunanelhti unatalhkv nitathvtahstanehvna ikehsehsti, nvwatalekwo yvwi ale ayelhikwo-atelv akihsitohi nahskiya hiyatanvthehskehsti.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha'i nika'v kohuhsti itsalhv'ihehsti elohi, kalhvhsti kehsehsti kalvlati i nika'vn kohuhsti itsalhvkihskehsti elohi kalhvkihsti kehsehsti kalvlati.
alewo hia nitsvwehsehaai iyunho anithali nihi tsitsetoha analikohvhskehsti anhi' elohi nika'vkwo kohuhsti anithayohihehsti v nahski iyunatvnheti kehsehsti etota kalvlati' ehi.
ilvhtlvyhenho anithali ale antsi tstanilawi'o ayv takwato'v tsinvtikalhstohtihsko'i, nanhahayelhi akwatahsuyo'i.
nhahkwonho kwita uluhtselv hia nuwesvkiav tsakvwiyuhi, hilako nakhskanvtsehehsti tsohstatanhvlhiai ahsikwo itsiyatolikehsti?  kalhkwokihsko'?
tsihsa hi'a nuwehselvki; vlha kalhkwokikwo yikvyoseha, kalhkwahskohihskini kalhkwoki iyulohsvhi.
nahski iyuhsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuh kesv nahskiyakwo khilo ukvwiyuhi tsutanhthelhe ohstv' iyunvnhtiyi tuthukv tsunvhsitahsti.
nhahkwonho unalenvhv ohstv nunvnelv v sakwo akathinohele ahskohi iyukwatinvtv atelv uthuki.
ahsenho kohuhsti uhtaytohti nuhvna kesv iyuhsti i unalha'i unhetse atsinatinvtiyi ale utali'i ale tsuwetsi ale nika'v kohuhsti uhv'i v atayvhtiyinho.
nahski iyuhsti atsinvhsitahsti elati utanvne'i, ale utatolihstanele'i, hia nuwese'i; hskinalha'i, skitoliki skikhthitahi nikatvnho takvyakuyveli.
nahskinho atsinvhsitahsti unalha'i uwetolitse'i, ale u'wekhanhe'i i ale uthukv unelaki uwelihsele'i.

ahsenho nahski na atsinvhsitahsti unukotsvhi uwhahthvhe ahsiyvwi ihtsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti naski unhetsvhi ukuyv'etiyi ahskohitskwi akihsi tsunakvwalhti v uniyvhenho, ale uyhvhskiyvhe'i i skwakuyvhsi tsikvthuka v utvnhe'i.
itsulahano ketsinvhsitahsti tulahskv' elati utanvne utatolihstanele'i, hia nuwese'i; hskitoliki skikhthita v nikatvnho takvyakuyv'eli.
ahsenho vlha yuwohiyunhe'iai titahstutiyikwo wulohshe'i, ale nanhahawhuyhthane ukuyhtiyi' atsithukv ikohitv.
nakwonho nahski itsulaha ketsinvhsitasti unatolehohsv nulhsthanv'i utsathi uyo unyelvnhe'ivv ale uniluhtse uninhonele' tsuninalha'i nikatv nulhsthanitolv'i.
nhahkwonho unalha'i wuyanvhv hi'a nuwehsele'i i tsanekutsitv kvnvhsitahsti i unelaki kvyelihselvki nikatv nihi tsikvthukvkivi skithayohselv iyuhsti.
lhahsko nahskwo nihi kahiyatolihsti yikese itsulaha ehstinvsitahsti v nahskiya kvyatolitsv'i?
uthalhawuhsenho unalha'i, ale wituyohihsele' tinatahstuhvhski ukuyvhohvhstiyi hnikatv' atsithukv ikohitv.
nahskiya nahskwo nttsvyneli etota kalvlati' ehi a iyunho titsatanhthv iyvtv itsihsiyvwiha kehsv nititsitolikvna ikesehst itsatanhvlhi unihskanvtsv'i.
hi'anho nulhsthanvki, tsihsa uhskwa'tv nahski hi'a nikawehskv'ihe kelili utanvhsvki, tsutiyi' ahsthv wuluhtsvki tsotani' ahskonititlv.
unitsathinho kvwhahstawatvhsvki, ale nanhahtunhvwanvki.
anikwalihsi nahskwo kvwaluhtshelv kvwakoliyehskvki, hi'a nikvwawehsehvki; tuyukhtihsko' ahskaya uta'invtiyi utali'i nika'vkwo kohuhsti yvtilhyilvhstiha?
unetsvno hi'a nituwehselvki; lhahsko yitsikoliye'o, nahski titalenihskv tsuwelhvnhvhi ahskaya ale akeyhv tuwolhvnhv'i?
ale ha nuwehsv'i; nahski iyuhsti ahskaya tektekehsti utota le utsi, ale atlatwhstihskehsti utali'i, ale nahski anithalih sakwokwo unikwetalhv'i?
nahski iyuhsti vlha nhahakwo anithali yiki; sakwokwohskini unikwetalhv'i.  nahski iyuhsti unelhanvhi tsuwuhthathanvhi kehsv lhehsti yvwi yitukalenthanehsti.
hi'ano nvkvwawehselvki; katonho yihsi tsunhetse kowheli kanvnehtiyi tikalenhtohti, ale akhehitahstiyi?
hiano nituwehselvki; tihstayiyu kehsv' iyuhsti titsinawhi mohsi unanelaki tanikhetohihsti tsunatali'i, itselihselvki; titalenihskvhskini vlha nahski yinuhste'i.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; khilo utali'i iakhitohehsti tsunhsinvhihskininonv ikehsehsti, nvwatalenho iatayhekehsti v atayhonehehsti uhe khilonho atsikhehitolvhi atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti.
kvhwstawatitohi hi'a nikvwawehselvki; iyunho nahski yinuhsti' ahskaya utali'i tanatsehv'i, vlha ohsiyu yiki atesvhvhstiyi.
hianho nituwehselvki, vlha nani'v hi'a tsinitsi wi yitokvnatanilvki, kekalihskoltanelvhi unvhsv.

anehahyenho aninali nvwansto tsunitsi kvwaninnukowhihsv, ale aneha aninali yvwi kvwaninalitvhi, ale aneha aninali unvhsv unatanalitvhi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv tilhiyilvhstihskv'i.  khilo tikvwatanilvihsti kehsehsti nahski tatanilvkehsti.
nhahkwonho takathinohelvki tsunhsti tiniyolhi nahski tsuhsihthatihstiyi ale utatolihstohtiyi; kvwhstawatitohinho tuninvhsttelvki.
tsihsano hia nuwhsvki; unnelaki titselihsi tsunhsti tiniyolhi v ale lhehsti titsinvhstatelvki kvkiluhtsehtiyi; nahskiyen nunahsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi ks.
tuhsithatvno nanhahutanvhsvki.
kvnhiyukwonho ahsiyvwi uluhtselvki hia nuwehselvki; hohstv thateyhohvhski, kato uhsti ohstv kohuhsti takatvnheli akhiwathvhtohti winahstvna kvnhitv?
hino nuwehselvki; katonho hohstv ihskwoseha?  vlha khilo ohstv yiki hsakwo uwahsvhiyuhi nahski unelanvhi.  ahseno tsatulihskehsti kvnhitv tikehsv witsananuko'ihstiyi thihskwanikota tikhanhahwatvhsti.
ha nuwehselvki; kato uhsti?  tsihsa hia nuweeki; hi'a, lhehsti tsatalhvki; lhehsti tsatayhonelvki; lhehsti tsanohskihsvki; tanatahyi'litohv lhehst kayhkoki tsanohelhvki;
hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi; ale nahskwo hi'a; tsvhsv nitsatakeyuhsv nikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala.
awinv hia nuwehselvki; hi'a nahski nikatv takikhanhahwatenv tsitshutsa kehsv nvtakvwatalenvtv, kato ahsi akilula?
tsihsa hia nuwehselvki; iyunho tsahskwatihstiyi tsatulihskehsti, hena, winatuka tsanhahai, ale thihvhsi uyo iyunatvnhahteki, kalvlatinho witsahehsti tsukvwalhti v ale thehsv skihstawatehsvha.
ahsenho awinv nahski uthvkanv utanvhsvki uyo'iyu uyelvnhvki, utsathiyheno uwenhahiyu kehsvki.
nhahkwono tsihsa hi nituwhehselv kvwhstawatitohi; utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha; uwenhahi yvwi ahstayiyu wuyvhstiyi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuh kehsv'i.
alewo hi'a nitsvwehseha v utli hitiyu khemili ukhthvlehihstiy yvki kahsinenatvtiyi eskakwo uwenhahi yvwi wuyvhstiyi unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i.
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv utsathanvhi unihskwanikohsvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki' kakonho yeli yatsihstelv?
tsihsanho nahski tukhanhahnv hi'a nituwehselvkiav yvwi kehsv' vlha nahski yinvkalhsta v unelanvhihskini kehsv nika'v kohuhsti iyulhstohtikwo.
nhahkwono kwita unhetsv hi'a nuwehselki; khvnhiyukwo ayv nikatiyu tokiyohsonhv ale itsvhstawatenv; katonho ayv tayotsiwhahthvhi?

tsihsanho hia nituwehselvki; utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; tanetliyvhsv'i, yvwi uwetsi kanhvha kalvkwtiyu uwehskilv'i, nihi hskihstawatvtv nahskwo itsinehsti tha'ltu tekahskilv'i, tetsuktanehehsti thalatu nanilstalhv ihsili.

ale nani'v khilo tsunhtetsvhi taninelv'i, ale analhinvtli ale tsunito, ale tsunitota, ale tsunitsi, ale tsunatali'i, ale tsunetsi, ale katohi, takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti, uniwhahthvhti kehsehsti ahskohitskwi unhehkwotsvhi, ale unatseli iyulhstohti kehsehsti kvnhitv winahsthvna.
ahsenho unitsatha ikvyi tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti; onhiyinho tsiki ikvyiikehsehsti.
kalvlatihyenho utselikohi nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela v sunale'iyu tsuwenvhse tsitunvhsvhse kohuhsti anatvnehi thelvlati tuwhihsv tsunilvwhihstanhtiyi.
nhahkwonho nahski' ahskaya kohuhsti anatvnehi tunukhthanv akihsi tsukvwalhti tsukuyv'ehtiyi hsika, thelvlati totsuwhihsv' tunvhse'i.
uwenvhsehno' sonheline iyulhilotv khalawatihsv'i, ale tukohe nvwanatale kanhtohtiyi anitona'e kohuhsti nntvhvn,
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i; itsena nahskwo nihi thelvlati totiwhihsv'i, tuyuktvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyveli.  unenvhsenho.
thaline ika iuwenvhse ale nhskwo tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi, nahskiya niutvnele'i.
hihskinenho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv tha'line i'uwenvhse'i, ale tuwhahthvhe nvwanatale anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvnehvna, hianho nituwehsele'i; katonho anhi itsitona utotakwatv kohuhsti nitsatvnehvna?
tlayhenha khilo yokinvhsv, unatvnhe'i.  hi'anho nituwehsele'i; nihi nahskwo itsena thelvlti totiwhihsv'i; tuyuktvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyv'eli.

uhsvnho nulhsthanv, thelvlati tawhihsv utselika hia nuwehsele atelv ukhthitehihi withihyanv kohuhsti anatvnehi ale thakuyvhsi tunilvwhihstanelv'i, onhiyhi ketsinvhsvhi thalenhta ikvyiyinho ketsinvhsvhi thihskwalta
hihskineno iyulhilotv khalawatihsv ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv, anihsiyvwiha akihsi tsukvwalhti kekakuyv'ele'i.
ikvyiyinho ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv utli' iki tayokakuyv'eli unelihse'i.  ahsenho nahskwo akihsikwo tsukvwalhti anihsiyvwiha' ikekkuyv'ele'i.
kekakuyvelvhnohi unikonelohihselekwo ahskaya kanela,
hi'a nuniwehse'i; hi'a onhiyi uniluhtsvhi sakwokwo iyulhilotv tunilvwhihstahsi, itsulahakwonho' nvhskiyvka ayv' nahski kakehsv ale utilhehkv ika tsokilvwhihstanelvhi.
ahsenho ahshiyvwi unhetsele hi'a nuwehsele'i; kinali'i, vlha utsathini yinikvyvneha.  lhahsko ohsi yitsayelvnhe akihsi tsukvwalhti kvyakuyv'ehtiyi?
hiki tstselika ale tsihena. v ohsi akiyelv tsiyakuyv'ehtiyi hi'a onhiyi uluhtsvhi nihi kvyakuyv'elv ika'i.
lhahsko tuyukhthv yiki nuhstv' katanvhthehskv iyakwvnhtiyi akwatseli'ikehsv'i? vitsihsa hikhtholi uyo'iyu iki nvtikalhstohti' ayv akwatanhthiyu kehsv'i?
howanho onhiyi tsiki ikvyi kehsehsti, ikvyinho tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti. v unitsahthayheno ketsiyanvhv, ahsenho anikayolhiyu kekhsuyehsv.
tsihsanho tsiluhsilimi wakhthv'i, tha'latu iyanitv anatahstawatitohi unanelaki iyvtv wituthinhvhsthanvki, ale hi'a nituwehselvki;
kvnhiyukwo tsiluhsilimi witikathi v ale yvwi uwetsi ttaytsysi totaketsoyohihseli nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tinowhelihski, nahskino totvnukhlani uyohuhihstiyi,
ale kunasilenhvtv yvwi totvniyohihseli uniwelhvnanhtiyi, ale unili'vnhstiyi, ale unatvtiyi tsutanhahwatv kethv'i; ale tso'ine ika totv'alenhi.
nhahkwonho uluhtslvki tsekwithi tsuwetsi unitsi, tahthinhehvki tsuwetsi aniwinv i elati utanvnvki, ale ahuhsti uthayosehvki.
hin nwhselvki; kato tsatuliha?  hi'a nvtayuwehselvki; halhskolhvhta hia anithali tikwetsihi tsunihtiyi tsatselikohi kesv'i v sakwo hikhthihsi ititlv, so'inho hikhskani.

tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki; lha yitsi khthaha nuhstv itsithayohihv'i. tsiko yelikwo ketsatithahsti ulihskwiti atlihstv' ayv tsvtakatithahi, alehsko yelikwo yitetsawohsta ayv nahski tsvtayvkwawohsthani? yelikwo, unatvnhvki.

hiano ntuwehselvki; utohiyuhi akwatseli ulihskwt atlihstv tatsatithahiyv ale ay vkwawohstohti kesv totayetsawohsthani. a tsikathihsihskini ale tsikahskani khilo uwehtiyi vlh ayv akwatanhehti yiki v ketsinehtihskininonv kehsehsti nahski etota tsutanelhanlvhi.
ahskohinho iyanitv unathvkanv utsathi unithalhawosvki tuninikwathilhv anithali tinatanhvlhi.
tsihsanho wituyhanvhv hia nuwhsvki v itsikhthaha ayelhi tekolhvwatihsv nunikvwiyuhsateki aninheko iyunatvnelitahstiyi yvwi v ale ketsilvkwoti aninhetsitohv nanatvneho'i.
nihihskini lhehsti nahski yinitsvhnehstivi khilohskini atsilvkwoti iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti.
ale khilo ukvwiyuhi iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinalha'i kehsehsti.
nahskiyakwo yvwi uwetsi utanvhsitahstiyi nuyholhilhvna tsiki, atsinvhsitahstiyikwohskini, ale kvnhv'i ulhskohltohtiy unitsathi tikhyvhtohti.
tselikonho unhnikihsv unitsathi yvwi kvwhahstawatvhsvki.
kvnhiyukwonho anithali tinikewi unohuhlti tunolhvki, unahthvkanvno tsihsa ulohsv'i unelhunhvkiav hi'a nuniwehsvki v skinitoliki, tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi.
unitsathinho tuninhetselvki elhaweyi unhvhtiyi.  ahsenho utlikwo ika'i unelhunhvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki, skinitoliki, tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi.
tsihsano ulewhihsthanv wituyhanvhvki i ale hi'a nituwehselvki; kato ihstatuli ayv ihstvyatvnhehtiyi?
ha nuniwehsvki:  tsakvwiyuhi, tsohstikhtholi tsulhstu'ihstiyi okinatuliha.
tsihsanho tuwetolitsv tiniktholi tuhsvnelvkiai khilakwonho iyvtv kvwanikowahthvhti' nulhsthanvki; ale kvwahstawatvhsvki.
nhahkwonho tsiluhsilmi na'v uniluhtsv, svkhthohi, oliwa uhsahilhi iyvtv, tsihsa anitha'li kvwahstawatitohi tunvhsvki,
hi'a nitwehselvki'; ihstena itlv na tsvtikatuha, khilakwono' iyvt tayehstiwahthvhi hsokwili-tikalianvhitv kelihsatehstihv ale akina athinehehsti, tehstelihsatehsvha, ale tehskinathinohelvha.
iyunho khilo kohuhsti ihstohselvha, hi'a nehstiwehselvha; ukvwiyuhi tutuliha v khilakwonho iyvtv totayuyohsi.
nahski hi'a nikatv nulhsthanvkihv utohiyuhti'yi ayelvhsv'i atolehohski tsunhetse'i, hi'a tsinuwehse'i;
hi'a netsiwehsi hsayani uwetsi akeyhv; khvnhiyukwo ukvwiyuhi tsatseli taya'ivv tatsa'luhtsheli utatolihstiyu v ale ukhilvtehsti hsokwili-tikalianvhitv kohuhsti athvnhehi uwetsi akina.
kvwhstawatitohinho unenvhsvkivv tsihsa nuniwehselv nahskiya winunatvnelvki;
sokwili-tikalianvhitv ale akina tunahthinolhvki i tinihsohiyinho tsunanhuwo tunilhvnvki, ale nanha hunakhilvthanvki.
utlinho iyanii' yvwi tsunanhuwo tuniyehstvnvki nvnohihv ikatvnho tunhvnikalvhvkihv tsuweyhohtha tetluhkvi, ale nvnohi tuniyohthanvnvki.
unitsathino ikvyi aneki, ale' onhi aneki unelhuhkvki, hi'a naniwehskvki v hohsana tewi uwetsi! v atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti' yihowa te'uto'v tsika'luhihstiha! v hosana' wahsthv kalvlatiyu!
tsiluhsilminho uluhtsvhi nikhv katuhv unalhthelvnhvki, hi'a naniwehskvki; kako hi'a?
unitsathinho hi'a nuniwehsvki; hi'a tsihsa atolehohskiav nahselithi ehi kelili katuhv'i.

tsihsanho wuyvlhvki uthvna-tikalawi'ihstiyi unelanvhi utselika, ale tunukowhihsvki nikatv aninateki ale uniwhahski nanhahtikalawihstiyi i ale tulhuhkwatinvhsvki tunihskilv atelv tininetliyvhski, ale kule tinihskonhihi tininateki unanvhtiyi.
hiano ntuwehselvki; hi'a nikvnv kowhela; akwatseli kalhtsote atatolihstohtiy kalhtsote tuto'ehsti; ahsenho hia aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi nitsvnelv.
tinikhewhino ale tiniyo'ulhi kvwaluhtselvki tikalawi'ihstiyi v ale tunhvwanvki.

nhahkwonho nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tinowhelihski unatolehohsv uhskwanikhtiyu tulvwhihstanehv'i v ale tiniyolhi unelhkv uthvna-tiklawi'ihstiyi hia naniwehskv'iav hohsana tewi uwetsi i v utsathi unihsonvtselvki;

ale hi'a nikvwawehselvki; hathvkihsko hi'a tsinaniweha v v tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki; vv v lhahsko hilvhiyu hi'a yitsikoliye'o'i v tsunahsti tiniyolhi ale tinihsta'i aniholi unukotsvhi tsawathvhtohthanv etsalvkwtotiyi?
tutanvelvkinho, ale katuhv unukotsvki v kwetiniyi wuluhtsvki, ale nanhahahsvlhvki.
sunalenho tikatuhv' wv'akhthv'i akonu uyohsihsanhvki.

ukohvnhoh svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv nvnohulhti, nanhahwuluhtsvki v ahsenho vtla kohuhsti yuwhahthvhe'i, ulahstuhsv uwahsv i hiano nuwehselvki; lhehsti ilvhiyu kohi iyutalenvtv yitsatathanhehsti.  khilakwonho' iyvtv svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv uwhayvhsvki.
kvwhstawatitohinho unikohv unihskwanikohsvki a hi'a nuniwesvki v nalhekvkwo khvyvhi svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv'i!

tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki; utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwesehavi iyunho yitsohiyuha, ale nitsatlahtsithv'ehvna yiki, vlha hiakwoh svkhtha-iyuhsti tluhkv tsinakvka yinvketsathvka v nahskwohskini hi'a yinitsiwehselv hi'a tsotalv, hatanvna, ale amekwohi wetsatuka, ahse nahski iyulhstohti.
nika'vnho kohuhsti itsithayohihehstihi itsatatolihstihskv'i i itsohiyuhvhskehsti, itsiwathihskehsti.

uthvnanho tikalawi'ihstiyikwuluhtsv v nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tsunathvhsonhvhi yvwi anehv kvwaluhtselvki tateyhohvhskv'ihi hia nuniwehsvki; kato tsalhskahstohti hi'a nahski tsitetsalvwhihstaneha?  ale kako tshanetshelvhi?
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki v ayv nahskih sutaleki tatsvyathvtvnhi, iyunho nahski ihskinonhelv nahski ayv tatsvnonheli iyuhsti akwalhskahstohtv'i, hi'a nahski tsitakilvwhihstaneha.

tsani tsitatawohskvki hatlv tsutalenhe'i v kalvlatihsko v yvwikwokhe anehv tsutalenhe'i?  elhaweyinho unatanvhthelhvki, hi'a naniwehskvki; i'yuno kalvlati, yokatvnhv, katonho tla yetsohiyunhe'i?  yokohsi.
iyuno yvwikwo anehv tsutalenhi yokatvnhvai totsihskaihakwo yvwi v nikatvyhenho atolehohski uniyelvha tsani.
uninetsvnho' hi'a nvkvwawhselv tsihsa; vtla yotsikhthaha. v hi'ano nituwehselvki; vlha nahskwo' ayv yvketsvnohvhsi' iyuhsti akwalhskahstohtv'i hi'a nahski tsitakilvwhihstaneha.
ahsenho kato itseliha?'i khilo ahskaya anithali tsuwetsi anihskaya anehe'i v ahsiyvwinho i'kvyi' wuluhtselv v hi'a nuwehsele'ioi akwetsi i hena khohi wititsalvwhihstahsi thelvlti takwhihsv'i.
tsunhetsvno, vlha, utvnhe'i; ahsenho onhi unetliyvhse utanhthv'i, ale uwenvhse'i.
sohno wuluhtshelv nahskiya nuwehsele'i.  tsunetsvnho, takehsi, utvnhe'i; ahsenho nuwenvhsvnakwo ikese'i.

kako hi'a anithali utota unhetsv nutvnele'i ahi ikvyi wuluhtselvhi, vkvwohselvki i v tsihsanho hi'a ntuwehselvki v utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehsehayv atelv anikihsitohi ale tsunatshehsathi anikeyhv unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv waniyvhiha teketsikoniha.

tsaniyhenho tuyukthv' tulvwhihstanehv itsiluhtselvki, ale' vlha yetso'iyunhe'i, atelvhskini anihksitohi ale anikeyhv tsunatshehsathi tsikvwohiyunhvkiai nihinho itsatolehohsv vlha onhi yititsinetliyvhse tetsatanhthv etso'iyuhtiy.

nvwatale talhilohstv itsathvkvka; ehe khilo ahskaya kanela v nahski thelvlatih tuwhihse'i, ale uhsoyhole kvwathuwhitv i ale uhskohse kikake-atithahsti kolhvhthiyi, ahle unehskehe inv ikathi v ale tutholhsthane tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi v invnho wulohse'i.
nhahkwono nahniyu kese unvnhstiyi tunvhse tsunvhsitahsti tlokehsi tsunlvwhihstaneh tinehv'i, tuninehsvhse unatatvnvhi.
tlokehsinho tsunilvwhihstanehi tuninihyvhe tsunhvhsitahsti i ahsiyvwi unilvnhile'i, hso'inho unilhe'i, hso'ino nvya tunvnhsthane'i.
tha'linenho tunvhse nvwanatale tsunvhsitahsti utli' iyani'i; nahskiyakwon nitunvnele'i.
onhiyinho uwetsi unvhse'iai hi'a nuwehse'i; ahse tvnilvkwthani akwetsi.
ahsenho tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstaneh unikohv uwetsi hiha' nitunatawehsele'ihi nahski hi'a utseli iyulhstotihv kha etiluka v ale etiwonv utseli iyulhstohti tsiki.
uniniyvhenho, ale uninukowihse thelvlati tawhihsi, ale unilhe'i.
nhahkwonho nahski thelvlati tawhhsv utselika kaluhtsvhaai kato totakvneli na tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi?
hi'ano nvkvwawehselvki v uyo'iyu nitotakvneli totvlhi nahski na uniyo'i v ale nvwanatale tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi totvtholhsthanivi nahski yeli kvwankhyvti nanvnhsihsv'i.

tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki; lhahsko ilvhiyu yitsikoliye'o hi'a' tsinikvnhv tsikowhela vti ananhehskehski uniyo'ihselvhi nvya nukvwiyuhsv unhvhsiyv ahti nulhsthanv; nahski hia yihwa nutvnelv, ale' uhskwanikhtiyu tetakhanhihskv'i.
nahski iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha v unelhanvhi utselikohi tayetsikisvli v nvwantalenho taketsinelihv nahski yeli kvwaninanukowhihsti utathanvhi.
khilono ni nvyohi alhvtsvha tayuhsonvnhihi khilonho uhsonvha tayuwetawothani.
nhahkwono nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale anikwalihsi unahthvkanv talhilohstihskv'i, unatolehsvki unvhsv ketsitvkv'i.
uniniyhtiyinho unatanhthelhv, unitsathi yvwi tunihskalvkiyv nahskihyenho atolehohski kvwayelvhsvki.
tsihsano unetsv thaline tulhilohstanelvki, hia nuwehsvki;
kalvlati utselikohi nahskiyakwo khilo ukvwiyuhi tsutvnv'ihsthane tsakatsvhstohtiyi uwetsi awinv,
ale tsitunvhse tsunvhsitahsti tsuniyanvhvhstiyi wiketsiyanvtv tekekatshvhstihskv uniluhihstiyi v ahsenho tiuniylvnhekwo nvtayunenvhstiyi.

thalinenho nvwanatale tsunvhsitahsti tunvhse'ivv hi'a nituwehsele'i a hi'a winititsiwehsi wiketsiyanvtv; kvniyukwo akwatvnv'ihsti alhstayvti, tikwatseli wahka ale tikalitsthanvhi tunilhv, nikatiyunho atvnv'ihsthanonhvhi; tekekatsvhstihskv itsiluhki.
ahsenho nvhlsalhikwo tiuniyelvnhe'i, ale utsathinikwo wunilohse'i, ahsiyvwi tsulokehsv'i, so'inho' unhtohtiyi.
anihsohinho tuniniyvhe' tsunvhsitahsti, ale tikvwanihsotlvhthane'i, ale tunilhe'i.
nhahkwonho ukvwiyuhi uthvkanv uthalhawohse'ivv ale tunvhse tsutseli aniyahwski, ale witunilhe nahski tsunatalhvhi, ale wunakohvhsthane' unituhv'i.
nhahkwonho hi'a nituwehsele tsunvhsitahsti; tikekatsvhstohtiyi atvnv'ihsti, ahsenho wiketsiyanvtv vlha yeli yinans unilhsyi.
nahskino' iyuhsti tekanvnhahwatihsv witsilohi, nani'vn tetsiwhahthihskehsti tetsinetsehehsti uniluhihstiyi anhi totkekatsvhsthanihsv'i.
howanho nahski tsunvhsitahsti tekanvnhahwatihsv wunilohse'i, ale unilhihsanhe nani'v tuniwhahthvhv uniyo ale anohstv; nhahkwonho ttikekatsvhsthanihsv yeli' nulhsthanilhe' analhstayvhvhski.
nhahkwonho uyvlhv ukvwiyuhi' tukhthanhilv analihstayvhvhski, ukohe nanhahahsiyvwi nunhuwa'vna kehse tekekatsvhstihskv anhuwohsti.
hano nuwehsele'i; kinali'i v katonho' anhi vhyvlhika nitsanhuwvna iki tekekatsvhstihskv anhuwohsti?  elhaweykwonho kehse'i.

nhahkwonho ukvwiyuhi hi'a ntuwehsele ketsinvhsitahstihv etsalvtsa tsuwoyeni ale tsulahsihteni; ale etsinawitv, ale vtoyititlv tsulhsihkv wetsata'uka.  hnanhahataniyvhkehsti ale taniltakihskehsti taninhtohkv'i.
unitsathiyhenho ketsiyanvtv, ahsenho anikiyolhiyu kekahsuyetv.
nhahkwonho anikwalihsi unenvhsvki wuninhohelhvki iyunatvnhtiyi unihsatvtiyhi kawonihskv'i.

tuninvhsvkinho tsetohv kvwhnstawatitohi ale elotv kvwhstelihski, hi'a nuniwehsvki; thateyhohvhski, otsikhthaha utohiyuhkiya kehsv nihiai ale unelhanvhi utselika tuyukhtv tehateyhohvhskv'i, vlha ale yvwi yithinayehska, vtlayhenho nunahstvkwo yvwi yithilvkwohto'i.
nahski iyuhsti skinohvhsivv kato heliha?  tsisa tuyukhti hsihsa akuyv'ehtiyi ayel akhyvhti kesv'i; tlakhe?
ahsenho tsihsa utolehohsvki uyokwo anatanhthehskv'i, ale hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho' ihskihsatv'vhska'i itsatlonahsti?
tsikowahtv atelv ayelhi akhyvhtohti avv akihsinho tsukvwalhti kvwayhohelvki.
hi'ano nituwehalvki; kako hi'a takatlilohsti, ale kako' atsinoheha hi'a tsikowhela?
sihsa, unatvnhvki.  hi'anho nituwehselvki; sihsa atina etsihvhsi hsihsa utselika, unelanvhino unelhanvhi utselika.
unathvkanvnho unihskwanikohsvki, ale unatanv'elvki.
nahiyu ika anihsatuhsi' tilehihsohti kehsv unatlahtsithv'ehi kvwaluhtselvki, ale kvwahthvtvnhvki,

hi'a nuniwesvki; thateyohvhski, mohsi unhetse hi'a nuwese'i; iyunho ahskaya ayohuhskehsti tsuwetsi nanehvna kehsehsti, tinatanhvlhi atayhekehsti utayhvtv, nahskino tathvhihstanehehsti tiniyolhi tinatanhvlhi.
nahskinho ayv otsehv anehvki kalhkwoki iyanitv anatanhvlhi; utanhilikenho utehsvnhv uyohuhsvkwo, tsuwetsinho nanehvna kehsv iyuhsti utali'i uwekohtanelv unhvlhi.
nahskiya nahskwo tha'line'ihv ale tso'ine'i i kalhkwokine wikvtihski.
ulhskwalthinho akeyhv nahskwo uyohuhsvki.
nahski iyuhsti nhahkwo tsuniyohuhsvhi tanalehihsanhvha, kako utalii kehsehsti nahski kalhkwoki iyanitv kehsv'i?
tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki i itsilitahstiha nitsikhthahvna kesv iyuhsti nuhstv kowhelv'i, ale nulhinikvkv unelhanvhi.
tsuniyohuhsvhihyeno tanalehsanhvha, vlha yitanatehsvhvhsko, vtl ale yitketsiyeko'i; tinikhanhahwatitohihskini kalvlati anehi unelhanvhi tsutseli' nahskiya kehso'i.
tsuniyohuhsvhskininonv unalehihsohti kehsv tsitsine'ihstiha, lhahsko yitsikoliye'o unelhanvhi itsnetselvhi, hi'a tsinikaweha?
ayv unelhanvhi ekwahami utselika, ale unelhanvhi ehsik utslk, ale unelhanvhi tsekakwi utselika.  vlha unelhanvhi tsuniyohuhsvhi unatseli yiki, tinvnhotvkwohskini unvhsv.
unitsathinho unathvkanv unihskwanikohsvki nuhstv tateyhohvhskvi.
anikwalihsihskini unathvkanv elhawey tuwanhv anihsatuhsi, nahski tunilawitsvki.
ahsiyvwhinho nanhahutahsuyvki tikhanhahwatvhsti tikohsihsihski, uthvtvnhvki uhsatv'vhskv'i, hi'a nuwehsvki;
thateyohvhski, kato uhsti utli' kalvkwtiyu ulhinetsv tikhanhahwatvhsti?
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki; yihowa tsanelhanvhi hikeyuhsehsti nika'v tsanawi hvhtihskehsti, ale nika'v tsatanhto, ale nika'v tsatanhthehtiyhi.
nahski hi'a ikvyiy al utsathi kalvkwti tikhanhahwatvhsti.
thalinenho nahskiyakwo nahskwo; tsvhsv tsinitsatakeyuhsv nikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala.
nahski hi'a thali nulhinetsv tulihstayitihsti nikatiyu tikhanhahwatvhsti ale untlhsi.
ahsikwo tanilawi'v anikwalihsivi tsihsa tuthvtvnhvki,
hi'a nuwehsvki; kato itseli etsatanvthehskv kalonetv, kako uwetsi?  tewi, vkvwohselvki.
hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho tikalhstohtiha, tewi atanhto uweyhohvhskv'i, tsakvwiyuhi, tsikohseha?  hi'a tsinikaweha;
yihowa' hi'a nuwehselvki ukvwiyuhi akwatselika; tsikathihsi ititlv tsolhehsti v khvnhi ketsskaki titsalahsihtiyhi kahskilo nikatsiyvnelvha;
iyuyhenho tewi, tskvwiyuhi, yikohseha, kato yikalhstohta uwetsi yiki?
tla nhahakwo yeli' khilo skntsh kvwhanetsehti yikehse'i; tla ale khilo nahiyu iyutalenvtv yeli kakvwathvthti yikehse'i.
nhahkwono tsihsa tuwonhthanvki unitsathi ale kvwhstawatitohi,
hi nuhwesvki; tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi mohsi uwehskilv ani'na;

nahski hiyuhsti nika'v kohuhsti titsikhanhahwatuka ketsohsehehsti tetsikhanhahwatekehsti ale nahski nitsatvnehehsti; ahsenho nahski nanatvnehv'i lhehsti yinitsatvnehehsti; aninhekoyheno ahsenho vlha nahski yinanatvneho'i.
tanatalhitlvhskoyheno' tikaketv tilihsvhsti ale uteyahthohti tilhsvhstiyi, nahskino yvwi taninhatlhvhsko'i; ahseno unvhsv vlha sakwo aniyehsatv yvkvnta yitokvnithelvhvka.
nikatiyuhskini tunilvwhstanehv yvwikwo kvwanikowhahthvhtiyi uniyelvhso'i.  tiyhahthena nitanvneho tsunakvtanohsti, ale taniyhahthv'vhstihsko' tekataluyatv tsunanhuwo;
ale unilvkwto nukvwiyuhsv' tsunanhtlvtiyi tanalhstayvhvhskv'i, ale nukvwiyuhsv tekahskilv tikalawi'ihstiyi,
ale ketsiyolihstiyi tikahntohtiyi, ale thateyohvhski, thateyhohv'hski, kvwanohsetiyi yvwi.
nihihskini lhehsti thateyhohvhski, yetsohsehehsti; ahsiyvwiyhenho titseyhohvhski, nahski kalonetv; nikatvnho' nihi itsalhinvtlikwo.
ale lhehsti khilo etota etsohselvki anhi' elohi v ahsiyvwikwohyehno itsitota, nahski kalvlati tshvtseha.
ale lhehsti skwathinhitohi yetsohsehehsti nihi, ahsiyvwikwohyenho titsathinhitohi, nahski kalonetv.
khilohskini utli atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti nihi itsehv'i, nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti.
khilonho uwahsvkwo atahsalatihskehsti elati iyakvnti kesehsti; khilonho uwahsvkwo elati natatvnehehsti atsihsalatoti kehsehsti.

nihihskini uyo'iyu itsalhstaneti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti! v tetsihstunhehohyenho yvwi kalvlati utselikohi; vlhayhenho itsvsv yitsiyvhiho'i, ale' vlha unnelaki waniyvha yititselihseho waniyvhihi.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti!  tetsihsvnhehoyhenho tsunohsulotsvhi taninelv'i, ale itsatlonahstv kohitiyu itsatatolihstihsko'i.  nahski iyuhsti utlihiyu' ika'i itsikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti!  tetsateyohohyenho amekwohi ale katohi etsiyoho ahsiyvwi nuhsthv itsohiyusv kohiyuhvhski iyetsvnhtiyi v ale nahski netsvka tha'li iyuwakhthi utli tsvhskino'i uwetsi netsvneho ehskakwo itsvhsv.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti, titsikhewi titsatathinhitohi!  hi'a itsiwehski; khilo iahselithvhskehsti ikhaneihstihskehsti uthvnv-tikalawihstiyi, ahsekwokwo nahski; khilohskini ikhane'ihstihskehsti atelv talonike utvna-tiklawistiy ahv'i, nahski' ahstayiyu ututala.
itsineku ale titsikhewi!  kato uhsti utli kalvkwtiyu, atelvhsko talonike'i, uthvna-tikalawihstiyike nahski kalvkwtiyu tsinikvneha atelv talonike'i?
ale, khilo ikhane'ihstihskehsti atsilv-kelhstiyi, ahsekwokwo nahski; khilohskini ikhaneihstihskehsti ahlskolhthanvhi nanhahahv'i, nahski ahstayiyu ututala.
itsineku ale titsikhewi!  kato uhsti utli kalvkwtiyu v alhskohlthanvhihsko, atsilvkhe-kelhstiyi, nahski kalvkwtiyu tsinikvneha ahlskolhthanvhi?
nahski iyuhsti khilo i'ahselithvhskehsti ikhane'ihstihskehsti atsilvkelhstiyi, khane'ihstihskehsti nahski ale nika'v kohuhsti nanhahahv'i.
ale khilo ikhaneihstihskehsti uthvnv-tiklawi'ihstiyi, khane'ihstihskehsti nahski' ale nanhahkhanela.
ale khilo ikhane'ihstihskehsti kalvlati, khane'ihstihskehsti unelhanvhi uwehtiyi ale nanhahuwolhi.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti v v ahskohineyhenho itsakuyihsko svlhi ale ehsv ale kamini; tetsinhohiyahskonho utli ulhsketvya kehsv tikhanhahwatvhsti, tuyukhtv kehsv'i, ale atatolihstiyi v ale kohiyhtiyi.  nahskihskini hi'a yinitsatvnele'iav aleh so'i nitsinhohiyvnakwo yikehse'i.
titsikewi titsatathinhitohi! v tohsv itsinhahsolvhstihski kemilinho itsikihski.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti!av itsohsulehskoyheno' katuititlv ulihskwiti ale athelitovv ahsenho hawinititlv ukhalitsvhi' kehso ahsekwo ataki'ehti kehsi ale tuyukhthv nikehsvna.
hikwalihsi thikhewi! i ikvyi hinvkalv hawinititlv ulihskwiti al athelito, katuititlvnho nahskwo tsutanvkalvtv kehsehsti.

uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti titsowhelihski al itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti!  nahskiyakwoyeno nihi tsunekv itikvnelvhi tatselihstvi, nahski katuititlv utohiyuhi tsuwotuhiyu tsikehso'i, ahsenho awhinititlv tsukhalitsvhi tsikehso tsuniyohuhsvhi tsunikhola ale nika'v kataha kehsv'i
nahskiykwohskini' nahskwo nihi katuititlv' itsatanhthiyu nvwahsto'i yvwi tiketsakhanhtiyi v ahsenho hawinititlv itsikhalitsvhi kehso' itsatlonahstv'i ale uyo'i.
uyo'iyu itsalhstanheti titsowhelihski ale itsikwalihsi itsatlonahsti!vi tetsolhvhihsihskoyeno tekanihsahv anatolehohski, ale tetsotu'ihstihsko' tatselihstv unatanhthi;
hi'anho nitsiwehsko'i; iyunho ayv yotsehe nahiyu tso'kitota tsanehe'i, vlha ytokayotsalikonhele kikv tunatsewelv anatolehohski.
nahski iyuhsti itsvhsv khvnikehsv nitsatatvne nahski titsitota kehsv anatolehohski tsunilhvhi.
itsikhalitsakhoka titsitota unalhilo'v'i.
inatv nihi!  unihskahsehti inatv tsunetsi nihi!  katonho yikalhstohta' yetsatiwhihsi akilhiyo'ihsti tikesv tsvhskino'i?

nahski iyuhsti khvnhiyukwo tetsinvli nanhahtitsehv anatolehohski ale anikhthanhahai ale tinowhelihski; ikatvnho totatsilhi ale totatsatvni tatanhahwhstv'i, ikatvnho totatsilivnhili titsilawi'ihstiyi, ale' uyo nitotatsvneli tekatunhahai;

nahski itsiluhtsehtiyi nikatv ohstv kikv elohi utsewotsvhi, utanhhthi ekwili ukikv nvtakvwatalenvtv, tsekalaya ukikv kwelikaya uwetsi nvtvhsti, nahski tsetsilv utlatnvtv uthvna-tikalawi'ihstiyi atsilvnho-kelhstiyi.
utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha v hi'a nahski nikatv tayunalhiyiloheli hi'a khohi tsaneha.

tsi'luhsilmi!  tsiluhsilimi!  anatolehohski thihihi, ale ketsaluhtsehtiyi ketsinvhsvhi nvya tvnhstihski! v yanokiyu akwatulihskv katsiyalhihsohtiyi titsetsi v nahskiya tsahthaka tsitekalhihsihsko' tsuwetsi anitv tikhanokeni hawinititlv; ahsenho vlha yitsatulihske'i.
kvniyukwo' itsatseli kalhtsote nvtha netsvnelv.
hiayhenho nitsvwehseha; vlha yvkeskikowahthv khohi iyutalenvtv, khvnhi hi'a nitsiwehsvha; atsilvkwotiyu nahski yhowa te'uto'v tsikaluhihstiha.
tsihsanho unukotsvki tikalawi'ihstiyi utanvhsvki, kvwhstawatitohnho kvwaluhtshelv kvwanonhelvki' nituhstv tatanelv uthvnatikalawi'ihstiyi.
tsihsano hi'a nituwehselvki; tlahsko nikatv hi'a yititsikowahthiha?  utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; vlha sakwohunv nvya anhi yitutahsahlhahehsti nahski nikohvhthanvna yikehsehsti.

oliwayonho uhsahilhv uwolhv'i kvwahstawatitohi unvhsv kesv kvwaluhtselvki, hi'a nuniwesvki; skinohvhsi hilako' iyu hi'a nahski nvtakalhsthani; ale kato uhsti uyelhtv kehsehsti tsaluhihstiyi, ale khohi kehsv ulhskwatihstiyi?
tsihsano unhetsv hi'a ntuwehselvkiav itseyahthahehsti lhehsti khilo tsitsilonuhelhi;
unitsathehstiyhen ayv takwato'v ani'luhihstihskehsti, ayv kalonetv, anatihskehsti v ale unitsathahsti tanilonuhehskehsti.

ale itsathvkihskehsti tanhahawa ale aninhohelhitohv tanhahya; itseyahthahehsti lhehsti uwelihihsti yinitsalihstanhelehsti; nahskiyeno nikatiyu ase iyulhstohti v ahsenho ulhskwatihstiyi kehsv asi kehssti.
tsunatalenhvtvyeno yvwi totvnalenhi totvnatatluthani v ale ayelhi tunolhvwhatihsv totvnatatluthani v ale takonulohsitohehsti, ale vyhukihyu nikalhsthanitohehsti, ale katohi talihthelvnhitohehsti.
nahski hi'a nikatv alenihskv kehsv akilhiya kehsv'i.
nhahkwonho nihi witotaketsiyohsi itsikilhiyo'ihstiyiav ale totaketsilhi; ale nikatiyu nunatalehsv yvwi ketsihskakehsti ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti.
nhahkwonho unitsathehsti tunotehihehsti, ale tanatatlutihskehsti ale tanatahskakehsti.
ale unitsathehsti unatlonahsti anatolehohski aninanukokehsti, ale unitsathehsti tanilonuhehskehsti.
ale utsathv ahskanv'ihsti kehsv ehv nahski' iyuhsti unitsathehsti atakeyhti kehsv unehv tvyhvtlatti.
ahsenho nahski na kvlhskwatihski alhinikvnehi nahski atsihstelhti kehsehsti.
hiano nahski ohstv khanohetv kalvlati utselikohi elanikhv unalitsitonnitahsti kehsehsti unatolehohihstiyi nani'v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi, khilanho nhahkwo tvlhskwatilhi.
nahski iyuhsti nhahkwo itsikohvha uhska'ihstiyu kvnohsatvhi ikvnehiuv nahski tenili atolehohsk tsunhesthane'ihv katokehsti kalvkwtiyu kehsv'i, v khilo akoliyehskehsti kolhkehsti,)
nhahkwo tsutiyi' anini analihsvha totsotalv wanilohsvha.
khilon kahsanali ukhi'lehsti lhehsti yvtiutlo'ahsehsti yukihsolhehsti kohuhsti uhv kanelv'i;
ale khilo tlokehsi wetohi lhehsti yvtiutsvhsehsti tsunhuwo yitunehsolhehsti.
ale uyo'iyu iyunalhstanehti tininelitv ale tsunihsta'i nahiyu kehsv'i.
ale itsatatolihstihskehsti itsithayohihehsti kola ale unatotakwahskv itsalihstiyi nikehsvna iyulhstohtiyi.
nahiyuyheno utsathehsti akilhiya, nahski ika'i vlha ilvhiyu yinulhsthano elohi tsutolhvnv nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi, vlha ale ilvhiyu nahski iyulhstohti yikehsehsti.
ale nahiyu ika nitahskwalhanvna yiki, vlha ukwetalhi kayetsihstelhti yikaki v ahsenho kekahsuyetv kehshv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti nahiyu ika tihskwalhti ksesti
nahiyu kehsv iyunho khilo hi'a nitsiwehsehehsti, kvnhiyukwo' anhi kalonetv etohahi ale' anhi; lhehsti tsitsohiyunhi

tvninanukotsihyeno unatlonahsti kalonetv ale unatlonahsti anatolehohski, ale aninanukowhihskehsti kalvkwtiyu uyelhtv ale uhskwanikhti; nahski iyuhsti iyunho yeli ikvwalhstohti yiki yitanilonuhvli nahskwo kekahsuyetv.
kvnhiyukwo nitsvnonhelv.
nahski iyuhsti iyunho hi'a niketsiwehselvha; inake etoha; lhehsti nanhahwitsilosvki; kvnhiyukwo utelihsv khanvhsulv' aya; lhehsti tsitsohiyunhi.
anakalihskihyeno tikhalvkv tsvtikannukoko'i, wutelikvnho iyvtv tsiwitkalvhsattihsko'i, nahskiya nahskwo nuhstehsti yvwi uwetsi kaluhtslvha.
ilvhtlvyenho kohuhsti uliwhotsvhi tsikano'i v nanhahawohali anatalhihsihsko'i.

ikvwenvtakwo' onhi nahski nahiyu akilhiya kalohsonhvhaav nvto' ika ehi tvlhsihvhsivv ale nvt hsvnoyi' ehi vlha ika yuthihstehstiav ale nokwsi tvninvko'ahsi, ale unitsathi kalvlohi tsanikhala tvnalhthelvnhi.

nhahkwonho kalvlo'i tkananukotsi yvwi uwetsi utseli uyelhtv'i, ale nhahakw nikatv tanilhstalhv elohi totvniyvlsi, ale tvnikohi yvwi uwetsi tsa'ihsehsti ulokilv kalvlo'iav ulhniktiyu kehs ale utsathi kalvkwtiyu kesv unhuwohstehsti.
nhahkwonho totakanvhsi tsunvhsitahsti v ale ahstayiyu tvnitselhuhihsi, ale totvnilhihsanhi kekahsuyetv nvhki nitotikalohskv unole, kalvlo' iyvtv witulhsthinilhv.
kha, itsatelhohkwa talhilohstv svkhthaiyuhsti tluhkv'i; iyuyheno tuwanikalhv' titake nitekalhstha, ale khila'i tsikalhstuhvhsko'i, itsikthaho koki na'vnhiyu kesv'i.
nahskiyahskini nahskwo nihi, iyunho nhahkwo hi'a nahski tsutalenhvtv itsikohvha i itsikhthahehsti ehskanhiyu kehsvi, kalohihstiyikwo kesv'i.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; hi'a khohi tsaneha vlha yvtvnilohsonhi, khvni nikatv hi'a tsutalenhvtv nikalhsthanvha.
kalvlo' ale elohi totakalohsonhivv ayvhskini akhinetsv'i vlha yvtakalohsonhi.
ahsenho nahiyu ika kehsv ale iyulhilotv khalawatisv vlha khilo yakhthaha, lha nahskwo tinikhanhahwatitohi kalvlati anehi i etotahskini uwahsvhiyu.
nahskiyhenho tsinuhste nahiyu noya tsehe'i, nahskiya nuhstehsti yvwi uwetsi kaluhtsvha.
nahiyhuhenho' ahsi nikanohukihskvna tsikehshe'i, tanalihstayvhvhske'i, ale tanatithahske'i v ale tanatesvhvhske'i ale teketsiyeke'i, khvni nahiyu ika noya utsanv tsiyuhi,
ale nanelihskvna tsikehse'iav khvnhi unohukanilhv, ale nikatv tunikvtsvvi nahskiyakwohskini nahskwo nuhstesti yvwi uwetsi kaluhtsvha.
nhahkwonho anithali tlokehsi anetohehsti, ahsiyvwi atsiyanvhti kehsehsti so'inho atsikhahiyahsti kehsehsti;
anithali anikeyhv anihstoskehsti ahstohskiyiav ahsiyvwi' atsiyanhti kehsehsti so'inho atsikhahiyahsti kehsehsti.
nahski iyuhsti itsiyahwskehsti, vlhayheno' yitsikhthaha iyukwo uluhihstiyi itsatseli ukvwiyuhi.
hianho itsanhthehsti, iyunho ahskaya kanela yi'akhthahe iyukwo kanohskihski uluhihstiyi, yuyahwse'i, ale' vlha unelaki wakiyvhsi kalhtsote yikvwelise'i.
nahski iyuhsti nihi nahskwo itsatvnv'ihstehsti, nitselihskvnakwhyeno kesv iyu yvwi uwetsi takaluhtsi.
kakokhenho akalhiya ale hsinahsani atsinvhsitahsti, nahski unvhsitohi nukvwiyuhshv' iyuwanelvhi kanelv tutathinhahai, nahski unalhstayvhti tsunhehtiyi unalhstayvhtiyi nikalhsthanihsv'i?
ohsiyu iyulhstanhehti nahski na atsinvhsitahsti unvhsitohi kaluhtsvha uwahthvhvha nahski natvnehv'i.
utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha; nikatv unhahai tvkhthitihsthani.
iyuhskinino nahski na unekutsitv atsinvhsitahsti hi'a nikawehskehsti tsutanhtv'i; akinvhsitohi kohitiha uluhihstiyi;
ale alenihskehsti tokalvnhihehsti itsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti, al itsulaha analhstayvhvhskehsti ale tanatithahskehsti tsuniyhvhstehski,
nahski atsinvhsitahsti unvhsitohi takaluhtsi nahiyu ika natkhthenohvna kehsv'i, ale iyuh nelihskvna kehsv'i,
ale totayukalhsi, ale unatlonahsti wanehv wvtayuhseheli; nanhahtaniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhtohkv'i.
nhahkwonho kalvlati' ehi ukvwiyuhi kesv nahskiya kehsehsti hskohi iyanitv anathv, nahski tsituninvhse titsvhstohti ale tsitunatlohsvhse atehsvhvhski.
hihskinho iyanitv anikhthanhahi kehse'i i hihskinho unineku.
unineku tuninvhse titsvhstohti ahsenho ko'i nunintsvhsvna kehse'i,
anikhthanhahahskini tuninvhse tsunitsvhstohti v ale nahskwo ko'i uninehtsvhse tunitlihsthane' tithelito.
ahsinho ukonhiyoke atehsvhvhski v nikatv anilhinvke'i, ale unilhinvtse'i.
svnoyihno ayelhi khilo ahstaya unhetse'i, hi'a nuwehse'i; kvniyukwo atehsvhvhski taya'i!  witetsa'tlo'i!
nhahkwono nikatv' anathv unatitanehse'ihv ale tunitshinohskalvhe tunitsvhsthv'i.
uninekunho hi'a nituniwehsele anikhthanha'hahi; ikat ko'i itsatseli skine'vhsi v tokhtlo'hihsehayhenho tokitsvhsthv'i.
ahsenho anikhthanhahi uninhetsv hi'a nuniwehse'i; lhake yeli yitokekiyelika nikatv, itsenakwohskini tininhtihskv'i itsvhsv witsiwhahi.
uniwhahsenvnho atehsvhski uluhtse'i v unatvnv'ihstinho nahski itsulaha tsakatsvhstohtiyi wuniyvlhe'i, ale unihstunhe kalohihstiy.
onhno naskwo anihso'i anatv uniluhtse'ihv hi'a nuniwehse'i; tsakvwiyuhi, tsakvwiyuhi, ehskihstuki.
ahsenho tsunhetsv hi'a nuwehse'i; utohiyuhya itsvyoseha, vlha yitsvkathaha.
nahski iyuhsti itsiyahwskehsti, vlhayheno yitsikhthaha nahiyu ika kehsv ale iyulhilotv khalawatihsv uluhihstiyi yvwi uwetsi.
nahskiyakwoyheno khilo ahskaya inv tsiwvtikalohsihse'iai ale tsiwituyhanvhe tsunvhsitahstivv ale tsituyohihsele unhahai.
ahsiyvwhinho hihski iyakayvli atelv tunhele'i, so'inho thali iyakayvli v so'inho hsakwo iyakayvli i anihsiyvwiha nahski yeli ikvwantvnhti kehsv'i.  nhahakwonho unhikise'i.
nhahkwonho hihski iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvhse wunohthane'iav hihskino iyakayvli unehkwotsele'i.
nahskwo ale na tha'li iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi nahskwo thali iyakayvli unehkwotsele'i.
sakwohskini iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvhsei, wuhskoha katohiav ale wituwahskalhane unalha'i tsutseli atelv.
ilvhyunho' iyvtv uluhtse nahski ketsinvhsitahsti uninalha'i v ohstvnho nunvnele'i.

hihskinho iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uluhtse'i, ale tuyolhe nvwanatale hihski iyakayvli atelv, hia nuwehse'i; skinalha'iuv hihski iyakayvli atelv tehskiyohihselvki o kvnhiyukwo nvwanatale hihski iyateyvli kvkinehkwotselv.

unalha'inho hi'a nuwehsele'i v ohsiyu! v hohstv ale hikalhiya etsanvhsitahsti!  tuyukhtv' nitsatvnelv uhsti tsutalenhvtv tetsalvwhihstanelv'i; utsathi tsutalenhvtv tsakvwiyuhsateki nvtakvyvneli; hiyvha ohstv atanhtatihstiyi tsanalhi utselikohi.
nahskwonho thali iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uluhtsv hi'a nuwehse'i; skinalha'i, tha'li iyakyvli atelv tehskiyohihselvki; kvniyukwo nvwanatale thali iyakayvli kvkhinehkwotselv.

unalha'i hiha nuwehsele'i v ohsiyu!  hohstv ale hikalhiya etsanvhsitahsti!  tuyuhkthv nitsatvnelv uhsti tsutalenhvtv' tetsalvwhihstanelv'iai utsathi tsutalenhvtv tsakvwiyuhsateki nvtakvyvneli v hiyvha ohstv atantatihstiyi tsanalha'i utselikohi.

nhahkwono hsakwo iyakayvli' tsatsinelvhi uluhtsv ha nuwese'i v skinalha'i v kvkathahvki i hihstayiyu kehsv'i, ale hihskutehskv'i nanhahanitsawihsvna kehsv'i, ale huthehskv'i nanhahnitsalelatvnvna kehsv'i.
ale tsihska'ihv'i akwenvhsvki, witakvhskalhanvki katohi atelv titsatselika; kvnhiyukwo' anhi nahski titsatselika.
unlha'inho unhetsv hia nuwehsele'i v tsanekutsitv ale tsatanulhti etsanvsitahsti! hikhthahvki tsihskutehskv nanhahnakhiwhihsvna kehsv'i, ale kuthehskv nanha hanakilelatvnvna kesv'i!
atelv tinihskwanikotihskiyi yiwtotsane atelv tikwatselika, nahskinho kohi tsitsi'luhki yitakikohe tikwatseli ale uninehkwotsvhi.
nahski iyuhsti tsito'etsikihsikwo hsakwo iyakayvli atelv, ahskohinho' iyakayvli tsuhi tsetsi'vhsi.
khiloyheno uhehsti atsinehti kehsehsti, utsathino uhskwanikotehsti; khilohskini nuhvna kehsehsti atsikietikwo kehsehsti nahski nahskwo' uhv'i.
hi'anho kohuhsti' hktohti nikehsvna kanvhsitahsti toyititlv tsuhlsihkv wetsata'uka; nanhahtaniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtaki'hskehsti taninhtohkv'i.
iyun nhahakwo yvwi uwetsi kaluhtsvha uwahsv utselikahi kalvkwtiyu kehsv unhuwohstehsti'v ale nikatv ketsilvkwoti tinikhanhahwatitohi tathinhehehsti, nhahkwo takanhi kalvkwtiyu uwehskilv'i;
ikvyititlvnho totaketsilawiti nikatiyu nunatalehsv yvwi, ale totvkalehnthani nahskiya awhi-tikthiya tsitakalenhtihsko tsutseli' awhi uninotena ale awhi tinihanulvhi.
hwinho uninotena akhthihsi ititlv totakakhohthani, awhinho tinihanulvhi akhskani ititlv;
nhahkwono ukvwiyuhi' hi'a nitotakawehseli akhthihsi ititlv anitona'i; etsena, etota' itsilvkwthanvhi'i itsatseli winikalhsta utselikohi etsalihskohlvtanelvhi elohi tsutolhvnhv nvtakvwatalenvtv.
akonuyheno akiyohsihskvki i vhskiyelahsthanvnho i akhthatekihskvki, vhskiunvnho v nvkikhthahvna kesvki, vhskiyvthanvki;
akiyelvha kehsvki, tohskinuwo'vkinho v akhtlvkvkivv vhskiyakathanhilhvkinho v titahstutiyhi vkhstuhvki, vhskiwahthvhilhvkinho.
nhahkwonho unatanhthi tvninhetsi hi'a ntakvwawehseli; tsakvwiyuhi, hilakiyu itsvkosv tsayohsihske'i v itsvyelahsthane'nho; ale tsathatekihske'i, itsvunenho;
ilakiyu itsvko'e netsakhthahvna v itsvythanenho; ale tsayelvha kehse'i, itsvnuwo'enho;
ale hilakiyu itsvko'e tsatlvke'i v ale titahstutiyi etsahstuhe'i, itsvykathanhilhe'nho?
ukvwiyuhinho takhanetsi hi'a nitotakawehseliii utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha v nahskiyheno' tsinetsatvnhelv uhstikhanhi ha nahski otsalhinvtli i ayv nihskiyatvnhelvki.
hi'anho nahskwo nitotakawehseli akhskani' ititlv anitona'i; hskiyatanvhsi, etsihskatsvhi a winahsthvna atsilvyi tikesv witsilohi v nahski' ahskina ale tsutse'li tinikhanhahwati'tohi kkolhvnanelvhi.
akonuyhenho akiyohsihskvki, vtlahno yihskiyelahsthane'i'; akhthatekihskvki, vtlhno yihski'une'i;
nvkikhthahvna kehsvki, vtlhno yihskiyvthane'i; akiyelvha kehshvki, vtlahno yitihskinuwo'e'i i akhtlvkvki', ale titahstutiyi vkhstuhvki, vtlahno yihskiwahthvhilhe'i.

nahskwonho nahski tvninhetsi, hi'a nvtakvwawehseli a tsakvwiyuhi, ilakiyu itsvko'e tsayohsihske'i v ale tsathatekihske'i v ale netsakhthahvna kese'i, ale tsayelvha kehse'i, ale tsatlvke'i, ale titahstutiyi etsahstuhe'i v nitsvhstelhvnnho kehse'i?
nhahkwonho takhanetsi hi'a nitotakawehseli; utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha v nahskiyhenho netsatvnhelvna kehsv uhstikhani hi'a nahski, ayv' vlha yinihskiyatvnhele'i.
hi'anho nahski whinahsthvna akilhiyo'ihstiyi tikehsv wvtvnilohsi; unatanhthihskini winahstvna kvnhitv tikehsv'i.
hi'ano nulhsthanvki, nahski tsihsa uhskwatv nikatv hi'a nahski nikawehskv'i, hi'a nituwehselvki kwahstawatitohi;
itsikhthaha tha'li' iyuhsvhi khanohiyeki tilhstayhtiyi kehsv'i, ale yvwi uwetsi tsakatluthanihsv akatvtiyi.
nhahkwonho tunilawitse nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale tinowhelihski ale tinilawiki anehv yvwi, kanelv nukvwiyuhsv atsilv akelhohi' khayakwa tsuto'itv;
uninhohelhenho kalonuhetv unhtohtiyi uniniyhtiyi tsihsa, ale unihihstiyi.
ahsenho hia nuniwehse'i; lhehsti tilhstayvhtiyi kehsv'ihv nahiyuhyenho yiki utsathi yanalhthelvhvka yvwi.
tsihsanho kwetiniyi etohv'i, sawani atayhehski utlvki kanelv'i,
uluhtshelvki akeyhv ayhehvki kuku nvya unekv kolhvhthanvhi atlihstvki utsathi tsukvwalhti atloneti, ale ulonethanvki ahskholi kanhkv alihstayvhvhskv'i.
kvwhstawatitohinho kvwakohv unithalhawohsvki, hi'a nuniwehsvki; katonho hi'a tsatsewoki?
hiayheno atloneti yunatinvhse utsathi yitukvwalhane'i, ale nahski uyo iyunatvnhhateki tinhehti yikehse'i.
tsihsanho utolehohsv, hi'a nituwehselvki; katonho ietsateyahthohti akeyhv?  ohsiyuhyenho tulvwhihstahsi tsinakwvka.
uyoyhenho iyunatvnhahteki nikohilv ketselatitoha, ayvhskini' vlha nikohilv yitsvyelatitoha.
hiayhenho atloneti tsiyelv'i tsakiloneta, vkinihsohtiyi akwatvnv'ihstiha.
utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; analhtsitonhitolvha hi'a ohstv khanohetv ilvhitlv elanikhv'i, nahskwo hi'a akeyhv tsinatvka uninhohehti kehsehsti, nahski akanvtatihstohti.
nhahkwonho ahsiyvwi thalatu iyanitv kehsv'i, tsutahsi ihskalati tsuto'itv, nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi wituluhtsele'i,
hi'a winituwehsele'i; kato tahskineli ayvnho totatsvyohihseli?  tso'ahskohino ayelhi-atelv tekvwahsahstanele'i.
nahiyukwonho ulenvhvki uyholv iyutvnhtiyi ulonuhehtiyi.
ikvyiyikwonho ika nakothanvna katu akihstiyi kehsv kvwhstawatitohi kvwaluhtshelv tsihsa, hi'a nikvwawehselvki, hatlv tsatuliha okatvnv'ihstohtiyi tsalhstayvhtiyi khanohiyeki.

hi'anho nuwesvki; itsena tikatuhv'i, nanhahtsehv ahskaya, hianho natsiwehselvha; titeyohvhski hi'a nikaweha; nhahkwo akihskwalv'eliti, kvkhstawatitohi hinelv tayotsihskwanikothani khanohiyeki tilhstayhtiyi kehsv'i.
kvwahstawatitohinho nuhstv tsihsa tunhetselv nahski nunatvnelvki, ale ohstv nunvnelvki khanohiyeki tilhstayvhtiyi.
uhsvnho nulhsthanv unahntlvnvki [tsihsa] thalatu iyanitv kvwahstawatitohi
analihstayvhvhskvno hi'a nuwesvki; utohiyuhya hi'a nitsvwehseha; hi'a tsinitsatvnhv hsakwo utahsuya tvkwatluthani.
utsathinho uyo'iyu uniyelvnhvki, ale unalenvhvki anihsiyvwiha hi'a nikvwawehselvki; tsakvwiyuhi, tsiko' ayv?
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwesvki; itsulaha tsohstahsuwhihska athe'litokihi nahski tvkwatluthani.
yvwi uwetsi a'i nuhstv kowheli atsinohehskv'i; ahsenho uyo'iyu iyulhstanhehti nahski ahskaya awi uwetsi atlutihski.  ohsiyu yikehse nahski ahskaya nutenhvnakwo yikese'i.
tsutahsinho atatlutihski unhetsv hia nuwesvkihv thateyhohvhski, tsiko' ayv ahi hi'a nuwehselvki; yeli nhiwi.
anlhstayvhvhskvno tsihsa katu ukihsvki, ale ulihelitsvki, ale ukvhaluyhvki, ale tunhelv kvhwstawatitohi, hi'anho nuwehsvki; itsiki, itsika, hi'a nahski ayv tsiyelv'i.
ulihskwitinho ukisv ale ulihelitsv tunenhelvki, hi'a nuwehsvki; nitsi'v itsatitha;
nahskiyhenho hi'a akikikv itse khanohet tatlohihstv'i, nahski unitsathi tsikkatsewelv, kaketsinehtiyi unihskanvtsv'i.
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; vlha ilvhiyu khohki iyutalenvtv yvkakatitha hi'a thelvlati unanukowhihsvhi, khvnhi nahiyu ika itsulaha itse itatithahvha etota utselikohi.
tuninhokihsvnho tikhanokihsti uninukotsvki, oliwayo'i uhsahilhv wunilohsvki.

nhahkwono tsihsa hia ntuwehselvki; nihi nitsi'v totatsotelhi khohi hsvnoyi tsiki, ayv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti.  hiayheno nikvnhv ikowhelati tatsiyvniliy'awhi-tikhthiya, awhinho unatatluhkv tvnatikaleyotsi.
ahsenho tikwalenvhi kehsehsti ikvyi nvtatsvyenveli kelili.
kwita unhetsv hi'a nuwehselvki; nahskwo nikatv yitunotelhv nihi yinvtikalhstohtiha, ahse ayv' vlha yitokvkwoteka.
tsihsanho ha nuwehselvki; utohiyuhiya hi'a nikvwehseha; khohikwo hsvnoyi tsiki ahsi tsathaka naniyvhkvna kehsehsti tso'i nvtahskwatayli.
kwitanho hia nuwehselvki; nahskwo itsulaha tiyiniyohuhihsti yiki, ahse' vlha yvkakvyatayika.  nahskiya nahskwo nikatv kvwstawatitohi nahski nuniwehsvki.
nhahkwonho tsihsa ale khwstawtitohi uniluhtsvki kehsimini tuto'v'i, hi'ano nituwehselv kvwhstawatitohi; anhi itsinehsti' khvnhi itlv wikatatolihsthanvha.
tuthinhvhsvkinho kwita ale anithali tsekwiti tsuwetsi, ale ulenvhe ehihsti utanhtate'i, ale utsathi kaketiyu nulhstanhele utanvhthv'i.
nhahkwono hi'a nituwehsele'i; akwatanvthv ukhalitsvhi utsathi ehihsti kehsi ayohuhihsti kesv ika'i.  anhi itsinehsti ale itsulaha itiyahwskehsti.

uhstikhitvnho uttitlstoti iyvtv wuluhtse'i, ale uliyhahsthune'i, ale utatolihsthane'i, hi'a nuwehse'i; etota, iyunho yeli ikvwalhstoti kesehsti wakilohihsikwo hi'a ulihskwiti; vlhahskininonv ayv nuhstv katanvthehskv'i, nihihskini.
kvwahstawatitohinho ani'nv ti'uluhtsv tuwhahthvhe anilhine'i, hianho nuwehsele kwita; katokwo, thlahsko tsiyawihskv hsakwo iyulhilotv ikohitv ketsiyawhihsti yiki?
itsiyahwskehsti ale itsatatolihstihskehst nski utakoliyetiyi kehsv witsinanuko'ihstiyi nikehsvna kehsv'i.  atanhto utohiyuh utvnv'ihsti, ukwetalhvhskini wanakalahiyu.
thalinenho uwenvhsi, wutatolihsthane'i, hi'a winuwehse'i; etota, iyunho hi'a ulihskwiti kvkilohihsetikwo nikehsvna yiki, khvnhi' yakwatithahv, nuhstv hatanhthehskv winikalhsta.
ti'uluhtsvnho tuwhahthvhe tha'line anilhina'e'i, tinikhtholiyhenho tikaketiyu kehse'i.
thalinenho tuwvhtetse ale utanvhse'i, ale tso'ine wutatolihsthane'i, nahskiya winuwehse'i.

nhahkwonho tiuluhtsv kvwahstawtitohi ani'nv'i, hi'a ntuwehsele'i; nhhakwo itsilhinvki ale itsiyawehsolvka; kvnhiyukwo iyu kehsv uhskwalvhiti, yvwinho uwetsi akatluthanv uninekutsitv yvwi teketsiyohihselv.
titsalehvka!  ita'ihsehsti!  kvnhyukwo akwo taya'i akwatlutihski.

ahsikwonho kawonihskvi khvnhiyukwo tsutahsi ahsiyvwi thalatu iyanitv kesv uluhtsvki, ale tathinhehvki unitsathi yvwi, ayelhsti-tikanvhitv ale ata tininehi, nvtakvninvhsitv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilvanelhohi tinilawiki anehv yvwi.
utlutihskinho tsunhonhelvhi kehse unatolehohihstohti hi'a iyuwehsvhi kese'i; khilo tsiyathutsalhanvha nahski kehsehsti, ahstaya tetsiniyvhha.
ulhihstiyunho tsihsa katokv uluhtsvki, hia nuwehsvki; thohiyi tenatakowathv, skinalha'i; ale uthutsalhanvki.
tsihsanho hia nuwehselvki; kinali'i, katonho vhi'luhki.  nhahkwonho uniluhtsvki ale tekvwahsihthatvki tsisa, kvwaniyvhvki.
ale kvnhiyukwo ahsiyvwi tsisa anehi uhsaltanvki khanokeni ulvhvki hayelhsti-kanvhitv, ale uluyhv ukvwiyuhi atsilv-kelhohi unvhsitahsti, ale ulihstehsthanvki.
nhahkwono tsihsa hi'a nuwehselvki; kalatihstiyi tsihilata tsatselih ayelhstikanvhitv, nikatvyhenho ayelhsti-kanvhitv aniyihski hayelhsti-kanvhitv tsuniyohuhihstohti kehsehsti.
tlahsko yhatanhtheha yeli katsiyatatolihstanehti kesv etota, khilakwono iyvtv vlha thalatukwo iyunatalhki tinikhanhahwatitohi yitokvkikhahsi?
ahsenho kato yikalhstohta yatohiyuhvka nuhstv kowhelv'i, ahse nahski iyulhstohti tsiki?

nahiyunho tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvki unitsathi; tsiko kanohskihski tsitsiyhoho nahskiya itsiluhki hskiniyvhika, hayelhstitikanvhitv ale ata titsinehi?  nituktsvnhihsv itsulaha itinvki tekateyohvhskvki uthvna-tiklawihstiy, vhtlanho yihskiniyihske'i.
ahsenho nikatv nahski hi'a nulhsthanvki utohiyuhtiyi antolehohski unowhelanvhi.  nhahkwono nikatv kvhwstawatitohi kvwahtetsvki ale unalihsvki.
tsihsanho uniniyvtv khayakwo'i wunahthinhvhsthanvki nahski nukvwiyuhsv atsilvkelhohi, nanhahtinowhelihski ale tinilawiki tanilawi'v'i.
kwitanho uhstawatvhse ke iyvtv tsa'ihse nukvwiyuhsv atsilv-kelhohi tikanelv kvtihski, uyvlhe'i, ale ketsinvhsitahsti itsulaha ani'ne'i, ukowatty uylvhse wahlskwthhi.
nunihkv'wiyusvnohoatsilv-anelhohi ale tsunathvhsonhvhi ale nikatv tinilawiki uniyole kayhkoki uninohelhvhi tsihsa utlutihski, nahski unihihstiyi unatulihske'i;
ahsenho unatlohtsekwo; unitsathehskininonv kayhkoki aninohehski uninanukotse'i, ahsenho unatlohtsekwo.  onhiyihskininonv anithali kayhkoki aninhohehski uniluhtse'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i;
hi'a nituwehsvki; yelikwo yitsiyohsta unelhanvhi utseli uthvna-tikalawi'ihstiyi, tso'ikwonho tsutotakwatv [tha'line] yvkanehskvli.
nukvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-kelhohi tulenhe'i, hia nuwehsele'i; tlahsko yhinheka?  kato hi'a anikhthahv tsaninhoheha tsiketsatlutiha?
ahsenho tsisa elhaweyikwo kehshe'i.  nukvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-kelhohi iunhetsv hi'a nuwehsele'i; kvhlayohsi unelhanvhi kvnhitv hineihstohtiyi, hskinohvhsi, tsiko nihi kalonetv unelhanvhi uwetsi?
tsihsano hia nuwehsele'i; yeli nhiwi.  ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha; ilvhiyu tayetsiko'i yvwi uwetsi akhthihsi ititlv ulhinikvkv uwolhehsti, ale tsa'ihsehsti ulokilv kalvlo'i.
nhahkwono nukvwiyuhsv atsilv-kelhohi tunhuwa'v tuwetsakalvhe'i; ahsotlv'ihsta, utvnhe'i; katonho ahsi anikhthahi yaninhoheha?  khvnhiyukwo nhahkwo itsathvkvka ahsotlv'ihstihskv'i.
kato itseliha?  uninhetsvnho hi'a nuniwehse'i; yelikwo kvwayohuhihsti.
nhahkwonho ukhathv tunalitsihskwe'i, ale ahskwinhv tekvwanhstihske'i ale anihso'i tsunoyeni tekvwanhstihske'i,
hi'a naniwehske'i; skiyatoleohihsi, kalonetv, kako tsitsvnhka?
kwita'nho uwolhe utlatnvtv'i, uluhtselenho athv hia nuwese'i; nihi nahskwo stetohvki tsihsa kelili' ehi.
ahsenho nikatv anikhthahv utayhile'i, hia nuwehse'i; vlha yitsikathaha niwehskv'i.
toyitlvnho wulohsv nvwatale ukohe'i, ale hi'a nituwehsele nanhahanetohi; nahskwo hi'a tsihsa nahselithi ehi tanetohvki.
thalinenho utayhile'i, unelhanvhi unhe'ihsthane'i; lha yitsikathaha na ahskaya, utvnhe'i.
khohyinho iyvtv kvwaluhtshele na'v anitona'i, hi'a nikvwawehsele kwita; utohiyuhi nahskwo nihi itsetolvhi, hiwonihskvyhenho kvnikehsv nitsvneha.
nhahkwonho ulenvhe uhskinvte'i, ale unelhanvhi unhe'ihsthane'i; lha yitsikathaha na ahskaya, utvnhe'i; khilakwonho iyvtv tsathaka uyvlhse'i.
kwitanho unhtate tsihsa unhetsvhi, hi'a tsinuwehsele'i; ahsi tsathaka nanyvhkvna kehsehsti tso'i nvtahskwatayili.  unukotsvnho ehihsti witutloyhile'i.
hsunalenho nulhsthanv v nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsil-anelhohi ale tinilawiki anehv awi uninhohelhe iyunhahtvnetihyi tsisa unihistiyi.
nhahkwonho unalhvlv unelihsanawitvhe'i, kwanitv kwaleti ukvwiyuhi wituniyohihsele'i.

nhahkwonho tsutahsi nahski ulonuhelhvhi utolehohsv takukotanelv'i unetliyvhse utanhthv'i v ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi alehv tsunathvhsonhvhi to'uyhohele tso'ahskohi ayelhi-atelv tsunakvwalhohti,
ha nuwehse'i; tsihskanvki nuhskanvtsvna kikv tsikatluta.  hi'anho nuniwehse'i; kato nahski ayv okhthohti?  tsvhsv nahski titsalvwhihstahsi.
ale tutinv atelv nanhahtikalawihstiyi v ale unukotse'i, ale iyvtv wulohsv v uwahsv wutatvne'i.
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-anelhohi tunikihsv atelv hi'a nuniwehshe'i; vlha tuyukhtv yikaki atelv-tihtiyi yititihvhska, kikvyhenho tsukvwalhanvhi.
uninhohelhvnho, uniwhahihsthane' vthi tikolhvhski ulokehsv'i nanhahanetohi tiketsinihsohtiyi.
nahski iyuhsti nahski tlokehsi kikv ulokehsv anohseha khohi tsiki.
nhahkwonho utohiyunhe tsunhetse tselimaya atolehohski, hia tsinuwehse'i; ale tunikisvki' tsohskohi ayelhi-atelv nsk n tskwthnvh, nski tsatsikvwalothanvhi, ihsili tsuwetsi tsunikvwalhthanvhi,
ale uniwhahihsthanvki vthi tikolhvhski ulokehsv'i, nahskiya yihowa akweyhonhv'i.
tsihsanho katoke ikvyititlv ukvwiyuhi uwolhv'i. e ukvwiyuhnho uthvtvne'i, hi'a nuwehse'i; nihihsko tsakvwiyuhi anitsuhs unatselika? v tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i; yelinhiwi.
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv-anelhohi ale tinilawikih kvwahyilitolv vlha yunhetse'i.
nhahkwonho kwaleti hi'a nuwehsele'i; tlahsko yhahthvkiha nika'v khvnikehsv nanvnehv anikhthahi ketsatlutihski?
ahsenho vlha hsakwunv yinunhetse'i, nahski iyuhsti ukvwiyuhi utsathi uhskwanikohse'i.
tilhstayvhtiyinho kehsv iyu'i ukvwiyuhi tsuyohisehti kehso hsakwo ayhvkhi, hi'akwo anela yvwi.
nahiyuno tikanotsalhi ayhvkhi unikhahe kwalakwa tshuto'itv.
nahski iyuhsti nhahkwo tunilawitsv kwale'ti hi'a nituwehsele'i v kako itsatulihv titsvyohihsehtiy?  kwalakwahsko? a tsisakhe kalonetv tsanohseho'i?
akhthaheyeno anvyhukvkwo nvtikalhstohtihskv tuniyohsvhi.

uwolhvnho tikukhthohtiyi kahskilv'i utali'i tsutanvhse'i, hia nvtsuwehsele'i; lhehsti nihi kohuhsti na nahskanhvna ahskaya ukvwalhi yititsalvwhihstanelehsti h utsathiyheno tsikiliyoki khohi ika kahskitskv'i nahski nvtikalhstohtihskv'i.
ahsenho nunkvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohhi' ale tinilawiki tunihstiyethane unitsathi kehsv kwalakwa unithayohsehtiyi, tsihsanho unihihstiyi.
ukvwiyuhnho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i; kako hi'a anithali kehsv itsatuli titsvyohihsehtiyi?vi kwalakwa, unatvnhe'i.
kwalehtinohi'a nituwehsele'i; katonho tatsiyvneli tsihsa, kalonetv tsanohseho'i?  waka'tv'vka, kvwohsele nikatv.
ukvwiyuhinho hi'a nuwese'i; katonho, kato utvnelv uhskanvtsv?  ahseno utlikwo nika'e unelhunhe'i, waka'tv'vka, anatihskv'i.

kwaleti utolehohsv tikvwahsehkokihsti nikehsvna kehsv'i, ale unatahsuyetv unalhthalvnhvki, ama wonekihse'i, ale tuhsulehe unitsathi anikhthahv'i, hia nuwehse'i; ayv vlha akhskanvtsvhi yiki hi'a nuhskanvtsvna yvwi ukikv.  nh itskasyahsta.
nikatvnho yvwi uninhetse'i, hi'a nuniwehse'i i ukikv ayv ale tsoketsi okinvkalhehsti.
nhahkwonho kwalakwa teuyohihsele'ivi uli'vnhonhvnho tsihsa tuyohse akatvtiyi.
nhahkwonho aniyahwski ukvwiyuhi tsutselika ukvwiyuh kanelv uniyvhthane tsihsa, ale nanha htekvwathuwhihsthane nikatv sunatalhki aniyahwski.
tuninhuwehsvnho, kikake kahsalena uninhuwo'e'i.

ale unihsteyonhv alhstulo tsutsayohsti kolhvhthanvhi v unihstulane'i, ale kanhsta akhthihsi ititlv unahsvkalatihsthane'i v ale tanalhinikwanvnehe ale anatehohtihske'i v hi'a naniwehske'i; itsvyolika, tsakvwiyhi anitsuhsi unatselika.
tunalitsikwenho ale uniyv'ele kanhstakuale unihskwalvnihsthane'i.
unatehohthanonvno uninhuwehse kahsalena, ale uwahsv tsunhuwe tuninhuwo'e'i; ale unatvtiyi wunhthinvhsthane'i.
uninukotsvnho uniwhahthvhe ahskaya hsalini ehi sawani tsutoitv v nahski kvhska'ihstaki nunvnele uwenvhstiyi tsutanhahwatv.
wuniluhtsvno kolikata tuto'vi, nahski uhskwalukohi tsikathka,
tsunitsoyhsti utithahsti ataka ahsuyi uninenhele'i, unelhthanvnho vlha yutulvhe utithahstiyi.
unatvnenho ale tuniyatholhe tsunhuwo anahsahstihske'i v nahskino utohiyunhe atolehohski tsunetse'i, hi'a tsinuwese'ihv tikwanhuwo tuniyatholhki, ale akwanhuwo' unahsahsthanvki.
unanvnenho ale uniyawihse'i
uniyalvnenho kalvltitlv ulhstathv'i iyuhsti kehsv ulhiyilitehv'i, hi'a nikvnhe kowhele'i; hi'ayo tsihsa ukvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika.
nahskwono itsulaha tekekatvne anithali aninohskihski, sakwo akhthihsi ititlv, sonho akhskani ititlv.
na'vnho anilohski kakvwahsotlvhte'i v ale tanalhstvnhehe'i,
hi'a naniwehske'i; uthvna-tikalawiihstiyi' hiyohstihski, tso'ikwonho ika hihyelitohi hanhehskehski, halhstelv tsvhsv; iyunho nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi kehsehsti, tatanhahwahstv ehatlohi.
nahskwonho nunikvwiyuhsv atsilvanelhohi' ale tinowhelihski ale tinilawiki aniyhelihskv'i hi'a naniwehske'i;
anihso'i tahstelihskvki, uwahsvhskini vlha yvkvlhstelv.  iyunho ukvwiyuhi ihsil unatseli kehsehsti, nhahkwo tatanhahwahstv ehatlo'ahi i khilanho tayeto'iyunhi.
unelhanvhi ulhskahstohtvki; nhahakwo wuhstelv iyunho ulvkwtehsti; hiayhenho tsinikawehskvki, unelhanvhi etota.
aninohskihskinho nahski itsulaha tikekatvnvhi nahskwo kakvwahsotlvt.
nhahkwonho ika utalenvtv tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv iyahsthi uhsvhiyeyi ititlv uhlsihvhsvki nikhv nahski katohi.

tso'inenho iyulhilot iyv khathawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi ititlv tsihsa unhetse ahstaya, hia nuwehse'i; ila, ila, lama hsakwatani?hs nahski hi'a nuhsti katkv'i, unelhanvhi akwatselika v unelnvhi akwatselika, katonho ihskwvhtetsvkwo?
ikatvnho nanhahanitona'i nahski unathvkanv'i ilaya ayhaniha hi'a, unatvnhe'i.
kilakwonho iyvtv ahsiyvwi tuhskwalhthane'ivv ale wunehse tuwoli, ale tsunitsoyahsti ukhali'ihsthane'i i kanstohinho uwekwatthanv wunvnhele nahski utithahsti.
ikatvnho hi'a nuniwese'i; unelaki, itatolehohi, tsikon ilaya takaluhtsi tayuhstelvhil.
tsihsanho tha'line ahstaya unhetsv te'uyohse utanhto.
khvniykwonho anhuwo ayehtoltv uthvna-tikalawi'ihstiyi tulhstluyhe'iav kalvlati tsulenvhe elati wuhskwatihsthane'i v ale katohi ulhihthelvnhe'i, ale nvya tunalhstluyhe'i.
tatselihstvnho tulihstu'ihse'i i ale unitsathi unatanhthi unilhinvtsvhi unatitanese'i,
ale tatselihstv tuninukotse tsulenhvhi nikehse'i v ale kalvkwtiyu katuhv uniyvlhe'i v ale unitsathe khvnikehsv nitunatvnhele'i.

nhahkwonho ahskohitskwi titathinhitohi ale nahski na itsulaha tsihsa kvwayahwski, unatolehohsv katoh alhthelvhvhskv'i, ale nahski nulhsthanitolv'i, utsathe unihskale'i, hia nuniwehse'i; utohiyuhiya unelhanvhi uwetsi kehse hi'a.
nanhhanho anitona'e unitsathe anikeyhv ke iyvtv totinikhanhe'i v nahski tsihsa kelili nvtkvwahstawatvtv kvwahstelhitolvhi,
nanhahunatahsuye meli makiteli' ehihv ale meli tsimi' ale tsohsi unitsiyv ale tsekwiti tsuwetsi unitsi.
uhsvnho nulhsthanv uluhtse' uwenhahi ahskaya alimatiyi ehi tsowa tsuto'itv, nahskwo nahski tsihsa uhstawatitohi kehshe'i;
kwaletiyi uwenvhsei, tsihsa ayelv'i wuthayolhe'i.  nhahkwonho kwaleti unetse ayelv'i tsuniyohihsehtiyi.
tsowanho ayelv unehshv uwetsanulothane kataha nikehsvna anhuwo unekv;
ale unvne uwahsv utseli itse titanihsohtiyi, nahski uyohi uthalehsv'i; ekwanho nvya kalohihstiyi atselihstv wuwehsakwalelhv utanvhse'i.
nanhahnho ikvyititlv titanihsohtiyi tunolhe meli makiteli ehi ale so'i meli.
ale ukitsvtv, atvnv'ihstohtiyi ika ulohsonhvhi v nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi ale anikwalihsi tekvwalawitse kwaleti,
hi'a nuniwehse'iah tsakvwiyuhi, okanvhtha nahski na atalonuhehski, ahsikwo tsikvnhvki, hi'a tsinuwehsvki i tso'inekwo ika totvkaleni.

nahsk iyuhsti hinheki ahstaya iyunvnhtiyi atselihstv'i tso'ine ika ikohitvai kvwhstawatitohihyenho' svnoyi yani'luhki yikvwanohski v hianho yinitaniwehsi yvwi; tsuyohuhsv' to'ulenhv; onhiyinho unatlonuhelhv'i utli uyo'iyu yiki ehskakwo ikvyiyi.
kwalehti hi'a ntuwehsele'i; aniyahwski tetsikhahasi itsena nahstayv iketsvnhti kehe winitsvka.
howanho unenvhse ahstayiyu winunvnele atselihstvi, uniyelvhthane nvyohi, ale tunikhanhe anikhthitihski.
unatotakwonhvhino, khila ika nikalhstihskei alenihskvh suntotakwahsti kehsv meli makiteli ehi aleh so'i meli unakhthanhilhe atselihstv'i.
ale kvnhiyukwo utsathi katohi ulhthelvnhe'i, yihowayhenho utseli tikhanhahwatitohi kalvlati tsutlo'ahse'iyv uluhtsvnho nvya uwehsakwalelhe' uhvhse kalohihstiyi ahv'ihi ale uhskilhane'i.
tikhanhtiyi ankalihski nahskiya kese'i, unhuwa'vno vnhtsi tsinunekiyv nunekiye'i.
anikhthiyanho anihskaihv tuninawe'i v ale tsuniyohuhsvhi nahskiya nunalhsthane'i.
tikhanhahwatitohinho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsel anikeyhv; lhehsti nihi yihstihska'ihehsti, tsikahthahyhenho tsihsa akatvnvhi ehstiyohv'i.
vlha anhi thika'na v tulenhvyhenho nahskiya nuwehsv'i v ehstena ehstakhtha ukvwiyhi atsinvnv'i.
ale ulhihstiyu ihstena witihstinohvhsi kvwahstawatitohi te'ulenhv uyohuhsvhi; ale kvnhiyukwo ikvyi kelili nvtayehsi, nanhahtayetsiko'i.  khvniyukwo ihstvnohvhsi.
ulhihstiyunho atselihstv unata'nvse'i v anihska'ihe ale utsathi analihelike'ihv ale tunihskwalhthane kvwhstawatitohi tuninhonelvhse'i.
ana'ihsvnho taninonelihsv kvwhstawatitohi kvnhyukwo tsihsa tunatlohse'i; thohiyi tetatakowahthv, utvnhe'i.  uniluhtsvno tsulahsihteni tuniniyvhe'i, elati nikvwatvnhele'i.
nhahkwonho tsihsa hi'a nituwehsele'i, lhehsti yihstihska'ihehsti a ihstena witihstinohvhsi' otsalinhvlhi kelili wunilohihstiyi, nanhahnho takvkikohi.
anaihsvnho khvniyukwo ikatv uniyawihsvhi uniluhtse katuhv'i, ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv-anelhohi tuninhonhele nikatv nulhsthanitolv'i.
nahskinho ale tinilawiki tunilawitsv ale uninohelhv, utsathi atelv tuninhele aniyahwski,
ha nuniwehse'i; hi'a nitsiwehsvha v kvwhstawatitohi hsvnoyi uniluhtsvki, otsilhinv kvwanohskihsvki.
iyunho nahski athvkanv ukvwiyuhi v tayotsihstiyethani, ale tatsvhstelvhi.
tunikihsvnho atelv, niketsiwehselv nunatvnele'i.  nahskino hia khanohetv ahsi aninhohelhitoha anitsuhsi.
nhahkwonho hsa'tu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi kelili unenvhsvki tsotalv tsihsa unahsehelv'i.
kvwakohvnho elati nikvwatvnhelvki.  ahsenho ikatv unatlahtsithvelvkwo.
tsihsanho uluhtsv tuwonhthanvkisi hi'a nuwehsvki; vkhinelv nika'v tikilvwhihstanhtiy kalvlati ale elohi.
nahski iyuhsti itsena wititseyohvhk nakatv nunatalehsv yvwi v tetsawohskehsti itstihskehsti tuto'v akayvlike'i ale uwetsi ale kalvkwtiyu atanhto,
tetseyohvhskehsti tsunikhanhahwtvhstiyi nika'v itsvnetselv'i; kvniyukwonho nikohilv itsvyelatitoha wikvlhskwatihski elohi.  emenv.
